   use stdlib_sorting, only: sort
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(int32), parameter :: input(8)=[5,-3,0,-3,2,1,5,-1],expected(8)=[-3,-3,-1,0,1,2,5,5]
   real(wp), parameter :: real_input(7)=[2.5_wp,-1.25_wp,0._wp,0.5_wp,-1.25_wp,2._wp,-3._wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: real_expected(7)=[-3._wp,-1.25_wp,-1.25_wp,0._wp,0.5_wp,2._wp,2.5_wp]
   integer(int32) :: values(8),large(64),large_expected(64),original(64),empty(0),single(1)
   real(wp) :: real_values(7)
   integer :: i,value,position,copies
   values=input
   call sort(values)
   if (any(values/=expected)) error stop 'ascending integer sort mismatch'
   print '(a,8i5)', 'Ascending integers:',values
   call sort(values)
   if (any(values/=expected)) error stop 'sort is not idempotent'
   values=input
   call sort(values,reverse=.true.)
   if (any(values/=expected(8:1:-1))) error stop 'descending integer sort mismatch'
   print '(a,8i5)', 'Descending integers:',values
   real_values=real_input
   call sort(real_values)
   if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real_values))) error stop 'nonfinite sorted values'
   if (any(real_values/=real_expected)) error stop 'ascending real sort mismatch'
   print '(a,7f9.3)', 'Ascending real values:',real_values
   real_values=real_input
   call sort(real_values,reverse=.true.)
   if (any(real_values/=real_expected(7:1:-1))) error stop 'descending real sort mismatch'
   do i=1,size(large)
      original(i)=modulo(37*i,17)-8
   end do
   ! Build an exact sorted reference from counts in the known integer range, not another sort.
   position=0
   do value=-8,8
      copies=count(original==value)
      large_expected(position+1:position+copies)=value
      position=position+copies
   end do
   if (position/=size(large)) error stop 'histogram reference size'
   large=original
   call sort(large)
   if (any(large/=large_expected)) error stop 'histogram-reference sort mismatch'
   print '(a,i0,a)', 'Sorted ',size(large),' repeated integers against a histogram reference.'
   call sort(empty)
   single=[42]
   call sort(single)
   if (single(1)/=42) error stop 'singleton sort mismatch'
   print '(a)', 'Empty and singleton arrays checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS stdlib-sorting-reference'
end program

name: gams-primes-trial-division
source:
! GAMS B: prime enumeration and primality, checked against independent trial division.
! Author API patterns: perazz/fortran-primes test/test_primes.f90 at the catalog pin.
! See licenses/fortran-primes-MIT.txt and the upstream source's additional notices.
! Known pinned limitation: is_prime(3215031751_int64) times out; retained under docs/gams-candidates.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int32, int64
   use prime_numbers, only: primes, is_prime
   implicit none
   integer(int32), allocatable :: actual(:), expected(:)
   integer(int32) :: n, k, reference(1000)
   integer(int64), parameter :: large_cases(*) = [ &
      -2_int64, 0_int64, 1_int64, 2_int64, 2147483647_int64, &
      10000000019_int64, 10000000020_int64, 10000000021_int64]

   k = 0
   do n = -20, 1000
      if (is_prime(n) .neqv. trial_prime(int(n, int64))) then
         print '(a,i0)', 'Primality mismatch for ', n
         error stop 'int32 primality check'
      end if
      if (trial_prime(int(n, int64))) then
         k = k + 1
         reference(k) = n
      end if
   end do
   expected = reference(:k)
   actual = primes(1000_int32)
   if (size(actual) /= size(expected)) error stop 'prime list size'
   if (any(actual /= expected)) error stop 'prime list values'
   if (size(actual) /= 168 .or. sum(actual) /= 76127) error stop 'known count and sum'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Primes through 1000: count = ', size(actual), '; sum = ', sum(actual)

   expected = pack(reference(:k), reference(:k) >= 100 .and. reference(:k) <= 200)
   actual = primes(100_int32, 200_int32)
   if (size(actual) /= size(expected)) error stop 'bounded list size'
   if (any(actual /= expected)) error stop 'bounded list values'
   print '(a,*(1x,i0))', 'Primes in [100,200]:', actual
   actual = primes(1_int32)
   if (size(actual) /= 0) error stop 'no primes below two'
   actual = primes(10_int32, 2_int32)
   if (size(actual) /= 0) error stop 'reversed range'

   do k = 1, size(large_cases)
      if (is_prime(large_cases(k)) .neqv. trial_prime(large_cases(k))) then
         print '(a,i0)', 'Primality mismatch for ', large_cases(k)
         error stop 'int64 primality check'
      end if
      print '(a,i0,a,l1)', 'is_prime(', large_cases(k), ') = ', is_prime(large_cases(k))
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Checked 1021 int32 cases, 8 int64 cases, and enumerated prime lists.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS primes-trial-division'
contains
   logical function trial_prime(value) result(prime)
      integer(int64), intent(in) :: value
      integer(int64) :: divisor
      prime = .false.
      if (value < 2) return
      divisor = 2
      ! Division in the bound avoids squaring a potentially large divisor.
      do while (divisor <= value / divisor)
         if (modulo(value, divisor) == 0) return
         divisor = divisor + 1
      end do
      prime = .true.
   end function
end program

name: gams-rpn-gcd-lcm-reference
source:
! GAMS B: direct use of the calculator's number-theory routines, without its UI.
! Original API driver; upstream MIT notice retained in licenses/rpn-calculator-MIT.txt.
program main
   use rat, only: gcd, lcm
   implicit none
   integer :: a, b, divisor, multiple, expected_gcd, expected_lcm, checked_lcm
   checked_lcm = 0
   do a = 0, 64
      do b = 0, 64
         ! Independent reference: enumerate every possible common divisor.
         expected_gcd = 0
         do divisor = 1, max(a, b)
            if (modulo(a, divisor) == 0 .and. modulo(b, divisor) == 0) expected_gcd = divisor
         end do
         if (gcd(a, b) /= expected_gcd) then
            print '(a,2(1x,i0))', 'GCD mismatch:', a, b
            error stop 'greatest common divisor'
         end if
         ! The pinned LCM implementation divides by gcd(a,b): (0,0) is outside its domain.
         if (a == 0 .and. b == 0) cycle
         expected_lcm = 0
         if (a > 0 .and. b > 0) then
            ! Search positive multiples; do not use gcd or the package LCM formula.
            do multiple = max(a, b), a*b, max(a, b)
               if (modulo(multiple, a) == 0 .and. modulo(multiple, b) == 0) then
                  expected_lcm = multiple
                  exit
               end if
            end do
         end if
         if (lcm(a, b) /= expected_lcm) then
            print '(a,2(1x,i0))', 'LCM mismatch:', a, b
            error stop 'least common multiple'
         end if
         checked_lcm = checked_lcm + 1
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'gcd(48,18) = ', gcd(48,18)
   print '(a,i0)', 'lcm(48,18) = ', lcm(48,18)
   print '(a)', 'Checked 4225 GCD and 4224 LCM cases for operands 0 through 64.'
   if (checked_lcm /= 4224) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a)', 'Zero operands checked; lcm(0,0), negative signs and overflow are outside this example.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS rpn-gcd-lcm-reference'
end program

name: gams-rational-addition-reference
source:
! Original GAMS A2 API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use rational_number, only: rationalnumber_t, ratNumInit, ratNumAdd, ratNumToStr, &
      ratNumGetNumerator, ratNumGetDenominator
   implicit none
   type(rationalnumber_t) :: left, right, answer
   integer :: p, q, r, s, mode, calls, num, den, divisor, common
   integer(int64) :: expected_num, expected_den
   calls = 0
   do p = -4, 4
      do q = 1, 6
         do r = -4, 4
            do s = 1, 6
               left = ratNumInit(p, q)
               right = ratNumInit(r, s)
               expected_num = int(p,int64)*s + int(r,int64)*q
               expected_den = int(q,int64)*s
               do mode = 0, 1
                  answer = ratNumAdd(left, right, simplify=(mode == 1))
                  num = ratNumGetNumerator(answer)
                  den = ratNumGetDenominator(answer)
                  if (den <= 0) error stop 'denominator sign'
                  if (int(num,int64)*expected_den /= expected_num*den) error stop 'exact rational sum'
                  if (mode == 1 .and. expected_num > 0) then
                     common = 1
                     do divisor = 1, int(min(expected_num,expected_den))
                        if (modulo(expected_num,int(divisor,int64)) == 0 .and. &
                            modulo(expected_den,int(divisor,int64)) == 0) common = divisor
                     end do
                     if (num /= expected_num/common .or. den /= expected_den/common) &
                        error stop 'positive sum reduction'
                  end if
                  calls = calls + 1
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   answer = ratNumAdd(ratNumInit(1,3), ratNumInit(1,6), simplify=.true.)
   print '(a)', '1/3 + 1/6 = '//ratNumToStr(answer)
   answer = ratNumAdd(ratNumInit(-1,3), ratNumInit(-1,6), simplify=.true.)
   print '(a)', '-1/3 - 1/6 = '//ratNumToStr(answer)//' (same value as -1/2)'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exact additions checked with simplify off/on: ', calls
   if (calls /= 5832) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a)', 'Pinned simplifier does not reduce negative/zero numerators; value checks allow this.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS rational-addition-reference'
end program

name: gams-strith-integer-reference
source:
! Original GAMS A1 API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use strith, only: strint_type, new_strint, digits
   implicit none
   type(strint_type) :: a, b, result
   integer :: i, j, cases
   character(32) :: expected
   cases = 0
   do i = -20, 20
      do j = -20, 20
         a = new_strint(int(i,int64))
         b = new_strint(int(j,int64))
         result = a + b
         write(expected,'(i0)') i + j
         call check(result, trim(expected))
         result = a - b
         write(expected,'(i0)') i - j
         call check(result, trim(expected))
         cases = cases + 2
      end do
   end do
   ! Exact decimal identities outside int64, without overflowing native integers.
   a = decimal('999999999999999999999999999999')
   b = new_strint(1_int64)
   result = a + b
   call check(result, '1000000000000000000000000000000')
   print '(a)', 'Thirty nines plus one: '//result%to_string(remove_0_padding=.true.)
   a = decimal('1000000000000000000000000000000')
   result = a - b
   call check(result, '999999999999999999999999999999')
   a = decimal('18446744073709551616')
   b = decimal('18446744073709551615')
   result = a - b
   call check(result, '1')
   result = b - a
   call check(result, '-1')
   a = new_strint('-'//repeat('0',digits-31)//'999999999999999999999999999999')
   b = decimal('999999999999999999999999999999')
   result = a + b
   call check(result, '0')
   print '(a,i0,a)', 'Checked ', cases, ' small signed additions/subtractions and 5 large decimal identities.'
   print '(a)', 'Fixed-capacity decimal integers; capacity overflow is outside this example.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS strith-integer-reference'
contains
   function decimal(text) result(value)
      character(*), intent(in) :: text
      type(strint_type) :: value
      if (len(text) >= digits) error stop 'decimal capacity'
      value = new_strint('+'//repeat('0',digits-1-len(text))//text)
   end function
   subroutine check(value, text)
      type(strint_type), intent(in) :: value
      character(*), intent(in) :: text
      character(:), allocatable :: actual
      actual = value%to_string(remove_0_padding=.true.)
      if (actual /= text) then
         print '(a)', 'Expected '//text//'; got '//actual
         error stop 'decimal integer check'
      end if
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-ryu-binary64-roundtrip
source:
! Original GAMS A6 API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
! This tests finite round trips, not a proof of globally shortest decimal strings.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64, real64
   use ryu, only: d2shortest
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: exponents(*) = [0,1,2,10,511,1022,1023,1024,1535,2045,2046]
   integer(int64), parameter :: mantissas(*) = [0_int64,1_int64,2_int64, &
      2_int64**51-1,2_int64**51,2_int64**52-1]
   integer :: i, j, sign, count, ios
   integer(int64) :: bits
   real(real64) :: value, restored
   character(:), allocatable :: text
   count = 0
   if (storage_size(value) /= 64 .or. radix(value) /= 2 .or. digits(value) /= 53) &
      error stop 'requires IEEE binary64 layout'
   do i = 1, size(exponents)
      do j = 1, size(mantissas)
         do sign = 0, 1
            bits = ior(shiftl(int(exponents(i),int64),52), mantissas(j))
            if (sign == 1) bits = ibset(bits,63)
            value = transfer(bits, value)
            text = d2shortest(value)
            read(text,*,iostat=ios) restored
            if (ios /= 0) then
               print '(a)', 'Unreadable decimal: '//text
               error stop 'decimal parse'
            end if
            if (transfer(restored,0_int64) /= bits) then
               print '(a,z16.16,a,a)', 'Round-trip mismatch for bits ', bits, ': ', text
               error stop 'binary64 round trip'
            end if
            count = count + 1
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (count /= 132) error stop 'case count'
   if (d2shortest(0.0_real64) /= '0.0') error stop 'positive zero spelling'
   if (d2shortest(-0.0_real64) /= '-0.0') error stop 'negative zero spelling'
   print '(a)', 'Smallest subnormal: '//d2shortest(transfer(1_int64,value))
   print '(a)', 'Smallest normal: '//d2shortest(tiny(value))
   print '(a)', 'Largest finite: '//d2shortest(huge(value))
   print '(a)', 'Negative zero: '//d2shortest(-0.0_real64)
   print '(a,i0)', 'Finite binary64 values recovered with identical bits: ', count
   print '(a)', 'NaN/infinity spelling, all bit patterns and shortest-length optimality are outside this example.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS ryu-binary64-roundtrip'
end program

name: gams-mpfun-real-addition
source:
! Original GAMS A3c API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use mpmodule
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: decimal_digits = 120, words = decimal_digits/mpdpw + 2
   integer :: cases
   type(mp_real) :: result
   character(*), parameter :: huge_integer = '1'//repeat('0',80)
   character(*), parameter :: huge_plus_one = '1'//repeat('0',79)//'1'
   cases = 0
   call check(huge_integer, '1', huge_plus_one)
   call check('1', huge_integer, huge_plus_one)
   call check('-'//huge_integer, '-1', '-'//huge_plus_one)
   call check(huge_integer, '-'//huge_integer, '0')
   call check('123456789012345678901234567890', '987654321098765432109876543210', &
      '1111111110111111111011111111100')
   call check('0.125', '0.375', '0.5')
   if (cases /= 6) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a)', 'Exact decimal identity: 10^80 + 1 = 1 followed by 79 zeroes and 1.'
   print '(a)', 'Also checked operand order, negative addition, cancellation and an explicit 31-digit sum.'
   print '(a)', 'Computed dyadic sum 0.125 + 0.375:'
   call mpwrite(6,30,8,result)
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Checked additions: ', cases, '; requested decimal precision: ', decimal_digits
   print '(a)', 'PASS mpfun-real-addition'
contains
   subroutine check(left_text, right_text, expected_text)
      character(*), intent(in) :: left_text, right_text, expected_text
      type(mp_real) :: left, right, expected
      left = number(left_text)
      right = number(right_text)
      expected = number(expected_text)
      result = left + right
      if (result /= expected) then
         print '(a)', left_text//' + '//right_text//' /= '//expected_text
         error stop 'multiprecision real addition'
      end if
      cases = cases + 1
   end subroutine
   function number(text) result(value)
      character(*), intent(in) :: text
      type(mp_real) :: value
      ! The author's decimal-string constructor requires a decimal point.
      if (index(text,'.') == 0) then
         value = mpreal(text//'.0',words)
      else
         value = mpreal(text,words)
      end if
   end function
end program

name: gams-mpfun-complex-addition
source:
! Original GAMS A4c API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use mpmodule

   integer :: cases
   type(mp_complex) :: result
   character(*), parameter :: big = '1'//repeat('0',80)

   cases = 0
   ! Component-wise exact decimal references, independent of another complex solver.
   call check(big, '-'//big, '-'//less_one, plus_two, '1', '2')
   print '(a)', '(10^80,-10^80) + (-(10^80-1),10^80+2), recovered components:'
   call mpwrite(6,30,8,mpreal(result,words),aimag(result))
   call check('-'//big, big, less_one, '-'//plus_two, '-1', '-2')
   call check(big, '1', '1', big, plus_one, plus_one)
   call check('0.125', '-0.25', '0.375', '0.75', '0.5', '0.5')
   call check(big, plus_one, '-'//big, '-'//plus_one, '0', '0')
   if (cases /= 5) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Exact complex sums checked: ', cases, '; requested decimal precision: ', decimal_digits
   print '(a)', 'Checked both components; multiplication and transcendental functions are outside this driver.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS mpfun-complex-addition'

         error stop 'multiprecision complex components'

   function number(text) result(value)
      character(*), intent(in) :: text
      type(mp_real) :: value
      ! The author's decimal-string constructor requires a decimal point.
      if (index(text,'.') == 0) then
         value = mpreal(text//'.0',words)
      else
         value = mpreal(text,words)
      end if
   end function
end program

name: gams-bstrith-bit-reference
source:
! Original GAMS N2 API driver. MIT: licenses/arithmetic-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use bstrith, only: shift_l, shift_r, xor, not, add, sub
   implicit none
   integer :: value, amount, left, right, checks
   character(8) :: bits, mask, expected
   character(4) :: a, b, reference
   checks = 0
   do value = 0, 255
      write(bits,'(b8.8)') value
      do amount = 1, 7
         write(expected,'(b8.8)') iand(ishft(value,amount),255)
         if (shift_l(bits,amount) /= expected) error stop 'left shift'
         write(expected,'(b8.8)') ishft(value,-amount)
         if (shift_r(bits,amount) /= expected) error stop 'right shift'
         checks = checks + 2
      end do
      write(expected,'(b8.8)') ieor(value,255)
      if (not(bits) /= expected) error stop 'bit complement'
      mask = '10100101'
      write(expected,'(b8.8)') ieor(value,165)
      if (xor(bits,mask) /= expected) error stop 'bit xor'
      write(expected,'(b8.8)') modulo(value+1,256)
      if (add(bits,'00000001') /= expected) error stop '8-bit modular addition'
      write(expected,'(b8.8)') modulo(value-1,256)
      if (sub(bits,'00000001') /= expected) error stop '8-bit modular subtraction'
      checks = checks + 4
   end do
   do left = 0, 15
      do right = 0, 15
         write(a,'(b4.4)') left
         write(b,'(b4.4)') right
         write(reference,'(b4.4)') modulo(left+right,16)
         if (add(a,b) /= reference) error stop '4-bit modular addition'
         write(reference,'(b4.4)') modulo(left-right,16)
         if (sub(a,b) /= reference) error stop '4-bit modular subtraction'
         checks = checks + 2
      end do
   end do
   if (checks /= 5120) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a)', '10100101 shifted left by 2: '//shift_l('10100101',2)
   print '(a)', '10100101 XOR 11110000: '//xor('10100101','11110000')
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent bit/arithmetic checks passed: ', checks
   print '(a)', 'Shift distances 1..7 for every 8-bit value; all pairs of 4-bit arithmetic operands.'
   print '(a)', 'Out-of-range shifts, malformed strings and wider strings are outside this example.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS bstrith-bit-reference'
end program

name: gams-carlson-rf-reference
source:
! Original C14 API driver. MIT: licenses/special-function-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use carlson_elliptic_module, only: wp=>carlson_elliptic_module_wp, drf
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: triples(3,3)=reshape([0.25_wp,1._wp,4._wp, &
      1._wp,2._wp,4._wp, 2._wp,3._wp,5._wp],[3,3])
   real(wp), parameter :: moduli(*)=[0._wp,0.25_wp,0.75_wp,0.95_wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: diagonal(*)=[0.25_wp,1._wp,4._wp]
   real(wp) :: x,y,z,k,actual,reference,coarse,fine,max_error,pi,u,h,total
   integer :: i,j,status
   pi=acos(-1._wp)
   max_error=0
   do i=1,size(diagonal)
      x=diagonal(i)
      actual=drf(x,x,x,status)
      call check(actual,1/sqrt(x),status)
   end do
   do i=1,3
      x=triples(1,i); y=triples(2,i); z=triples(3,i)
      actual=drf(x,y,z,status)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'RF status'
      coarse=rf_integral(x,y,z,2048)
      fine=rf_integral(x,y,z,4096)
      call check(coarse,fine,0)
      call check(actual,fine,0)
      reference=drf(y,z,x,status)
      call check(reference,actual,status)
      reference=drf(4*x,4*y,4*z,status)
      call check(reference,actual/2,status)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'k             Complete elliptic K(k)'
   do i=1,size(moduli)
      k=moduli(i)
      actual=drf(0._wp,1-k*k,1._wp,status)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'elliptic K status'
      h=pi/(2*4096)
      total=1+1/sqrt(1-k*k)
      do j=1,4095
         u=j*h
         total=total+merge(4._wp,2._wp,mod(j,2)==1)/sqrt(1-k*k*sin(u)**2)
      end do
      reference=total*h/3
      call check(actual,reference,0)
      print '(f6.2,f26.16)',k,actual
   end do
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled reference/identity error: ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS carlson-rf-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(value,expected,code)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: value,expected
      integer,intent(in) :: code
      real(wp) :: error
      if(code/=0) error stop 'RF status'
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(value) .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(expected)) error stop 'nonfinite RF'
      error=abs(value-expected)/max(1._wp,abs(expected))
      max_error=max(max_error,error)
      if(error>2.e-11_wp) error stop 'RF reference check'
   end subroutine
   function rf_integral(a,b,c,n) result(value)
      real(wp),intent(in) :: a,b,c
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      real(wp) :: value,t,term,step
      integer :: j
      ! t=1/sqrt(1+u) transforms the defining RF integral to a smooth finite interval.
      step=1._wp/n
      value=1+1/sqrt(a*b*c)
      do j=1,n-1
         t=j*step
         term=1/sqrt((1+(a-1)*t*t)*(1+(b-1)*t*t)*(1+(c-1)*t*t))
         value=value+merge(4._wp,2._wp,mod(j,2)==1)*term
      end do
      value=value*step/3
   end function
end program

name: gams-bernoulli-power-sums
source:
! Original C19 API driver. MIT: licenses/special-function-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use specfun_module, only: bernob, wp=>specfun_wp
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter :: indices(*)=[0,1,2,4,6,8,10,12], sizes(*)=[3,10,20]
   integer,parameter :: numerators(*)=[1,-1,1,-1,1,-1,5,-691]
   integer,parameter :: denominators(*)=[1,2,6,30,42,30,66,2730]
   real(wp) :: values(0:12),coefficients(0:12),expected,actual,maximum_error,error
   integer(int64) :: direct,choose
   integer :: i,j,p,n,m,checks
   call bernob(12,values)
   maximum_error=0
   coefficients=0
   do i=1,size(indices)
      j=indices(i)
      expected=real(numerators(i),wp)/denominators(i)
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(values(j))) error stop 'nonfinite Bernoulli number'
      error=abs(values(j)-expected)/max(1._wp,abs(expected))
      maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
      if(error>3.e-12_wp) error stop 'Bernoulli rational reference'
      coefficients(j)=values(j)
      print '(a,i0,a,f23.15)', 'B(',j,') = ',values(j)
   end do
   ! bernob does not assign odd output positions >1 at this pin. Do not read them.
   ! Their mathematical zeros are supplied locally for the independent power-sum application.
   checks=0
   do i=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(i)
      do p=1,8
         direct=0
         do m=0,n-1
            direct=direct+int(m,int64)**p
         end do
         actual=0
         choose=1
         do j=0,p
            actual=actual+real(choose,wp)*coefficients(j)*real(n,wp)**(p+1-j)
            choose=choose*(p+1-j)/(j+1)
         end do
         actual=actual/(p+1)
         expected=real(direct,wp)
         error=abs(actual-expected)/max(1._wp,abs(expected))
         maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
         if(.not.ieee_is_finite(actual) .or. error>3.e-12_wp) error stop 'integer power sum'
         checks=checks+1
      end do
   end do
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent integer power sums checked: ',checks
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'Odd outputs above B1 are unassigned at this pin and are not read.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS bernoulli-power-sums'
end program

name: gams-amos-complex-series
source:
! Original C10 API driver. MIT: licenses/special-function-drivers-MIT.txt.
! Known pinned failure at z=2-0.75i retained under docs/gams-candidates/amosf90.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use amos, only: f90_zbesj,f90_zbesi,f90_zbesk
   implicit none
   complex(dp),parameter :: arguments(*)=[cmplx(.5_dp,.25_dp,dp),cmplx(1._dp,.5_dp,dp),cmplx(2._dp,.75_dp,dp)]
   real(dp),parameter :: orders(*)=[.3_dp,.5_dp,1.25_dp],pi=acos(-1._dp)
   complex(dp) :: jvalues(2),ivalues(2),kvalue(1),z,reference
   real(dp) :: nu,maximum_error
   integer :: i,j,m,nz,status,checks
   maximum_error=0
   checks=0
   do i=1,size(arguments)
      z=arguments(i)
      do j=1,size(orders)
         nu=orders(j)
         call f90_zbesj(z,nu,1,2,jvalues,nz,status)
         if(status/=0 .or. nz/=0) error stop 'AMOS J status/underflow'
         call f90_zbesi(z,nu,1,2,ivalues,nz,status)
         if(status/=0 .or. nz/=0) error stop 'AMOS I status/underflow'
         do m=1,2
            call check(jvalues(m),series(z,nu+m-1,-1))
            call check(ivalues(m),series(z,nu+m-1,1))
         end do
      end do
      call f90_zbesk(z,.5_dp,1,1,kvalue,nz,status)
      if(status/=0 .or. nz/=0) error stop 'AMOS K status/underflow'
      reference=sqrt(pi/(2*z))*exp(-z)
      call check(kvalue(1),reference)
      print '(a,2f10.4,a,2f20.12)', 'z = ',real(z),aimag(z), '; K_0.5(z) = ',real(kvalue(1)),aimag(kvalue(1))
   end do
   if(checks/=39) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Independent complex Bessel values checked: ',checks
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS amos-complex-series'
contains
   subroutine check(value,expected)
      complex(dp),intent(in) :: value,expected
      real(dp) :: error
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite([real(value),aimag(value),real(expected),aimag(expected)]))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite complex reference'
      error=abs(value-expected)/max(1._dp,abs(expected))
      maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
      if(error>2.e-12_dp) then
         print '(a,2f16.8,a,f12.6,a,i0)', 'At z=',real(z),aimag(z),'; starting order=',nu,'; sequence index=',m
         print '(a,2es24.16)', 'Actual:   ',real(value),aimag(value)
         print '(a,2es24.16)', 'Reference:',real(expected),aimag(expected)
         print '(a,es24.16)', 'Scaled error:',error
         error stop 'complex Bessel reference'
      end if
      checks=checks+1
   end subroutine
   function series(x,order,sign_factor) result(value)
      complex(dp),intent(in) :: x
      real(dp),intent(in) :: order
      integer,intent(in) :: sign_factor
      complex(dp) :: value,term,total
      integer :: k
      logical :: converged
      term=cmplx(1._dp,0._dp,dp)
      total=term
      converged=.false.
      do k=1,100
         term=term*(sign_factor*x*x/4)/(k*(order+k))
         total=total+term
         if(abs(term)<=epsilon(1._dp)*max(1._dp,abs(total))) then
            converged=.true.
            exit
         end if
      end do
      if(.not.converged) error stop 'reference series did not converge'
      value=(x/2)**order*total/gamma(order+1)
   end function
end program

name: gams-blas-gemm-reference
source:
! Original D1b6 API driver. MIT: licenses/linear-algebra-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use blas, only: blas_gemm
   implicit none
   real(dp) :: base_a(3,2),base_b(2,4),initial(3,4),actual(3,4),expected(3,4)
   real(dp),allocatable :: a(:,:),b(:,:)
   real(dp),parameter :: alphas(*)=[1._dp,-2._dp,0._dp],betas(*)=[0._dp,.5_dp,-1._dp]
   real(dp) :: alpha,beta,error,maximum_error
   character,parameter :: options(*)=['N','T']
   integer :: i,j,k,ta,tb,mode,cases
   do i=1,3
      do k=1,2
         base_a(i,k)=real(2*i-3*k,dp)
      end do
      do j=1,4
         initial(i,j)=real(i-j,dp)/2
      end do
   end do
   do k=1,2
      do j=1,4
         base_b(k,j)=real(3*k-j,dp)
      end do
   end do
   maximum_error=0
   cases=0
   do ta=1,2
      do tb=1,2
         if(ta==1) then
            a=base_a
         else
            a=transpose(base_a)
         end if
         if(tb==1) then
            b=base_b
         else
            b=transpose(base_b)
         end if
         do mode=1,3
            alpha=alphas(mode); beta=betas(mode)
            expected=beta*initial
            ! Independent scalar loops; no MATMUL or another BLAS call supplies the reference.
            do i=1,3
               do j=1,4
                  do k=1,2
                     expected(i,j)=expected(i,j)+alpha*base_a(i,k)*base_b(k,j)
                  end do
               end do
            end do
            actual=initial
            call blas_gemm(options(ta),options(tb),3,4,2,alpha,a,size(a,1),b,size(b,1),beta,actual,3)
            if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'nonfinite GEMM result'
            error=maxval(abs(actual-expected))/max(1._dp,maxval(abs(expected)))
            maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
            if(error>1.e-12_dp) error stop 'GEMM scalar-loop reference'
            cases=cases+1
            if(ta==1 .and. tb==1 .and. mode==1) then
               print '(a)', '3-by-2 times 2-by-4 matrix product:'
               do i=1,3
                  print '(4f12.4)',actual(i,:)
               end do
            end if
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if(cases/=12) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Transpose/scaling combinations checked: ',cases
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scaled error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS blas-gemm-reference'
end program

name: gams-fsparse-matvec-reference
source:
! Original D1b4 API driver. MIT: licenses/linear-algebra-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use fsparse, only: COO_dp,CSR_dp,dense2coo,coo2csr,matvec
   use fsparse_constants, only: dp
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(COO_dp) :: coo
   type(CSR_dp) :: csr
   real(dp) :: a(4,3),vectors(3,3),x(3),initial(4),product(4),expected(4),ycoo(4),ycsr(4)
   integer :: i,j,v,mode,repetition,calls
   a=reshape([2._dp,0._dp,0._dp,-1._dp, 0._dp,3._dp,0._dp,0._dp, &
      4._dp,0._dp,0._dp,5._dp],[4,3])
   vectors(:,1)=[1._dp,-2._dp,3._dp]
   vectors(:,2)=[0._dp,1._dp,-1._dp]
   vectors(:,3)=0
   call dense2coo(a,coo)
   call coo2csr(coo,csr)
   calls=0
   do v=1,3
      x=vectors(:,v)
      product=0
      do i=1,4
         do j=1,3
            product(i)=product(i)+a(i,j)*x(j)
         end do
      end do
      do mode=0,1
         initial=real(mode,dp)*[.5_dp,-1._dp,7._dp,2._dp]
         ycoo=initial
         ycsr=initial
         do repetition=1,2
            ! This API accumulates y := y+A*x. Repeating the call must add again.
            call matvec(coo,x,ycoo)
            call matvec(csr,x,ycsr)
            expected=initial+repetition*product
            call check(ycoo,expected)
            call check(ycsr,expected)
            calls=calls+2
         end do
      end do
      print '(a,i0,a,4f10.3)', 'A*x for vector ',v,': ',product
   end do
   if(calls/=24) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'COO/CSR accumulated products checked: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Rectangular 4-by-3 matrix includes an empty row; zero/nonzero output and zero input checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fsparse-matvec-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,reference)
      real(dp),intent(in) :: actual(:),reference(:)
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'nonfinite sparse result'
      if(maxval(abs(actual-reference))>1.e-12_dp) error stop 'sparse scalar-loop reference'
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-forinv-pseudoinverse-reference
source:
! Original D9c API driver. MIT: licenses/linear-algebra-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use kinds, only: rk
   use forinv, only: inv
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(rk) :: a(3,2),reference(2,3),square(3,3),square_reference(3,3),u(3),v(2),x(2)
   real(rk),allocatable :: result(:,:)
   integer :: i,j,cases
   cases=0
   u=[1._rk,2._rk,3._rk]
   v=[1._rk,2._rk]
   do i=1,3
      do j=1,2
         a(i,j)=u(i)*v(j)
         ! (u*v^T)^+ = v*u^T / ((u^T*u)*(v^T*v)) = v*u^T/70.
         reference(j,i)=v(j)*u(i)/70
      end do
   end do
   call check(a,reference,result)
   x=matmul(result,u)
   if(maxval(abs(x-[.2_rk,.4_rk]))>1.e-11_rk) error stop 'minimum-norm solution'
   print '(a,2f16.10)', 'Rank-one minimum-norm solution: ',x
   ! Two orthogonal columns, squared norms 9 and 5, give an explicit full-rank inverse.
   a(:,1)=[1._rk,2._rk,2._rk]
   a(:,2)=[2._rk,-1._rk,0._rk]
   reference(1,:)=a(:,1)/9
   reference(2,:)=a(:,2)/5
   call check(a,reference,result)
   call check(transpose(a),transpose(reference),result)
   square=0
   square_reference=0
   square(1,1)=2; square(3,3)=4
   square_reference(1,1)=.5_rk; square_reference(3,3)=.25_rk
   call check(square,square_reference,result)
   a=0; reference=0
   call check(a,reference,result)
   if(cases/=5) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Known pseudoinverses and all four Moore-Penrose identities checked: ',cases
   print '(a)', 'Tall, wide, rank-one, singular diagonal and zero matrices; explicit cutoff 1e-10.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS forinv-pseudoinverse-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(original,expected,pseudoinverse)
      real(rk),intent(in) :: original(:,:),expected(:,:)
      real(rk),allocatable,intent(out) :: pseudoinverse(:,:)
      real(rk),allocatable :: workspace(:,:),left(:,:),right(:,:)
      real(rk) :: errors(5)
      ! The pinned ForSVD dependency may overwrite its input; preserve the reference matrix.
      workspace=original
      pseudoinverse=inv(workspace,method='gesvd',tol=1.e-10_rk)
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(pseudoinverse))) error stop 'nonfinite pseudoinverse'
      left=matmul(original,pseudoinverse)
      right=matmul(pseudoinverse,original)
      errors(1)=maxval(abs(pseudoinverse-expected))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(expected)))
      errors(2)=maxval(abs(matmul(left,original)-original))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(original)))
      errors(3)=maxval(abs(matmul(right,pseudoinverse)-pseudoinverse))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(pseudoinverse)))
      errors(4)=maxval(abs(left-transpose(left)))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(left)))
      errors(5)=maxval(abs(right-transpose(right)))/max(1._rk,maxval(abs(right)))
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(errors)) .or. any(errors>1.e-11_rk)) error stop 'pseudoinverse references'
      cases=cases+1
      print '(a,i0,a,5es12.3)', 'Case ',cases,' reference and identity errors: ',errors
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-splpak-paired-noise-fit
source:
! Original K1 API driver. MIT: licenses/applied-methods-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use splpak_module, only: splpak_type,wp=>splpak_wp
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter :: n=24,ncf=10,nwrk=ncf*(ncf+1)+1,nodes(1)=[10]
   type(splpak_type) :: fit
   real(wp) :: x(1,n),y(n),weights(n),coef(ncf),work(nwrk),t,value,derivative,sse
   real(wp),parameter :: slopes(*)=[2._wp,-3._wp,0._wp],offsets(*)=[0._wp,1._wp,-2.25_wp]
   real(wp) :: maximum_value_error,maximum_derivative_error
   integer :: c,i,j,status,checks
   checks=0
   maximum_value_error=0
   maximum_derivative_error=0
   do c=1,3
      do i=1,12
         t=real(i-1,wp)/11
         x(1,2*i-1:2*i)=t
         y(2*i-1:2*i)=offsets(c)+slopes(c)*t
         weights(2*i-1:2*i)=1
         if(c==2) then
            y(2*i-1)=y(2*i-1)+.25_wp
            y(2*i)=y(2*i)-.25_wp
         end if
         if(c==3) weights(2*i-1:2*i)=1+real(i,wp)/10
      end do
      call fit%initialize(1,x,1,y,weights,n,[0._wp],[1._wp],nodes,1._wp,coef,ncf,work,nwrk,status)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'spline initialization'
      do j=0,20
         t=real(j,wp)/20
         value=fit%evaluate(1,[t],coef,[0._wp],[1._wp],nodes,status)
         if(status/=0 .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'spline value status'
         maximum_value_error=max(maximum_value_error,abs(value-offsets(c)-slopes(c)*t))
         derivative=fit%evaluate(1,[t],[1],coef,[0._wp],[1._wp],nodes,status)
         if(status/=0 .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(derivative)) error stop 'spline derivative status'
         maximum_derivative_error=max(maximum_derivative_error,abs(derivative-slopes(c)))
         checks=checks+2
      end do
      sse=0
      do j=1,n
         value=fit%evaluate(1,x(:,j),coef,[0._wp],[1._wp],nodes,status)
         if(status/=0 .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'training value status'
         sse=sse+(value-y(j))**2
      end do
      if(c==2) then
         ! Paired opposite noise makes the line the exact least-squares fit; SSE=24*(1/4)^2.
         if(abs(sse-1.5_wp)>1.e-8_wp) error stop 'known noisy least-squares objective'
      else
         if(sse>1.e-14_wp) error stop 'exact line training residual'
      end if
      print '(a,i0,a,f18.12)', 'Fit ',c,' training SSE: ',sse
      call fit%destroy()
   end do
   if(maximum_value_error>1.e-8_wp) error stop 'known fitted line'
   if(maximum_derivative_error>1.e-7_wp) error stop 'known fitted derivative'
   if(checks/=126) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,2es14.5)', 'Maximum value/derivative errors: ',maximum_value_error,maximum_derivative_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS splpak-paired-noise-fit'
end program

name: gams-fortsa-autocorrelation-reference
source:
! Original L10a2a API driver. MIT: licenses/applied-methods-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_c_binding, only: c_double,c_int
   use fortsa_stats_m, only: acvf,acvf_opt,acvf2acf
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(c_int),parameter :: n=8,m=8
   real(c_double),parameter :: base(n)=[1._c_double,-1._c_double,2._c_double,-2._c_double, &
      3._c_double,-3._c_double,4._c_double,-4._c_double]
   real(c_double) :: series(n),centered(n),reference(m),actual(m,3),average,error,maximum_error
   integer :: c,i,lag,method,covariance_calls,correlation_calls
   covariance_calls=0; correlation_calls=0; maximum_error=0
   do c=1,4
      select case(c)
      case(1)
         series=base
      case(2)
         series=base+10
      case(3)
         series=-2*base+3
      case(4)
         series=7
      end select
      average=0
      do i=1,n
         average=average+series(i)/n
      end do
      centered=series-average
      do lag=0,m-1
         reference(lag+1)=0
         do i=1,n-lag
            reference(lag+1)=reference(lag+1)+centered(i)*centered(i+lag)/n
         end do
      end do
      if(c==1) then
         if(any(abs(reference([1,2,8])-[7.5_c_double,-6.25_c_double,-.5_c_double])>1.e-12_c_double)) &
            error stop 'known covariance anchors'
      end if
      call acvf(series,n,actual(:,1),m)
      call acvf_opt(series,n,0_c_int,actual(:,2),m)
      call acvf_opt(series,n,1_c_int,actual(:,3),m)
      do method=1,3
         if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual(:,method)))) error stop 'nonfinite autocovariance'
         error=maxval(abs(actual(:,method)-reference))
         maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
         if(error>1.e-10_c_double) error stop 'independent lag sums'
         covariance_calls=covariance_calls+1
         if(reference(1)>0) then
            call acvf2acf(actual(:,method),m)
            if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(actual(:,method)))) error stop 'nonfinite autocorrelation'
            error=maxval(abs(actual(:,method)-reference/reference(1)))
            maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
            if(error>1.e-10_c_double) error stop 'normalized autocovariance'
            correlation_calls=correlation_calls+1
         end if
      end do
      if(c==1) then
         print '(a)', 'Lag       Direct autocorrelation'
         do lag=0,m-1
            print '(i3,f24.14)',lag,actual(lag+1,1)
         end do
      end if
   end do
   if(covariance_calls/=12 .or. correlation_calls/=9) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,2i5)', 'Covariance/correlation calls checked: ',covariance_calls,correlation_calls
   print '(a,es14.5)', 'Maximum absolute error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'Constant-series covariance checked; zero-variance correlation is undefined and is not requested.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortsa-autocorrelation-reference'
end program

name: gams-integrate-nd-polynomial-reference
source:
! Original H2b1a2 API driver. MIT: licenses/applied-methods-drivers-MIT.txt.
module problem
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   implicit none
   integer :: powers(3)=0,domain=1
contains
   function integrand(x) result(value)
      real(dp),intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(dp) :: value
      value=product(x**powers(:size(x)))
   end function
   function bounds(x,dimension) result(interval)
      real(dp),intent(in) :: x(:)
      integer,intent(in) :: dimension
      real(dp) :: interval(2)
      select case(domain)
      case(1)
         if(dimension==1) then
            interval=[-1._dp,2._dp]
         else
            interval=[0._dp,3._dp]
         end if
      case(2)
         interval=[0._dp,1._dp]
         if(dimension==2) interval(2)=1+x(1)**2
      case(3)
         select case(dimension)
         case(1)
            interval=[-1._dp,1._dp]
         case(2)
            interval=[0._dp,2._dp]
         case(3)
            interval=[1._dp,3._dp]
         end select
      end select
   end function
end module
program main
   use problem
   use gauss_leg_mod, only: gauss_leg_nd
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(dp) :: actual,expected,choose,error,maximum_error
   integer :: p,q,r,panels,cases
   maximum_error=0; cases=0
   domain=1
   do p=0,4
      do q=0,4
         powers=[p,q,0]
         expected=(2._dp**(p+1)-(-1._dp)**(p+1))/(p+1)*3._dp**(q+1)/(q+1)
         do panels=1,2
            actual=gauss_leg_nd([panels,panels],integrand,bounds)
            call check(actual,expected)
         end do
      end do
   end do
   domain=2
   do p=0,3
      do q=0,3
         powers=[p,q,0]
         expected=0; choose=1
         ! Integrate x^p*(1+x^2)^(q+1)/(q+1) exactly by the binomial theorem.
         do r=0,q+1
            expected=expected+choose/real((q+1)*(p+2*r+1),dp)
            choose=choose*(q+1-r)/real(r+1,dp)
         end do
         actual=gauss_leg_nd([1,1],integrand,bounds)
         call check(actual,expected)
      end do
   end do
   domain=3; powers=[2,3,1]
   actual=gauss_leg_nd([1,1,1],integrand,bounds)
   call check(actual,32._dp/3)
   if(cases/=67) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,f22.14)', '3D integral of x^2*y^3*z: ',actual
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exact polynomial integral checks: ',cases
   print '(a,es14.5)', 'Maximum scaled error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'Panel counts are explicit; each panel uses six Gauss-Legendre nodes per dimension.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS integrate-nd-polynomial-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(value,reference)
      real(dp),intent(in) :: value,reference
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'nonfinite quadrature result'
      error=abs(value-reference)/max(1._dp,abs(reference))
      maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
      if(error>1.e-11_dp) error stop 'exact polynomial integral'
      cases=cases+1
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-conmax-linear-program-certificate
source:
! Original G2a API driver. MIT: licenses/optimization-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use conmax_module, only: slnpro
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: tableau(7,4),x(3),y(6),matrix(2,2),rhs(2),scales(2),lambda(2),expected(2)
   real(wp),parameter :: first(*)=[2._wp,5._wp,-3._wp],second(*)=[4._wp,1._wp,7._wp]
   real(wp) :: objective,certificate,gap
   integer :: iyrct(6),ixrct(6),iycct(3),status,c
   do c=1,3
      select case(c)
      case(1)
         scales=[1._wp,1._wp]
      case(2)
         scales=[.5_wp,3._wp]
      case(3)
         scales=[4._wp,.25_wp]
      end select
      matrix(1,:)=[-1._wp,-1._wp]*scales(1)
      matrix(2,:)=[1._wp,-1._wp]*scales(2)
      rhs=[-first(c)*scales(1),second(c)*scales(2)]
      expected=[(first(c)+second(c))/2,(first(c)-second(c))/2]
      lambda=.5_wp/scales
      ! Nonnegative dual weights combine the inequalities into an upper bound on -y.
      if(maxval(abs(matmul(transpose(matrix),lambda)-[0._wp,-1._wp]))>1.e-12_wp) &
         error stop 'independent dual certificate'
      certificate=dot_product(lambda,rhs)
      tableau=0; x=0; y=0
      iyrct=0; ixrct=0; iycct=0
      tableau(1:2,1:2)=matrix
      tableau(1:2,3)=rhs
      tableau(3,1:2)=[0._wp,1._wp] ! SLNPRO maximizes the negative of this row times x.
      iyrct(1)=-1
      call slnpro(tableau,2,2,iyrct,y,ixrct,iycct,2,2,x,status)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'LP status'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x(:2)))) error stop 'nonfinite LP solution'
      if(maxval(abs(x(:2)-expected))>1.e-9_wp) error stop 'known LP solution'
      if(maxval(matmul(matrix,x(:2))-rhs)>1.e-9_wp) error stop 'LP feasibility'
      objective=-x(2)
      gap=certificate-objective
      if(abs(gap)>1.e-9_wp) error stop 'LP primal-dual gap'
      if(.not.ieee_is_finite(tableau(3,3))) error stop 'nonfinite reported LP objective'
      if(abs(tableau(3,3)-objective)>1.e-9_wp) error stop 'reported LP objective'
      print '(a,i0,a,2f12.6,a,f12.6,a,es12.3)', 'Case ',c,': x,y=',x(:2), &
         '; maximum -y=',objective,'; certificate gap=',gap
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Free variables, mixed-sign optima and rescaled inequalities checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS conmax-linear-program-certificate'
end program

name: gams-bobyqa-box-reference
source:
! Original G2h1a1 API driver. MIT: licenses/optimization-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
module objective_problem
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer :: evaluations=0
   real(wp),parameter :: lower(2)=[0._wp,0._wp],upper(2)=[1._wp,2._wp]
contains
   subroutine objective(n,x,value)
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      real(wp),intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp),intent(out) :: value
      if(n/=2 .or. .not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'invalid BOBYQA callback'
      if(any(x<lower-1.e-12_wp) .or. any(x>upper+1.e-12_wp)) error stop 'callback outside bounds'
      value=(x(1)-2)**2+(x(2)+1)**2
      evaluations=evaluations+1
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use objective_problem
   use bobyqa_module, only: bobyqa
   implicit none
   real(wp),parameter :: starts(2,3)=reshape([.25_wp,1._wp,.9_wp,.1_wp,.1_wp,1.8_wp],[2,3])
   real(wp) :: x(2),value,gradient(2),projected
   integer :: c
   do c=1,3
      x=starts(:,c)
      evaluations=0
      call bobyqa(2,5,x,lower,upper,.1_wp,1.e-9_wp,0,1000,objective)
      if(evaluations>=1000) error stop 'BOBYQA evaluation budget exhausted'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite BOBYQA solution'
      if(maxval(abs(x-[1._wp,0._wp]))>1.e-8_wp) error stop 'known box minimum'
      value=(x(1)-2)**2+(x(2)+1)**2
      if(abs(value-2._wp)>1.e-8_wp) error stop 'known objective'
      gradient=2*(x-[2._wp,-1._wp])
      projected=maxval(abs(x-min(upper,max(lower,x-gradient))))
      if(projected>1.e-8_wp) error stop 'projected optimality residual'
      print '(a,i0,a,2f14.9,a,f14.9,a,i0)', 'Start ',c,': solution=',x,'; f=',value,'; evaluations=',evaluations
   end do
   print '(a)', 'No objective derivatives supplied; reference gradient is used only after solving.'
   print '(a)', 'This API has no returned status flag; checked answers and budget use determine acceptance.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS bobyqa-box-reference'
end program

name: gams-pikaia-rastrigin-reference
source:
! Original G2i API driver. MIT: licenses/optimization-api-drivers-MIT.txt.
module global_problem
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp=>real64
   use pikaia_module, only: pikaia_class
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer :: evaluations=0
contains
   function rastrigin(x) result(value)
      real(wp),intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp) :: value
      value=sum(x*x+10*(1-cos(2*acos(-1._wp)*x)))
   end function
   subroutine fitness(me,x,value)
      class(pikaia_class),intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp),intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(wp),intent(out) :: value
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite genetic callback'
      if(any(abs(x)>2+1.e-12_wp)) error stop 'genetic callback outside bounds'
      value=1/(1+rastrigin(x)) ! PIKAIA maximizes fitness, so the known maximum is 1 at x=0.
      evaluations=evaluations+1
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use global_problem
   implicit none
   integer,parameter :: seeds(*)=[12345,6789,24680]
   integer :: i
   do i=1,size(seeds)
      call run(seeds(i))
   end do
   print '(a)', 'These fixed-seed finite searches do not guarantee global convergence on other problems.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS pikaia-rastrigin-reference'
contains
   subroutine run(seed)
      integer,intent(in) :: seed
      type(pikaia_class) :: solver
      real(wp) :: x(2),value,objective,reference_fitness
      integer :: status
      x=[.37_wp,-.61_wp]
      evaluations=0
      call solver%init(2,[-2._wp,-2._wp],[2._wp,2._wp],fitness,status, &
         ngen=600,np=100,nd=7,ivrb=0,iseed=seed,convergence_tol=1.e-10_wp,convergence_window=601)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'PIKAIA initialization'
      call solver%solve(x,value,status)
      if(status/=0) error stop 'PIKAIA solve status'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)) .or. .not.ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'nonfinite global result'
      if(any(abs(x)>2+1.e-12_wp)) error stop 'global result outside bounds'
      objective=rastrigin(x)
      reference_fitness=1/(1+objective)
      if(abs(value-reference_fitness)>1.e-10_wp) error stop 'reported fitness'
      if(maxval(abs(x))>1.e-2_wp .or. objective>1.e-2_wp) error stop 'known global optimum'
      print '(a,i0,a,2f14.9,a,es12.3,a,i0)', 'Seed ',seed,': x=',x,'; objective=',objective, &
         '; evaluations=',evaluations
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-featom-coulomb-spectrum
source:
! Original I1b API driver. MIT: licenses/boundary-spectral-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use types, only: dp
   use schroed_dirac_solver, only: total_energy
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter :: elements=8,degree=20,nq=43
   real(dp) :: alpha_j(-7:6),alpha(-7:6),quadrature(nq,elements),expected,error,maximum_error
   real(dp),allocatable :: energies(:),functions(:,:,:)
   integer :: charge,dofs,n,l,index,checks
   alpha=0; alpha_j=-2
   maximum_error=0; checks=0
   do charge=1,2
      ! Nonrelativistic point-Coulomb branch; energies are in Hartree atomic units.
      call total_energy(charge,100._dp,elements,100._dp,degree,nq,dofs,0,0,137.0359895_dp,0, &
         -7,alpha_j,alpha,energies,functions,quadrature)
      if(dofs<=0 .or. size(energies)<6) error stop 'Coulomb output dimensions'
      if(size(functions,3)<6) error stop 'Coulomb function dimensions'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(energies(:6)))) error stop 'nonfinite Coulomb energies'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(functions(:,:,:6)))) error stop 'nonfinite Coulomb functions'
      print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Nuclear charge: ',charge,'; finite-element degrees of freedom: ',dofs
      do n=1,3
         expected=-real(charge**2,dp)/(2*real(n**2,dp))
         do l=0,n-1
            index=(n-1)*n/2+l+1
            error=abs(energies(index)-expected)
            maximum_error=max(maximum_error,error)
            if(error>1.e-7_dp) error stop 'analytic Coulomb energy'
            print '(a,2i3,a,f20.12,a,es12.3)', 'n,l=',n,l,'; energy=',energies(index),'; error=',error
            checks=checks+1
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if(checks/=12) error stop 'case count'
   print '(a,es14.5)', 'Maximum absolute energy error: ',maximum_error
   print '(a)', 'Only the first six levels per charge are checked; full wavefunction accuracy is not claimed.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS featom-coulomb-spectrum'
end program

name: gams-arpack-poisson-eigenpairs
source:
! Original D4a1 API driver. MIT: licenses/boundary-spectral-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter :: n=20,nev=3,ncv=10,lwork=ncv*(ncv+8)
   integer :: ido,info,iparam(11),ipntr(11),i,j,index,mode,calls
   real(dp) :: resid(n),v(n,ncv),workd(3*n),workl(lwork),eigenvalues(nev),z(n,nev)
   real(dp) :: tol,expected,product(n),exact_vector(n),error,gram(nev,nev),identity(nev,nev)
   logical :: selected(ncv)
   character(2) :: which
   interface
      subroutine dsaupd(ido,bmat,n,which,nev,tol,resid,ncv,v,ldv,iparam,ipntr,workd,workl,lworkl,info)
         import dp
         character :: bmat
         character(2) :: which
         integer :: ido,n,nev,ncv,ldv,lworkl,info,iparam(11),ipntr(11)
         real(dp) :: tol,resid(*),v(ldv,*),workd(*),workl(*)
      end subroutine
      subroutine dseupd(rvec,howmny,selected,d,z,ldz,sigma,bmat,n,which,nev,tol, &
         resid,ncv,v,ldv,iparam,ipntr,workd,workl,lworkl,info)
         import dp
         logical :: rvec,selected(*)
         character :: howmny,bmat
         character(2) :: which
         integer :: ldz,n,nev,ncv,ldv,lworkl,info,iparam(11),ipntr(11)
         real(dp) :: d(*),z(ldz,*),sigma,tol,resid(*),v(ldv,*),workd(*),workl(*)
      end subroutine
   end interface
   identity=0
   do j=1,nev
      identity(j,j)=1
   end do
   do mode=1,2
      which='SM'
      if(mode==2) which='LM'
      ido=0; info=1; calls=0
      resid=[(sin(real(i,dp)),i=1,n)]
      iparam=0; ipntr=0; workd=0; workl=0; v=0; selected=.false.
      iparam(1)=1; iparam(3)=1000; iparam(7)=1
      tol=1.e-11_dp
      do
         call dsaupd(ido,'I',n,which,nev,tol,resid,ncv,v,n,iparam,ipntr,workd,workl,lwork,info)
         if(ido==-1 .or. ido==1) then
            call multiply(workd(ipntr(1):ipntr(1)+n-1),product)
            workd(ipntr(2):ipntr(2)+n-1)=product
            calls=calls+1
         else if(ido==2) then
            workd(ipntr(2):ipntr(2)+n-1)=workd(ipntr(1):ipntr(1)+n-1)
         else
            exit
         end if
         if(calls>10000) error stop 'ARPACK operation budget'
      end do
      if(ido/=99 .or. info/=0 .or. iparam(5)/=nev) error stop 'ARPACK convergence'
      call dseupd(.true.,'A',selected,eigenvalues,z,n,0._dp,'I',n,which,nev,tol, &
         resid,ncv,v,n,iparam,ipntr,workd,workl,lwork,info)
      if(info/=0) error stop 'ARPACK extraction'
      if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(eigenvalues)) .or. .not.all(ieee_is_finite(z))) error stop 'nonfinite eigenpairs'
      print '(a,a)', 'Spectrum selection: ',which
      do j=1,nev
         index=j
         if(mode==2) index=n-nev+j
         expected=4*sin(real(index,dp)*acos(-1._dp)/(2*(n+1)))**2
         call multiply(z(:,j),product)
         error=sqrt(sum((product-eigenvalues(j)*z(:,j))**2))
         if(abs(eigenvalues(j)-expected)>1.e-9_dp .or. error>1.e-9_dp) error stop 'known eigenvalue/residual'
         exact_vector=[(sqrt(2._dp/(n+1))*sin(real(i*index,dp)*acos(-1._dp)/(n+1)),i=1,n)]
         if(abs(abs(dot_product(z(:,j),exact_vector))-1)>1.e-8_dp) error stop 'known eigenvector direction'
         print '(i3,2f22.14,es14.4)',index,eigenvalues(j),expected,error
      end do
      gram=matmul(transpose(z),z)
      if(maxval(abs(gram-identity))>1.e-10_dp) error stop 'eigenvector orthogonality'
      print '(a,i0)', 'Matrix-vector callback count: ',calls
   end do
   print '(a)', 'PASS arpack-poisson-eigenpairs'
contains
   subroutine multiply(x,y)
      real(dp),intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(dp),intent(out) :: y(n)
      y=2*x
      y(2:n)=y(2:n)-x(:n-1)
      y(:n-1)=y(:n-1)-x(2:n)
   end subroutine
end program

name: gams-linalg-poisson-eigenpairs
source:
! Original D4a1 API driver. MIT: licenses/boundary-spectral-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp=>real64
   use linalg_fortran, only: linalg
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter :: n=20
   real(dp) :: a(n,n),vectors(n,n),eigenvalues(n),identity(n,n),gram(n,n),weighted(n,n)
   real(dp) :: expected,product(n),exact_vector(n),residual,maximum_error,reconstruction
   integer :: i,j
   a=0; identity=0
   do i=1,n
      a(i,i)=2
      identity(i,i)=1
      if(i<n) then
         a(i,i+1)=-1
         a(i+1,i)=-1
      end if
   end do
   vectors=a
   call linalg%eigh(vectors,eigenvalues)
   if(.not.all(ieee_is_finite(eigenvalues)) .or. .not.all(ieee_is_finite(vectors))) &
      error stop 'nonfinite dense eigensystem'
   maximum_error=0
   print '(a)', 'Index       Computed eigenvalue        Exact eigenvalue          Residual'
   do j=1,n
      expected=4*sin(real(j,dp)*acos(-1._dp)/(2*(n+1)))**2
      maximum_error=max(maximum_error,abs(eigenvalues(j)-expected))
      product=2*vectors(:,j)
      product(2:n)=product(2:n)-vectors(:n-1,j)
      product(:n-1)=product(:n-1)-vectors(2:n,j)
      residual=sqrt(sum((product-eigenvalues(j)*vectors(:,j))**2))
      if(abs(eigenvalues(j)-expected)>1.e-11_dp .or. residual>1.e-11_dp) error stop 'known dense eigenpair'
      exact_vector=[(sqrt(2._dp/(n+1))*sin(real(i*j,dp)*acos(-1._dp)/(n+1)),i=1,n)]
      if(abs(abs(dot_product(vectors(:,j),exact_vector))-1)>1.e-8_dp) error stop 'known sine eigenvector'
      weighted(:,j)=vectors(:,j)*eigenvalues(j)
      if(j<=3 .or. j>=n-2) print '(i3,2f24.15,es14.4)',j,eigenvalues(j),expected,residual
   end do
   gram=matmul(transpose(vectors),vectors)
   if(maxval(abs(gram-identity))>1.e-11_dp) error stop 'dense eigenvector orthonormality'
   reconstruction=maxval(abs(matmul(weighted,transpose(vectors))-a))
   if(reconstruction>1.e-11_dp) error stop 'dense spectral reconstruction'
   print '(a,2es14.5)', 'All 20 checked; maximum eigenvalue/reconstruction errors: ',maximum_error,reconstruction
   print '(a)', 'Six listed eigenpairs use the same n=20 Dirichlet matrix as the ARPACK driver.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS linalg-poisson-eigenpairs'
end program

name: gams-econ-markov-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/resampling-markov-drivers-MIT.txt.
program markov_reference
   use shared_mod, only: wp
   use dist_mod, only: markov_steady_state, tauchen
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: tol = 1.e-11_wp
   real(wp) :: reset(3,3), expected(3), stationary(3)
   integer :: j
   call two_state(.1_wp, .2_wp)
   call two_state(.7_wp, .6_wp)
   call two_state(.02_wp, .03_wp)
   expected = [.1_wp, .3_wp, .6_wp]
   do j = 1, 3
      reset(:,j) = expected
   end do
   call solve(reset, stationary)
   if (maxval(abs(stationary-expected)) > tol) error stop 'rank-one equilibrium'
   print '(a,3f10.6)', 'Three-state reset equilibrium:', stationary
   call ar1(0._wp, 0._wp, .2_wp)
   call ar1(1.5_wp, .8_wp, .1_wp)
   call ar1(-.7_wp, -.5_wp, .3_wp)
   print '(a)', 'PASS econ-markov-reference'
contains
   subroutine solve(matrix, p)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: matrix(:,:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: p(:)
      integer :: status
      p = 0._wp
      call markov_steady_state(matrix, p, 1.e-14_wp, 10000, status)
      if (status /= 0) error stop 'stationary iteration did not converge'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(p))) error stop 'nonfinite equilibrium'
      if (minval(p) < 0._wp .or. abs(sum(p)-1._wp) > tol) error stop 'invalid stationary probabilities'
      if (maxval(abs(matmul(matrix,p)-p)) > tol) error stop 'stationary equation residual'
   end subroutine solve

   subroutine two_state(a, b)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: a, b
      real(wp) :: matrix(2,2), p(2), exact(2)
      ! Column-stochastic convention: probability flow 1->2 is a, 2->1 is b.
      matrix(:,1) = [1._wp-a, a]
      matrix(:,2) = [b, 1._wp-b]
      exact = [b, a]/(a+b)
      call solve(matrix, p)
      if (maxval(abs(p-exact)) > tol) error stop 'analytic two-state equilibrium'
      print '(a,2f7.3,a,2f10.6)', 'a,b=', a, b, ' equilibrium=', p
   end subroutine two_state

   subroutine ar1(mu, rho, sigma)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: mu, rho, sigma
      integer, parameter :: n = 31
      real(wp), parameter :: width = 3._wp
      real(wp) :: nodes(n), transition(n,n), exact_nodes(n), reference(n,n), p(n)
      real(wp) :: extent, conditional_mean, lower, upper, step, probability_error
      integer :: i, k
      call tauchen(n, mu, rho, sigma, width, nodes, transition)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(nodes))) error stop 'nonfinite AR nodes'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(transition))) error stop 'nonfinite AR probabilities'
      extent = width*sigma/sqrt(1._wp-rho*rho)
      do k = 1, n
         exact_nodes(k) = mu + extent*(real(2*(k-1),wp)/(n-1)-1._wp)
      end do
      if (maxval(abs(nodes-exact_nodes)) > tol) error stop 'AR grid endpoints and spacing'
      ! Integrate the conditional normal density over midpoint cells, including tails.
      do i = 1, n
         conditional_mean = mu + rho*(exact_nodes(i)-mu)
         do k = 1, n
            lower = 0._wp
            upper = 1._wp
            if (k > 1) then
               step = (exact_nodes(k-1)+exact_nodes(k))/2._wp
               lower = .5_wp*(1._wp+erf((step-conditional_mean)/(sqrt(2._wp)*sigma)))
            end if
            if (k < n) then
               step = (exact_nodes(k)+exact_nodes(k+1))/2._wp
               upper = .5_wp*(1._wp+erf((step-conditional_mean)/(sqrt(2._wp)*sigma)))
            end if
            reference(i,k) = upper-lower
         end do
      end do
      probability_error = maxval(abs(transition-reference))
      if (probability_error > tol) error stop 'independent normal cell probabilities'
      if (minval(transition) < 0._wp) error stop 'negative transition probability'
      if (maxval(abs(sum(transition,dim=2)-1._wp)) > tol) error stop 'transition rows must sum to one'
      ! tauchen returns ROW probabilities; steady_state expects COLUMN probabilities.
      call solve(transpose(transition), p)
      if (abs(dot_product(p,nodes)-mu) > tol) error stop 'symmetric AR stationary mean'
      if (rho == 0._wp) then
         if (maxval(abs(p-reference(1,:))) > tol) error stop 'independent identically distributed equilibrium'
      end if
      print '(a,f5.2,a,f6.2,a,es10.2)', 'AR rho=', rho, ' mean=', dot_product(p,nodes), &
         ' maximum probability error=', probability_error
   end subroutine ar1
end program markov_reference

name: gams-fjsample-jackknife-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; see licenses/resampling-markov-drivers-MIT.txt.
program jackknife_reference
   use FJsample, only: WP, Complement, jackError
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(WP), parameter :: tol = 1.e-11_WP
   call check([1._WP, 3._WP])
   call check([1._WP, 2._WP, 4._WP, 5._WP, 8._WP, 10._WP])
   call check([7._WP, 7._WP, 7._WP, 7._WP])
   call check([-1._WP, -3._WP, -7._WP, -9._WP, -15._WP, -19._WP])
   call check([-4._WP, -3._WP, -2._WP, -1._WP, 1._WP, 2._WP, 3._WP, 4._WP])
   print '(a)', 'PASS fjsample-jackknife-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(data)
      real(WP), intent(in) :: data(:)
      real(WP) :: jack(0:size(data)), reference(size(data)), nonlinear(0:size(data))
      real(WP) :: mean, variance, se, bias, se_ref, bias_ref, total, average, err
      integer :: n, i, j
      n = size(data)
      mean = 0._WP
      do i = 1, n
         mean = mean + data(i)/n
         total = 0._WP
         do j = 1, n
            if (j /= i) total = total + data(j)
         end do
         reference(i) = total/(n-1)
      end do
      variance = 0._WP
      do i = 1, n
         variance = variance + (data(i)-mean)**2/(n-1)
      end do
      call Complement(jack(0), data)
      call Complement(n, jack(1:), data)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(jack))) error stop 'nonfinite complement'
      err = max(abs(jack(0)-mean), maxval(abs(jack(1:)-reference)))
      if (err > tol) error stop 'independent leave-one-out means'
      call jackError(n, jack, se, bias)
      se_ref = sqrt(variance/n)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite([se, bias]))) error stop 'nonfinite mean uncertainty'
      if (abs(se-se_ref) > tol .or. abs(bias) > tol) error stop 'sample mean standard error or bias'
      print '(a,i2,a,f9.4,a,f10.6)', 'n=', n, ' mean=', mean, ' standard error=', se

      ! A nonlinear estimator: square the sample mean and each resampled mean.
      nonlinear = jack**2
      call jackError(n, nonlinear, se, bias)
      average = 0._WP
      do i = 1, n
         average = average + reference(i)**2/n
      end do
      total = 0._WP
      do i = 1, n
         total = total + (reference(i)**2-average)**2
      end do
      se_ref = sqrt(real(n-1, WP)/n*total)
      ! Package bias is full estimate minus mean resampled estimate, without (n-1).
      ! For this estimator it equals -sample_variance/(n*(n-1)).
      bias_ref = -variance/(real(n, WP)*(n-1))
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite([se, bias]))) error stop 'nonfinite nonlinear uncertainty'
      if (abs(se-se_ref) > tol .or. abs(bias-bias_ref) > tol) error stop 'squared mean uncertainty or bias'
      print '(a,f11.6,a,f11.6)', '  squared mean standard error=', se, ' package bias=', bias
   end subroutine check
end program jackknife_reference

name: gams-fsparse-storage-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/storage-fourier-geometry-drivers-MIT.txt.
program storage_reference
   use fsparse, only: COO_dp, CSR_dp, dense2coo, coo2dense, coo2csr, csr2coo
   use fsparse_constants, only: dp
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(dp) :: a(5,4), zero(3,2), full(2,3), scalar(1,1)
   integer :: i, j
   a = 0._dp
   a(2,1) = -2._dp
   a(2,4) = .5_dp
   a(4,2) = 3._dp
   a(4,4) = -4._dp
   zero = 0._dp
   do j = 1, 3
      do i = 1, 2
         full(i,j) = real(2*i+3*j,dp)/2
      end do
   end do
   scalar = -7._dp
   call check(a)
   call check(transpose(a))
   call check(zero)
   call check(full)
   call check(scalar)
   print '(a)', 'PASS fsparse-storage-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(dense)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: dense(:,:)
      type(COO_dp) :: coo, returned
      type(CSR_dp) :: csr
      real(dp) :: reconstructed(size(dense,1),size(dense,2)), restored(size(dense,1),size(dense,2))
      integer :: i, j, k, entry, nonzeros, expected_ptr(size(dense,1)+1)
      ! Fixtures use exact moderate dyadic values: no threshold or subnormal cases.
      nonzeros = count(dense /= 0._dp)
      call dense2coo(dense,coo)
      call check_coo(coo,dense)
      call coo2csr(coo,csr)
      if (csr%nrows /= size(dense,1) .or. csr%ncols /= size(dense,2)) error stop 'CSR dimensions'
      if (csr%nnz /= nonzeros .or. csr%base /= 1) error stop 'CSR count or base'
      if (size(csr%rowptr) /= size(dense,1)+1) error stop 'CSR row pointer length'
      if (size(csr%col) /= nonzeros .or. size(csr%data) /= nonzeros) error stop 'CSR array lengths'
      expected_ptr(1) = 1
      do i = 1, size(dense,1)
         expected_ptr(i+1) = expected_ptr(i)+count(dense(i,:) /= 0._dp)
      end do
      if (any(csr%rowptr /= expected_ptr)) error stop 'independent CSR row counts'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(csr%data))) error stop 'nonfinite CSR data'
      reconstructed = 0._dp
      k = 0
      do i = 1, size(dense,1)
         do j = 1, size(dense,2)
            if (dense(i,j) == 0._dp) cycle
            k = k+1
            if (csr%col(k) /= j .or. csr%data(k) /= dense(i,j)) error stop 'CSR column/value reference'
         end do
         do entry = csr%rowptr(i), csr%rowptr(i+1)-1
            j = csr%col(entry)
            if (j < 1 .or. j > size(dense,2)) error stop 'CSR column range'
            reconstructed(i,j) = csr%data(entry)
         end do
      end do
      if (any(reconstructed /= dense)) error stop 'independent CSR reconstruction'
      call csr2coo(csr,returned)
      call check_coo(returned,dense)
      ! coo2dense writes stored entries only; callers must initialize omitted zeros.
      restored = 0._dp
      call coo2dense(coo,restored)
      if (any(restored /= dense)) error stop 'COO dense restoration'
      restored = 0._dp
      call coo2dense(returned,restored)
      if (any(restored /= dense)) error stop 'CSR to COO dense restoration'
      print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,i0)', 'Dense/COO/CSR checked: ',size(dense,1),' x ',size(dense,2),' nnz=',nonzeros
   end subroutine check

   subroutine check_coo(coo,dense)
      type(COO_dp), intent(in) :: coo
      real(dp), intent(in) :: dense(:,:)
      integer :: i, j, k, nonzeros
      nonzeros = count(dense /= 0._dp)
      if (coo%nrows /= size(dense,1) .or. coo%ncols /= size(dense,2)) error stop 'COO dimensions'
      if (coo%nnz /= nonzeros .or. coo%base /= 1) error stop 'COO count or base'
      if (any(shape(coo%index) /= [2,nonzeros])) error stop 'COO coordinate shape'
      if (size(coo%data) /= nonzeros) error stop 'COO value count'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(coo%data))) error stop 'nonfinite COO data'
      k = 0
      do i = 1, size(dense,1)
         do j = 1, size(dense,2)
            if (dense(i,j) == 0._dp) cycle
            k = k+1
            if (any(coo%index(:,k) /= [i,j])) error stop 'independent COO coordinates'
            if (coo%data(k) /= dense(i,j)) error stop 'independent COO value'
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine check_coo
end program storage_reference

name: gams-spectrum-real-dft-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/storage-fourier-geometry-drivers-MIT.txt.
program real_dft_reference
   use spectrum, only: rfft
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dp = real64, lengths(*) = [3,4,5,6,7,8,11,12,15,16]
   real(dp), parameter :: pi = acos(-1._dp), tol = 1.e-11_dp
   real(dp), allocatable :: x(:), adjusted(:)
   complex(dp), allocatable :: actual(:)
   integer :: l, n, i, mode, calls
   calls = 0
   do l = 1, size(lengths)
      n = lengths(l)
      allocate(x(n))
      do mode = 1, 4
         do i = 1, n
            select case(mode)
            case(1)
               x(i) = 0._dp
               if (i == 2) x(i) = 1._dp
            case(2)
               x(i) = 2._dp
            case(3)
               x(i) = real(mod(7*i,11)-5,dp)/4
            case(4)
               x(i) = 1._dp + 2*cos(2*pi*(i-1)/n) - .5_dp*sin(2*pi*(i-1)/n)
            end select
         end do
         actual = rfft(x)
         call check(x,actual)
         calls = calls+1
      end do
      print '(a,i0,a)', 'Four signals checked at length ',n,' (direct DFT and Parseval)'
      deallocate(x)
   end do
   x = [1._dp,-2._dp,3._dp,.5_dp,4._dp]
   adjusted = [x,0._dp,0._dp,0._dp]
   actual = rfft(x,8)
   call check(adjusted,actual)
   actual = rfft(x,3)
   call check(x(:3),actual)
   calls = calls+2
   if (calls /= 42) error stop 'transform count'
   print '(a)', '42 forward real transforms checked, including explicit zero padding and truncation.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS spectrum-real-dft-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(signal,transform)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: signal(:)
      complex(dp), intent(in) :: transform(:)
      real(dp) :: re, im, angle, energy, reference_energy, scale
      integer :: n, k, j, weight
      n = size(signal)
      if (size(transform) /= n/2+1) error stop 'real half-spectrum length'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(real(transform,dp)))) error stop 'nonfinite DFT real part'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(transform)))) error stop 'nonfinite DFT imaginary part'
      scale = max(1._dp,sum(abs(signal)))
      energy = 0._dp
      do k = 0, n/2
         re = 0._dp
         im = 0._dp
         do j = 0, n-1
            angle = 2*pi*real(k*j,dp)/n
            re = re+signal(j+1)*cos(angle)
            im = im-signal(j+1)*sin(angle)
         end do
         if (abs(transform(k+1)-cmplx(re,im,dp))/scale > tol) error stop 'independent Fourier sum'
         weight = 2
         if (k == 0 .or. (mod(n,2) == 0 .and. k == n/2)) weight = 1
         energy = energy+weight*abs(transform(k+1))**2/n
      end do
      reference_energy = sum(signal**2)
      if (abs(energy-reference_energy)/max(1._dp,reference_energy) > tol) error stop 'Parseval energy'
      if (abs(aimag(transform(1))) > tol) error stop 'imaginary DC term'
      if (mod(n,2) == 0) then
         if (abs(aimag(transform(size(transform)))) > tol) error stop 'imaginary Nyquist term'
      end if
   end subroutine check
end program real_dft_reference

name: gams-geodesic-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/storage-fourier-geometry-drivers-MIT.txt.
program geodesic_reference
   use geodesic_module, only: inverse, direct, wp => geodesic_wp
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: pi = acos(-1._wp), rad = pi/180, a = 6378137._wp
   real(wp), parameter :: flattening = 1._wp/298.257223563_wp
   real(wp), parameter :: distance_tol = 1.e-6_wp, angle_tol = 1.e-9_wp
   call sphere(10._wp,20._wp,45._wp,80._wp)
   call sphere(-30._wp,170._wp,20._wp,-175._wp)
   call sphere(80._wp,-40._wp,75._wp,130._wp)
   call sphere(-60._wp,-80._wp,-20._wp,100._wp)
   call sphere(0._wp,0._wp,0._wp,90._wp)
   call sphere(35._wp,-120._wp,-12._wp,-60._wp)
   call equator(0._wp,90._wp)
   call equator(170._wp,190._wp)
   call equator(-20._wp,-80._wp)
   call meridian(-40._wp,20._wp)
   call meridian(30._wp,70._wp)
   call meridian(80._wp,85._wp)
   print '(a)', 'PASS geodesic-reference'
contains
   real(wp) function angular_error(x,y)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x,y
      angular_error = abs(modulo(x-y+180._wp,360._wp)-180._wp)
   end function angular_error

   subroutine compare(lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2,f,expected_distance,expected_azimuth)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2,f,expected_distance,expected_azimuth
      real(wp) :: distance, azi1, azi2, arc, reduced, scale12, scale21, area
      real(wp) :: endpoint_lat, endpoint_lon, final_bearing
      call inverse(a,f,lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2,distance,azi1,azi2,0,arc,reduced,scale12,scale21,area)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite([distance,azi1,azi2]))) error stop 'nonfinite inverse geodesic'
      if (abs(distance-expected_distance) > distance_tol) error stop 'independent geodesic distance'
      if (angular_error(azi1,expected_azimuth) > angle_tol) error stop 'independent initial bearing'
      ! The direct solve uses independent distance and bearing, not inverse outputs.
      call direct(a,f,lat1,lon1,expected_azimuth,expected_distance,0,endpoint_lat,endpoint_lon, &
         final_bearing,0,arc,reduced,scale12,scale21,area)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite([endpoint_lat,endpoint_lon,final_bearing]))) error stop 'nonfinite direct geodesic'
      if (abs(endpoint_lat-lat2) > angle_tol) error stop 'independent endpoint latitude'
      if (angular_error(endpoint_lon,lon2) > angle_tol) error stop 'independent endpoint longitude'
      print '(a,f18.6,a,es9.1)', 'Distance (m): ',distance,' reference error: ',abs(distance-expected_distance)
   end subroutine compare

   subroutine sphere(lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2
      real(wp) :: p,q,d,h,distance,bearing
      p = rad*lat1
      q = rad*lat2
      d = rad*(lon2-lon1)
      h = sin((q-p)/2)**2+cos(p)*cos(q)*sin(d/2)**2
      distance = 2*a*atan2(sqrt(h),sqrt(1._wp-h))
      bearing = atan2(sin(d)*cos(q),cos(p)*sin(q)-sin(p)*cos(q)*cos(d))/rad
      call compare(lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2,0._wp,distance,bearing)
   end subroutine sphere

   subroutine equator(lon1,lon2)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: lon1,lon2
      real(wp) :: delta
      delta = modulo(lon2-lon1+180._wp,360._wp)-180._wp
      call compare(0._wp,lon1,0._wp,lon2,flattening,a*abs(delta)*rad,sign(90._wp,delta))
   end subroutine equator

   subroutine meridian(lat1,lat2)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: lat1,lat2
      real(wp) :: coarse,fine
      coarse = meridian_integral(lat1,lat2,2048)
      fine = meridian_integral(lat1,lat2,4096)
      if (abs(coarse-fine) > distance_tol/10) error stop 'meridional quadrature refinement'
      call compare(lat1,35._wp,lat2,35._wp,flattening,fine,0._wp)
   end subroutine meridian

   real(wp) function meridian_integral(lat1,lat2,panels) result(distance)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: lat1,lat2
      integer, intent(in) :: panels
      real(wp) :: step,e2,latitude,total,term
      integer :: i,weight
      step = (lat2-lat1)*rad/panels
      e2 = flattening*(2-flattening)
      total = 0._wp
      do i = 0,panels
         latitude = lat1*rad+i*step
         term = a*(1-e2)/(1-e2*sin(latitude)**2)**1.5_wp
         weight = 2
         if (mod(i,2) == 1) weight = 4
         if (i == 0 .or. i == panels) weight = 1
         total = total+weight*term
      end do
      distance = total*step/3
   end function meridian_integral
end program geodesic_reference

name: gams-y12m-sparse-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/sparse-integral-drivers-MIT.txt.
program sparse_reference
   use y12m, only: y12mb, y12mc, y12md
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n = 10
   real(wp) :: matrix(n,n), permuted(n,n)
   integer :: i
   matrix = 0._wp
   do i = 1,n
      matrix(i,i) = 4._wp+real(i,wp)/4
      if (i < n) then
         matrix(i,i+1) = -.5_wp
         matrix(i+1,i) = -1.25_wp
      end if
   end do
   matrix(1,n) = -.75_wp
   matrix(n,1) = .25_wp
   call check(matrix,1)
   ! A cyclic row permutation removes most diagonal pivots without changing the solution.
   do i = 1,n
      permuted(i,:) = matrix(mod(i,n)+1,:)
   end do
   call check(permuted,2)
   print '(a)', 'PASS y12m-sparse-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(original,case_number)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: original(n,n)
      integer, intent(in) :: case_number
      integer, parameter :: capacity = 1000
      real(wp) :: entries(capacity), pivot(n), rhs(n), b(n), exact(n), flags(8)
      real(wp) :: solution_error, backward_error, residual, denominator, row_norm
      integer :: columns(capacity), rows(capacity), ha(n,11), iflag(10), status, nz, i, j, load
      entries = 0._wp
      rows = 0
      columns = 0
      ha = 0
      nz = 0
      do i = 1,n
         do j = 1,n
            if (original(i,j) == 0._wp) cycle
            nz = nz+1
            entries(nz) = original(i,j)
            rows(nz) = i
            columns(nz) = j
         end do
      end do
      iflag = 0
      flags = 0._wp
      iflag(2:5) = [3,1,0,2]
      flags(1:4) = [16._wp,1.e-12_wp,1.e16_wp,1.e-12_wp]
      call y12mb(n,nz,entries,columns,capacity,rows,capacity,ha,n,flags,iflag,status)
      if (status /= 0) error stop 'sparse preparation status'
      do load = 1,4
