         select case(load)
         case(1)
            exact = 1._wp
         case(2)
            exact = [(real((-1)**i*i,wp)/4,i=1,n)]
         case(3)
            exact = 0._wp
         case(4)
            exact = 0._wp
            exact(4) = 1._wp
         end select
         ! Preserve original A and form each manufactured RHS independently of sparse routines.
         rhs = 0._wp
         row_norm = 0._wp
         do i = 1,n
            do j = 1,n
               rhs(i) = rhs(i)+original(i,j)*exact(j)
            end do
            row_norm = max(row_norm,sum(abs(original(i,:))))
         end do
         b = rhs
         if (load == 1) then
            call y12mc(n,nz,entries,columns,capacity,rows,capacity,pivot,b,ha,n,flags,iflag,status)
            if (status /= 0) error stop 'sparse factorization status'
         else
            iflag(5) = 3
         end if
         call y12md(n,entries,capacity,b,pivot,columns,ha,n,iflag,status)
         if (status /= 0) error stop 'sparse substitution status'
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(b))) error stop 'nonfinite sparse solution'
         solution_error = maxval(abs(b-exact))/max(1._wp,maxval(abs(exact)))
         backward_error = 0._wp
         do i = 1,n
            residual = -rhs(i)
            do j = 1,n
               residual = residual+original(i,j)*b(j)
            end do
            backward_error = max(backward_error,abs(residual))
         end do
         denominator = row_norm*maxval(abs(b))+maxval(abs(rhs))
         backward_error = backward_error/max(1._wp,denominator)
         if (solution_error > 1.e-11_wp) error stop 'known sparse solution'
         if (backward_error > 1.e-12_wp) error stop 'sparse backward error'
         print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,es10.2,a,es10.2)', 'Matrix ',case_number,', RHS ',load, &
            ' solution error=',solution_error,' backward error=',backward_error
      end do
      print '(a)', 'One sparse LU factorization reused for four right-hand sides.'
   end subroutine check
end program sparse_reference

name: gams-fitpack-spline-integral
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/sparse-integral-drivers-MIT.txt.
program spline_integral
   use fitpack, only: fitpack_curve, FP_REAL, FP_FLAG, FITPACK_SUCCESS
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: wp = FP_REAL, n = 9
   type(fitpack_curve) :: curve
   real(wp), parameter :: x(n) = [-2._wp,-1.7_wp,-1._wp,-.25_wp,0._wp,.4_wp,1._wp,1.6_wp,2._wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: bounds(2,6) = reshape([-2._wp,2._wp, -.7_wp,1.3_wp, -2._wp,-.25_wp, &
      .4_wp,2._wp, 1.3_wp,-.7_wp, .2_wp,.2_wp],[2,6])
   real(wp) :: y(n),actual,expected,left,right,total,query,value,error
   integer(FP_FLAG) :: status
   integer :: degree,i,k,checks
   checks = 0
   do degree = 0,3
      y = x**degree
      status = curve%new_fit(x,y,smoothing=0._wp)
      if (.not. FITPACK_SUCCESS(status)) error stop 'interpolating spline fit status'
      ! A cubic interpolant must reproduce these polynomials, including off-grid points.
      do i = 0,16
         query = -2._wp+real(i,wp)/4
         value = curve%eval(query,status)
         if (.not. FITPACK_SUCCESS(status)) error stop 'spline evaluation status'
         if (.not. ieee_is_finite(value)) error stop 'nonfinite spline value'
         if (abs(value-query**degree) > 1.e-11_wp) error stop 'polynomial reproduction'
      end do
      error = 0._wp
      do k = 1,size(bounds,2)
         actual = curve%integral(bounds(1,k),bounds(2,k))
         expected = primitive(bounds(2,k),degree)-primitive(bounds(1,k),degree)
         if (.not. ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'nonfinite spline integral'
         error = max(error,abs(actual-expected))
         if (abs(actual-expected) > 1.e-11_wp) error stop 'analytic polynomial integral'
         checks = checks+1
      end do
      left = curve%integral(-2._wp,.15_wp)
      right = curve%integral(.15_wp,2._wp)
      total = curve%integral(-2._wp,2._wp)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite([left,right,total]))) error stop 'nonfinite partition integrals'
      if (abs(left-(primitive(.15_wp,degree)-primitive(-2._wp,degree))) > 1.e-11_wp) &
         error stop 'left partition antiderivative'
      if (abs(right-(primitive(2._wp,degree)-primitive(.15_wp,degree))) > 1.e-11_wp) &
         error stop 'right partition antiderivative'
      if (abs(left+right-total) > 1.e-11_wp) error stop 'integral additivity'
      checks = checks+3
      print '(a,i0,a,es10.2)', 'Polynomial degree ',degree,' maximum integral error=',error
      call curve%destroy()
   end do
   if (checks /= 36) error stop 'integral check count'
   print '(a)', '36 integrals checked, including reversed/zero intervals and off-knot partition additivity.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fitpack-spline-integral'
contains
   real(wp) function primitive(t,degree)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: t
      integer, intent(in) :: degree
      primitive = t**(degree+1)/real(degree+1,wp)
   end function primitive
end program spline_integral

name: gams-kdtree-neighbor-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/spatial-nufft-drivers-MIT.txt.
program neighbor_reference
   use kdtree2_precision_module, only: kdkind
   use kdtree2_module, only: kdtree2, kdtree2_result, kdtree2_create, kdtree2_destroy, &
      kdtree2_n_nearest, kdtree2_r_nearest
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n = 48, counts(*) = [1,5,n], dp = real64
   real(kdkind), target :: points(3,n)
   real(kdkind) :: queries(3,3), radius2(3)
   real(dp) :: distances(n), sorted(n), difference, temp
   type(kdtree2), pointer :: tree
   type(kdtree2_result) :: nearest(n), within(n)
   logical :: seen(n), rearrange
   integer :: i,j,d,q,mode,c,k,r,found,index,calls
   do i = 1,n
      points(:,i) = real([mod(7*i,53),mod(11*i,59),mod(13*i,61)],kdkind)/64
   end do
   queries(:,1) = [13._kdkind,29._kdkind,41._kdkind]/64
   queries(:,2) = 0._kdkind
   queries(:,3) = points(:,17)
   radius2 = [0._kdkind,.125_kdkind,4._kdkind]
   calls = 0
   do mode = 0,1
      rearrange = mode == 1
      tree => kdtree2_create(points,sort=.true.,rearrange=rearrange)
      if (.not. associated(tree)) error stop 'tree allocation'
      do q = 1,3
         distances = 0._dp
         do i = 1,n
            do d = 1,3
               difference = real(points(d,i),dp)-real(queries(d,q),dp)
               distances(i) = distances(i)+difference*difference
            end do
         end do
         ! Independent insertion sort of exhaustive squared distances; tied indexes may differ.
         sorted = distances
         do i = 2,n
            temp = sorted(i)
            j = i-1
            do while (j >= 1)
               if (sorted(j) <= temp) exit
               sorted(j+1) = sorted(j)
               j = j-1
            end do
            sorted(j+1) = temp
         end do
         do c = 1,size(counts)
            k = counts(c)
            call kdtree2_n_nearest(tree,queries(:,q),k,nearest(:k))
            seen = .false.
            do i = 1,k
               index = nearest(i)%idx
               if (index < 1 .or. index > n) error stop 'nearest index range'
               if (seen(index)) error stop 'duplicate nearest index'
               seen(index) = .true.
               if (.not. ieee_is_finite(nearest(i)%dis)) error stop 'nonfinite nearest distance'
               if (abs(real(nearest(i)%dis,dp)-distances(index)) > 1.e-6_dp) error stop 'distance reference'
               if (abs(distances(index)-sorted(i)) > 1.e-6_dp) error stop 'exhaustive nearest ordering'
            end do
            calls = calls+1
         end do
         do r = 1,size(radius2)
            call kdtree2_r_nearest(tree,queries(:,q),radius2(r),found,n,within)
            if (found < 0 .or. found > n) error stop 'radius result count range'
            if (found /= count(distances <= real(radius2(r),dp))) error stop 'exhaustive radius count'
            seen = .false.
            do i = 1,found
               index = within(i)%idx
               if (index < 1 .or. index > n) error stop 'radius index range'
               if (seen(index)) error stop 'duplicate radius index'
               seen(index) = .true.
               if (distances(index) > real(radius2(r),dp)) error stop 'radius membership'
               if (.not. ieee_is_finite(within(i)%dis)) error stop 'nonfinite radius distance'
               if (abs(real(within(i)%dis,dp)-distances(index)) > 1.e-6_dp) error stop 'radius distance'
            end do
            if (any(seen .neqv. (distances <= real(radius2(r),dp)))) error stop 'complete radius set'
            calls = calls+1
         end do
         print '(a,l1,a,i0,a)', 'Rearrange=',rearrange,', query ',q,': nearest and complete radius sets checked.'
      end do
      call kdtree2_destroy(tree)
   end do
   if (calls /= 36) error stop 'search count'
   print '(a)', '36 searches checked against exhaustive real64 distances; upstream tree uses single precision.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS kdtree-neighbor-reference'
end program neighbor_reference

name: gams-delaunay-affine-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/spatial-nufft-drivers-MIT.txt.
program affine_reference
   use delsparse_mod, only: R8, delaunaysparses
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n = 10, m = 6
   real(R8), parameter :: tol = 1.e-10_R8
   real(R8) :: points(3,n),original(3,n),queries(3,m),saved_queries(3,m),data(3,n),result(3,m)
   real(R8) :: weights(4,m),coeff(4),reconstructed(3),expected(3),a(3),b(3),c(3),volume
   integer :: simplices(4,m),status(m),i,j,k,l
   points(:,1) = [0._R8,0._R8,0._R8]
   points(:,2) = [2._R8,0._R8,0._R8]
   points(:,3) = [.2_R8,1.5_R8,0._R8]
   points(:,4) = [.1_R8,.3_R8,1.7_R8]
   do i = 5,n
      coeff = [real(i-3,R8),real(mod(i,3)+1,R8),real(mod(i+1,4)+1,R8),3._R8]
      coeff = coeff/sum(coeff)
      points(:,i) = matmul(points(:,:4),coeff)
   end do
   do i = 1,m
      coeff = [real(2*i+1,R8),real(i+4,R8),real(2*i+3,R8),real(3*i+2,R8)]
      coeff = coeff/sum(coeff)
      queries(:,i) = matmul(points(:,:4),coeff)
   end do
   original = points
   saved_queries = queries
   do i = 1,n
      data(:,i) = fields(points(:,i))
   end do
   ! This routine rescales its coordinates in place; references use preserved originals.
   call delaunaysparses(3,n,points,m,queries,simplices,weights,status,interp_in=data,interp_out=result)
   if (any(status /= 0)) error stop 'scattered interpolation status'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(weights))) error stop 'nonfinite barycentric weights'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(result))) error stop 'nonfinite interpolated values'
   do i = 1,m
      if (abs(sum(weights(:,i))-1._R8) > tol) error stop 'partition of unity'
      if (minval(weights(:,i)) < -tol) error stop 'outside returned simplex'
      reconstructed = 0._R8
      expected = 0._R8
      do j = 1,4
         k = simplices(j,i)
         if (k < 1 .or. k > n) error stop 'simplex index range'
         do l = 1,j-1
            if (simplices(l,i) == k) error stop 'duplicate simplex vertex'
         end do
         reconstructed = reconstructed+weights(j,i)*original(:,k)
         expected = expected+weights(j,i)*fields(original(:,k))
      end do
      a = original(:,simplices(2,i))-original(:,simplices(1,i))
      b = original(:,simplices(3,i))-original(:,simplices(1,i))
      c = original(:,simplices(4,i))-original(:,simplices(1,i))
      volume = a(1)*(b(2)*c(3)-b(3)*c(2))-a(2)*(b(1)*c(3)-b(3)*c(1)) &
         +a(3)*(b(1)*c(2)-b(2)*c(1))
      if (abs(volume) < tol) error stop 'degenerate returned tetrahedron'
      if (maxval(abs(reconstructed-saved_queries(:,i))) > tol) error stop 'barycentric query reconstruction'
      if (maxval(abs(result(:,i)-expected)) > tol) error stop 'scalar weighted field reference'
      expected = fields(saved_queries(:,i))
      if (maxval(abs(result(:2,i)-expected(:2))) > tol) error stop 'exact constant and affine reproduction'
      print '(a,i0,a,f10.6,a,f10.6)', 'Query ',i,': affine=',result(2,i), &
         ' piecewise linear squared radius=',result(3,i)
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Six 3D queries checked: affine reproduction, simplex geometry, and three-channel weighted interpolation.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS delaunay-affine-reference'
contains
   function fields(x) result(y)
      real(R8), intent(in) :: x(3)
      real(R8) :: y(3)
      y = [1._R8,2*x(1)-3*x(2)+.5_R8*x(3)+1._R8,sum(x*x)]
   end function fields
end program affine_reference

name: gams-nufft1d-sum-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/spatial-nufft-drivers-MIT.txt.
program nonuniform_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dp = real64, n = 80, mode_counts(*) = [15,16,31,32]
   real(dp), parameter :: pi = acos(-1._dp), requested = 1.e-10_dp
   real(dp) :: nodes(n),angle,re,im,scale,error
   complex(dp) :: strengths(n),reference
   complex(dp), allocatable :: transform(:)
   integer :: i,j,k,sign,m,case_number,pattern,calls
   interface
      subroutine nufft1d1f90(nj,xj,cj,iflag,eps,ms,fk,ier)
         import dp
         integer :: nj,iflag,ms,ier
         real(dp) :: xj(nj),eps
         complex(dp) :: cj(nj),fk(-ms/2:(ms-1)/2)
      end subroutine nufft1d1f90
   end interface
   block
      integer :: status
      do i = 1,n
         nodes(i) = pi*sin(.37_dp*i)+.01_dp*cos(.11_dp*i)
      end do
      ! Keep every source strictly inside the documented interval [-pi,pi].
      nodes = .95_dp*nodes
      calls = 0
      do case_number = 1,size(mode_counts)
         m = mode_counts(case_number)
         allocate(transform(-m/2:(m-1)/2))
         do pattern = 1,3
            strengths = cmplx(0._dp,0._dp,dp)
            select case(pattern)
            case(1)
               strengths(7) = cmplx(2._dp,-.5_dp,dp)
            case(2)
               strengths = cmplx(1._dp,0._dp,dp)
            case(3)
               do i = 1,n
                  strengths(i) = cmplx(real(mod(7*i,19)-9,dp)/8,real(mod(11*i,23)-11,dp)/8,dp)
               end do
            end select
            scale = max(1._dp,sum(abs(strengths))/n)
            do sign = -1,1,2
               call nufft1d1f90(n,nodes,strengths,sign,requested,m,transform,status)
               if (status /= 0) error stop 'NUFFT status'
               if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(real(transform,dp)))) error stop 'nonfinite NUFFT real output'
               if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(transform)))) error stop 'nonfinite NUFFT imaginary output'
               error = 0._dp
               do k = -m/2,(m-1)/2
                  re = 0._dp
                  im = 0._dp
                  do j = 1,n
                     angle = real(sign*k,dp)*nodes(j)
                     re = re+real(strengths(j),dp)*cos(angle)-aimag(strengths(j))*sin(angle)
                     im = im+real(strengths(j),dp)*sin(angle)+aimag(strengths(j))*cos(angle)
                  end do
                  reference = cmplx(re/n,im/n,dp)
                  error = max(error,abs(transform(k)-reference)/scale)
               end do
               if (error > 1.e-8_dp) error stop 'direct nonuniform Fourier sum'
               if (abs(transform(0)-sum(strengths)/n)/scale > 1.e-8_dp) error stop 'zero mode normalization'
               calls = calls+1
               print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,i2,a,es10.2)', 'Modes=',m,' signal=',pattern,' sign=',sign,' scaled error=',error
            end do
         end do
         deallocate(transform)
      end do
      if (calls /= 24) error stop 'NUFFT case count'
   end block
   print '(a)', '24 type-1 transforms checked against scalar Fourier sums, including odd/even mode counts and both signs.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS nufft1d-sum-reference'
end program nonuniform_reference

name: gams-fishpack-helmholtz-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/pde-drivers-MIT.txt.
program helmholtz_reference
   use fishpack, only: wp, ip, hwscrt
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp), parameter :: shifts(*) = [0._wp,-.75_wp], pi = acos(-1._wp)
   real(wp) :: error, previous, ratio
   integer :: problem, refinement
   do problem = 1,size(shifts)
      previous = 0._wp
      do refinement = 0,2
         call check(16_ip*2**refinement,12_ip*2**refinement,shifts(problem),error)
         if (refinement > 0) then
            ratio = previous/error
            if (.not. ieee_is_finite(ratio)) error stop 'nonfinite refinement ratio'
            if (ratio < 3.8_wp .or. ratio > 4.2_wp) error stop 'second-order mesh refinement'
         end if
         previous = error
      end do
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Six nonzero-Dirichlet Poisson/Helmholtz solves checked against exact discrete solutions.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fishpack-helmholtz-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(m,n,lambda,continuous_error)
      integer(ip), intent(in) :: m,n
      real(wp), intent(in) :: lambda
      real(wp), intent(out) :: continuous_error
      real(wp) :: solution(m+1,n+1), forcing(m+1,n+1), continuous(m+1,n+1), discrete(m+1,n+1)
      real(wp) :: dummy(1), perturbation, x,y,affine,wave,hx,hy,mu_continuous,mu_discrete,factor
      real(wp) :: solver_error,residual,term,boundary_error
      integer(ip) :: i,j,status
      hx = 2._wp/m
      hy = 2._wp/n
      mu_continuous = -(pi/2)**2-pi**2
      mu_discrete = -4*sin(pi/(2*m))**2/hx**2-4*sin(pi/n)**2/hy**2
      factor = (mu_continuous+lambda)/(mu_discrete+lambda)
      forcing = 0._wp
      do j = 1,n+1
         y = -1._wp+(j-1)*hy
         do i = 1,m+1
            x = (i-1)*hx
            affine = 1._wp+.5_wp*x-.25_wp*y
            wave = sin(pi*x/2)*sin(pi*(y+1._wp))
            continuous(i,j) = affine+wave
            discrete(i,j) = affine+factor*wave
            forcing(i,j) = lambda*affine+(mu_continuous+lambda)*wave
            if (i == 1 .or. i == m+1 .or. j == 1 .or. j == n+1) then
               solution(i,j) = affine
            else
               solution(i,j) = forcing(i,j)
            end if
         end do
      end do
      dummy = 0._wp
      call hwscrt(0._wp,2._wp,m,1_ip,dummy,dummy,-1._wp,1._wp,n,1_ip, &
         dummy,dummy,lambda,solution,m+1,perturbation,status)
      if (status /= 0) error stop 'Poisson/Helmholtz solver status'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(solution))) error stop 'nonfinite PDE solution'
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(perturbation)) error stop 'nonfinite forcing perturbation'
      if (abs(perturbation) > 1.e-12_wp) error stop 'unexpected forcing perturbation'
      solver_error = maxval(abs(solution-discrete))
      if (solver_error > 1.e-11_wp) error stop 'exact discrete eigenmode solution'
      boundary_error = max(maxval(abs(solution(1,:)-continuous(1,:))), &
         maxval(abs(solution(m+1,:)-continuous(m+1,:))), &
         maxval(abs(solution(:,1)-continuous(:,1))),maxval(abs(solution(:,n+1)-continuous(:,n+1))))
      if (boundary_error > 1.e-12_wp) error stop 'nonzero boundary preservation'
      residual = 0._wp
      do j = 2,n
         do i = 2,m
            term = (solution(i-1,j)-2*solution(i,j)+solution(i+1,j))/hx**2 &
               +(solution(i,j-1)-2*solution(i,j)+solution(i,j+1))/hy**2 &
               +lambda*solution(i,j)-forcing(i,j)
            residual = max(residual,abs(term))
         end do
      end do
      residual = residual/max(1._wp,maxval(abs(forcing(2:m,2:n))))
      if (residual > 1.e-11_wp) error stop 'independent five-point residual'
      continuous_error = maxval(abs(solution-continuous))
      if (abs(continuous_error-abs(factor-1._wp)) > 1.e-11_wp) error stop 'predicted discretization error'
      print '(a,f6.2,a,i0,a,i0,a,es10.2,a,es10.2,a,es10.2)', 'lambda=',lambda,' grid=',m,'x',n, &
         ' solver error=',solver_error,' PDE error=',continuous_error,' residual=',residual
   end subroutine check
end program helmholtz_reference

name: gams-poisfft-periodic-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/pde-drivers-MIT.txt.
program periodic_reference
   use poisfft, only: drp, PoisFFT_Solver1D_DP, PoisFFT_Periodic, PoisFFT_Spectral, &
      PoisFFT_Estimate, Execute, Finalize
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(drp), parameter :: pi = acos(-1._drp), length = 2*pi
   integer, parameter :: grids(*) = [16,32,64], modes(*) = [PoisFFT_Spectral,2]
   real(drp) :: error,previous,ratio
   integer :: mode,g
   do mode = 1,size(modes)
      previous = 0._drp
      do g = 1,size(grids)
         call check(grids(g),modes(mode),error)
         if (mode == 2 .and. g > 1) then
            ratio = previous/error
            if (.not. ieee_is_finite(ratio)) error stop 'nonfinite periodic refinement ratio'
            if (ratio < 3.5_drp .or. ratio > 4.5_drp) error stop 'second-order periodic refinement'
         end if
         previous = error
      end do
   end do
   print '(a)', 'Spectral and second-order periodic Poisson solvers checked at three grids; plans reused for zero forcing.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS poisfft-periodic-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(n,approximation,continuous_error)
      integer, intent(in) :: n,approximation
      real(drp), intent(out) :: continuous_error
      type(PoisFFT_Solver1D_DP) :: solver
      real(drp) :: forcing(n), solution(n), continuous(n), discrete(n), h,x,mu1,mu3
      real(drp) :: solver_error,residual,term
      integer :: i,left,right
      h = length/n
      if (approximation == PoisFFT_Spectral) then
         mu1 = -1._drp
         mu3 = -9._drp
      else
         mu1 = -4*sin(pi/n)**2/h**2
         mu3 = -4*sin(3*pi/n)**2/h**2
      end if
      do i = 1,n
         x = (i-1)*h
         continuous(i) = sin(x)+.25_drp*cos(3*x)
         forcing(i) = -sin(x)-2.25_drp*cos(3*x)
         discrete(i) = -sin(x)/mu1-2.25_drp*cos(3*x)/mu3
      end do
      ! Periodic Poisson requires zero-mean forcing; remove only roundoff-level mean.
      forcing = forcing-sum(forcing)/n
      solver = PoisFFT_Solver1D_DP([n],[length],[PoisFFT_Periodic,PoisFFT_Periodic], &
         approximation=approximation,planning=PoisFFT_Estimate)
      call Execute(solver,solution,forcing)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(solution))) error stop 'nonfinite periodic solution'
      solver_error = maxval(abs(solution-discrete))
      if (solver_error > 1.e-11_drp) error stop 'exact periodic reference solution'
      if (abs(sum(solution)/n) > 1.e-11_drp) error stop 'zero-mean solution gauge'
      if (approximation == 2) then
         residual = 0._drp
         do i = 1,n
            left = modulo(i-2,n)+1
            right = modulo(i,n)+1
            term = (solution(left)-2*solution(i)+solution(right))/h**2-forcing(i)
            residual = max(residual,abs(term))
         end do
         if (residual/max(1._drp,maxval(abs(forcing))) > 1.e-11_drp) error stop 'periodic discrete residual'
      end if
      continuous_error = maxval(abs(solution-continuous))
      if (approximation == PoisFFT_Spectral .and. continuous_error > 1.e-11_drp) error stop 'spectral accuracy'
      print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,es10.2,a,es10.2)', 'Approximation=',approximation,' n=',n, &
         ' solver error=',solver_error,' continuous PDE error=',continuous_error
      forcing = 0._drp
      call Execute(solver,solution,forcing)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(solution))) error stop 'nonfinite zero-forcing solution'
      if (maxval(abs(solution)) > 1.e-11_drp) error stop 'reused plan zero forcing'
      call Finalize(solver)
   end subroutine check
end program periodic_reference

name: gams-fast-float-parsing-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/data-kinds-drivers-MIT.txt.
program parsing_reference
   use fast_float_module, only: parse_double, parse_i64, parse_i32, parse_result, &
      parse_options, PRESET_FORTRAN, outcomes
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: int32,int64,real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(int64), parameter :: integers(*) = [-huge(0_int64)-1_int64,-huge(0_int64), &
      -100000_int64,-1_int64,0_int64,1_int64,255_int64,huge(0_int64)]
   integer(int32), parameter :: small(*) = [-huge(0_int32)-1_int32,-100000_int32, &
      -1_int32,0_int32,1_int32,255_int32,huge(0_int32)]
   type(parse_result) :: status
   real(real64) :: value,expected
   integer(int64) :: large
   integer(int32) :: number
   character(40) :: text
   integer :: i,calls
   calls = 0
   do i = -64,64
      expected = real(i,real64)/8
      write(text,'(f12.3)') expected
      value = parse_double(trim(adjustl(text)),res=status)
      call ok()
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(value) .or. value /= expected) error stop 'exact dyadic decimal'
   end do
   do i = 1,size(integers)
      write(text,'(i0)') integers(i)
      large = parse_i64(trim(text),base=10,res=status)
      call ok()
      if (large /= integers(i)) error stop 'signed int64 decimal reference'
   end do
   do i = 1,size(small)
      write(text,'(i0)') small(i)
      number = parse_i32(trim(text),base=10,res=status)
      call ok()
      if (number /= small(i)) error stop 'signed int32 decimal reference'
   end do
   large = parse_i64('11111111',base=2,res=status)
   call ok()
   if (large /= 255_int64) error stop 'binary integer'
   number = parse_i32('7FFFFFFF',base=16,res=status)
   call ok()
   if (number /= huge(0_int32)) error stop 'hex integer'
   value = parse_double('1.25D-1',parse_options(format=PRESET_FORTRAN),res=status)
   call ok()
   if (value /= .125_real64) error stop 'Fortran D exponent'
   value = parse_double('9007199254740993',res=status)
   call ok()
   if (value /= 9007199254740992._real64) error stop 'binary64 halfway rounding'
   value = parse_double('not-a-number',res=status)
   if (status%outcome%state /= outcomes%INVALID_INPUT%state) error stop 'invalid float status'
   large = parse_i64('not-an-integer',base=10,res=status)
   if (status%outcome%state /= outcomes%INVALID_INPUT%state) error stop 'invalid integer status'
   value = parse_double('1e999',res=status)
   if (status%outcome%state /= outcomes%OUT_OF_RANGE%state) error stop 'float overflow status'
   large = parse_i64('9223372036854775808',base=10,res=status)
   if (status%outcome%state /= outcomes%OUT_OF_RANGE%state) error stop 'int64 positive overflow status'
   large = parse_i64('-9223372036854775809',base=10,res=status)
   if (status%outcome%state /= outcomes%OUT_OF_RANGE%state) error stop 'int64 negative overflow status'
   number = parse_i32('2147483648',base=10,res=status)
   if (status%outcome%state /= outcomes%OUT_OF_RANGE%state) error stop 'int32 overflow status'
   if (calls /= 148) error stop 'successful parse count'
   print '(a)', '129 exact binary-fraction decimals and 15 signed decimal integers checked.'
   print '(a)', 'Binary/hex integers, D exponent and a binary64 halfway case checked.'
   print '(a)', 'Six invalid/overflow outcomes checked; 154 parser calls in total.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fast-float-parsing-reference'
contains
   subroutine ok()
      if (status%outcome%state /= outcomes%OK%state) error stop 'valid parse status'
      calls = calls+1
   end subroutine ok
end program parsing_reference

name: gams-fifo-storage-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/data-kinds-drivers-MIT.txt.
program fifo_reference
   use fifo_queue, only: fifo,new_fifo_queue
   use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding, only: c_int64_t,c_sizeof,c_ptr,c_f_pointer,c_associated
   implicit none
   type, bind(C) :: record
      integer(c_int64_t) :: serial,checksum
   end type record
   type(fifo) :: queue,other
   type(record), target :: input
   type(record) :: model(200),sentinel
   type(c_ptr) :: memory
   integer :: head,tail,cycle,i
   interface
      subroutine c_free(pointer) bind(C,name='free')
         import c_ptr
         type(c_ptr), value :: pointer
      end subroutine c_free
   end interface
   queue = new_fifo_queue(c_sizeof(input))
   other = new_fifo_queue(c_sizeof(input))
   sentinel = record(-999_c_int64_t,12345_c_int64_t)
   input = sentinel
   call other%push(input)
   input = record(0_c_int64_t,0_c_int64_t)
   head = 0
   tail = 0
   call count_check()
   do cycle = 1,3
      do i = 1,40
         call push_check()
      end do
      do i = 1,17
         call pop_check()
      end do
      do i = 1,13
         call push_check()
      end do
      do while (head < tail)
         call pop_check()
      end do
      if (queue%pop(memory)) error stop 'empty queue returned an item'
      if (c_associated(memory)) error stop 'empty pop pointer must be null'
      if (other%count() /= 1) error stop 'independent queue changed'
      print '(a,i0,a,i0,a)', 'Cycle ',cycle,': ',tail,' cumulative copied records checked; queue drained.'
   end do
   call extract(other,sentinel)
   if (other%count() /= 0 .or. .not. other%is_empty()) error stop 'secondary final state'
   call queue%destroy()
   call other%destroy()
   if (tail /= 159 .or. head /= tail) error stop 'reference model count'
   print '(a)', '160 records checked: interleaved FIFO order, copied values, empty/refill behavior, independent queues.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fifo-storage-reference'
contains
   subroutine count_check()
      if (queue%count() /= tail-head) error stop 'reference queue count'
      if (queue%is_empty() .neqv. (tail == head)) error stop 'reference empty state'
   end subroutine count_check
   subroutine push_check()
      tail = tail+1
      model(tail) = record(int(tail,c_int64_t),int(tail*tail-7*tail,c_int64_t))
      input = model(tail)
      call queue%push(input)
      ! The queued record must survive overwriting the caller's storage.
      input = record(-1_c_int64_t,-1_c_int64_t)
      call count_check()
   end subroutine push_check
   subroutine pop_check()
      head = head+1
      call extract(queue,model(head))
      call count_check()
   end subroutine pop_check
   subroutine extract(which,expected)
      type(fifo), intent(inout) :: which
      type(record), intent(in) :: expected
      type(record), pointer :: output
      type(c_ptr) :: allocation
      if (.not. which%pop(allocation)) error stop 'early empty queue'
      if (.not. c_associated(allocation)) error stop 'null payload'
      call c_f_pointer(allocation,output)
      if (output%serial /= expected%serial .or. output%checksum /= expected%checksum) error stop 'copied FIFO record'
      ! Payloads were allocated with malloc; free each before destroying its empty queue.
      call c_free(allocation)
      nullify(output)
   end subroutine extract
end program fifo_reference

name: gams-penf-machine-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/data-kinds-drivers-MIT.txt.
program machine_reference
   use penf, only: penf_init,is_initialized,endian,endianL,endianB,I1P,I2P,I4P,I8P,R4P,R8P, &
      BII1P,BII2P,BII4P,BII8P,BIR4P,BIR8P,BYI1P,BYI2P,BYI4P,BYI8P,BYR4P,BYR8P, &
      MaxI1P,MaxI2P,MaxI4P,MaxI8P,MaxR4P,MaxR8P,smallR4P,smallR8P,byte_size
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: int8,int16,int32,int64,real32,real64
   implicit none
   real(R4P), volatile :: step4,one4,next4
   real(R8P), volatile :: step8,one8,next8
   integer(int8) :: bytes(4)
   integer :: count4,count8,order
   call penf_init()
   if (.not. is_initialized) error stop 'PENF initialization state'
   if (any([I1P,I2P,I4P,I8P] /= [int8,int16,int32,int64])) error stop 'ISO integer kinds'
   if (any([R4P,R8P] /= [real32,real64])) error stop 'ISO real kinds'
   if (any([int(BII1P),int(BII2P),int(BII4P),int(BII8P)] /= [8,16,32,64])) error stop 'integer storage bits'
   if (any([int(BIR4P),int(BIR8P)] /= [storage_size(0._real32),storage_size(0._real64)])) &
      error stop 'real storage bits'
   if (any([int(BYI1P),int(BYI2P),int(BYI4P),int(BYI8P)] /= [1,2,4,8])) error stop 'integer bytes'
   if (any([int(BYR4P),int(BYR8P)] /= [4,8])) error stop 'real bytes'
   if (byte_size(0_I1P) /= 1 .or. byte_size(0_I2P) /= 2) error stop 'small integer byte inquiry'
   if (byte_size(0_I4P) /= 4 .or. byte_size(0_I8P) /= 8) error stop 'large integer byte inquiry'
   if (byte_size(0._R4P) /= 4 .or. byte_size(0._R8P) /= 8) error stop 'real byte inquiry'
   if (MaxI1P /= huge(0_int8) .or. MaxI2P /= huge(0_int16)) error stop 'small integer maxima'
   if (MaxI4P /= huge(0_int32) .or. MaxI8P /= huge(0_int64)) error stop 'large integer maxima'
   if (MaxR4P /= huge(0._real32) .or. MaxR8P /= huge(0._real64)) error stop 'real maxima'
   if (smallR4P /= tiny(0._real32) .or. smallR8P /= tiny(0._real64)) error stop 'normal real minima'
   bytes = transfer(int(z'01020304',int32),bytes)
   if (all(bytes == [4_int8,3_int8,2_int8,1_int8])) then
      order = endianL
   else if (all(bytes == [1_int8,2_int8,3_int8,4_int8])) then
      order = endianB
   else
      error stop 'unsupported mixed byte order'
   end if
   if (endian /= order) error stop 'byte order reference'
   call penf_init()
   if (.not. is_initialized .or. endian /= order) error stop 'repeated initialization'
   one4 = 1._R4P
   one8 = 1._R8P
   step4 = one4
   step8 = one8
   count4 = 0
   do
      next4 = one4+step4/2
      if (next4 == one4) exit
      step4 = step4/2
      count4 = count4+1
      if (count4 > 100) error stop 'real32 experiment did not terminate'
   end do
   count8 = 0
   do
      next8 = one8+step8/2
      if (next8 == one8) exit
      step8 = step8/2
      count8 = count8+1
      if (count8 > 200) error stop 'real64 experiment did not terminate'
   end do
   if (step4 /= epsilon(one4) .or. count4+1 /= digits(one4)) error stop 'measured real32 roundoff'
   if (step8 /= epsilon(one8) .or. count8+1 /= digits(one8)) error stop 'measured real64 roundoff'
   print '(a,4i4)', 'Integer storage bits:',BII1P,BII2P,BII4P,BII8P
   print '(a,i0,a,es12.4)', 'R4P significand bits=',count4+1,' measured epsilon=',step4
   print '(a,i0,a,es12.4)', 'R8P significand bits=',count8+1,' measured epsilon=',step8
   print '(a,i0,a)', 'Endian code=',endian,' (verified from the bytes of 0x01020304).'
   print '(a)', 'PASS penf-machine-reference'
end program machine_reference

name: gams-fordot-exact-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/products-status-drivers-MIT.txt.
program exact_products
   use kinds, only: rk
   use fordot, only: fdot => dot_product
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: lengths(*) = [1,7,8,17,64]
   character(2), parameter :: methods(*) = ['m1','m2','m3','m4']
   real(rk), allocatable :: u(:),v(:)
   integer(int64) :: numerator,a,b
   real(rk) :: expected,actual
   integer :: l,n,pattern,i,method,block,blocks(3),calls
   calls = 0
   do l = 1,size(lengths)
      n = lengths(l)
      allocate(u(n),v(n))
      blocks = [1,3,n]
      do pattern = 1,3
         numerator = 0_int64
         do i = 1,n
            select case(pattern)
            case(1)
               a = mod(7*i,23)-11
               b = mod(11*i,19)-9
            case(2)
               a = (-1)**i*(mod(i,5)+1)
               b = 3
            case(3)
               a = 0
               b = mod(i,13)-6
            end select
            u(i) = real(a,rk)/8
            v(i) = real(b,rk)/4
            numerator = numerator+a*b
         end do
         expected = real(numerator,rk)/32
         actual = fdot(u,v)
         call check(actual,expected)
         do method = 1,size(methods)
            actual = fdot(u,v,option=methods(method))
            call check(actual,expected)
            do block = 1,size(blocks)
               if (blocks(block) > n) cycle
               if (block > 1) then
                  if (any(blocks(:block-1) == blocks(block))) cycle
               end if
               actual = fdot(u,v,option=methods(method),nblock=blocks(block))
               call check(actual,expected)
            end do
         end do
         print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,f12.5)', 'Length=',n,' pattern=',pattern,' exact dot product=',expected
      end do
      deallocate(u,v)
   end do
   if (calls /= 231) error stop 'dot product call count'
   print '(a)', '231 exact results checked: default and m1..m4, including unequal blocks and zero products.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fordot-exact-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,expected)
      real(rk), intent(in) :: actual,expected
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'nonfinite dot product'
      if (actual /= expected) error stop 'exact int64 numerator reference'
      calls = calls+1
   end subroutine check
end program exact_products

name: gams-fassert-captured-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/products-status-drivers-MIT.txt.
program captured_assertions
   use fassert, only: assert_equal,assert_approx_equal,expect_equal,expect_approx_equal
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   real(real64), parameter :: deltas(*) = [-.75_real64,-.5_real64,-.25_real64,0._real64, &
      .25_real64,.5_real64,.75_real64], tol = .5_real64
   real(real64) :: values(3)
   character(:), allocatable :: message
   logical :: passed,expected
   integer :: i,captured
   captured = 0
   call assert_equal(3*7,21,'integer arithmetic')
   call assert_equal([1,4,9],[1,4,9],'integer squares')
   call assert_approx_equal(sqrt(2._real64)**2,2._real64,'numerical assertion',tolerance=1.e-12_real64)
   call expect_equal(7,7,'equal scalar',passed,output_message=message)
   call validate(passed,.true.,message,'equal scalar')
   call expect_equal(7,8,'unequal scalar',passed,output_message=message)
   call validate(passed,.false.,message,'unequal scalar')
   call expect_equal([1,4,9],[1,4,9],'equal vector',passed,output_message=message)
   call validate(passed,.true.,message,'equal vector')
   call expect_equal([1,4,8],[1,4,9],'unequal vector',passed,output_message=message)
   call validate(passed,.false.,message,'unequal vector')
   do i = 1,size(deltas)
      expected = abs(deltas(i)) <= tol
      call expect_approx_equal(10._real64+deltas(i),10._real64,'tolerance window',passed, &
         tolerance=tol,output_message=message)
      call validate(passed,expected,message,'tolerance window')
   end do
   values = [1._real64,2._real64,3.25_real64]
   call expect_approx_equal(values,[1._real64,2._real64,3._real64],'vector tolerance boundary',passed, &
      tolerance=.25_real64,output_message=message)
   call validate(passed,.true.,message,'vector tolerance boundary')
   values(3) = 3.5_real64
   call expect_approx_equal(values,[1._real64,2._real64,3._real64],'vector outside tolerance',passed, &
      tolerance=.25_real64,output_message=message)
   call validate(passed,.false.,message,'vector outside tolerance')
   if (captured /= 13) error stop 'captured comparison count'
   print '(a)', 'Three positive assertions and 13 captured comparisons checked.'
   print '(a)', 'Scalar/vector mismatches and both exact tolerance boundaries were detected without stopping.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fassert-captured-reference'
contains
   subroutine validate(actual,expected,text,label)
      logical, intent(in) :: actual,expected
      character(*), intent(in) :: text,label
      if (actual .neqv. expected) error stop 'independent comparison truth value'
      if (index(text,label) == 0) error stop 'missing comparison label'
      if (expected) then
         if (index(text,'PASSED:') == 0) error stop 'success diagnostic'
      else
         if (index(text,'FAILED:') == 0) error stop 'failure diagnostic'
      end if
      captured = captured+1
   end subroutine validate
end program captured_assertions

name: gams-errstat-recovery-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/products-status-drivers-MIT.txt.
program recovery_reference
   use errstat, only: error_stat_type,catch_error,set_success,error_occurred
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite,ieee_value,ieee_quiet_nan
   implicit none
   real(real64) :: numerator(9),denominator(9),value
   real(real64), parameter :: expected_values(*) = [1.5_real64,0._real64,2._real64,0._real64, &
      1._real64,0._real64,3._real64,0._real64,7._real64]
   integer, parameter :: codes(*) = [0,101,0,102,0,103,0,101,0]
   type(error_stat_type) :: status,saved
   character(:), allocatable :: message
   integer :: i
   numerator = [9._real64,9._real64,16._real64,-1._real64,25._real64,0._real64,36._real64,4._real64,49._real64]
   numerator(6) = ieee_value(0._real64,ieee_quiet_nan)
   denominator = [4._real64,0._real64,4._real64,1._real64,25._real64,1._real64,4._real64,-0._real64,1._real64]
   do i = 1,size(codes)
      value = safe_ratio_root(numerator(i),denominator(i),status)
      if (status%get_status() /= codes(i)) error stop 'expected status code'
      if (error_occurred(status) .neqv. (codes(i) /= 0)) error stop 'expected error flag'
      select case(codes(i))
      case(0)
         message = 'ok'
      case(101)
         message = 'zero denominator'
      case(102)
         message = 'negative radicand'
      case(103)
         message = 'nonfinite input'
      end select
      if (status%get_message() /= message) error stop 'exact error or recovery message'
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(value) .or. value /= expected_values(i)) error stop 'driver arithmetic result'
      print '(a,i0,a,i0,2a)', 'Call ',i,': status=',status%get_status(),' message=',status%get_message()
   end do
   call catch_error(701,'original',status)
   saved = status
   call status%append_message('context')
   if (status%get_message() /= 'original - context') error stop 'appended error context'
   if (saved%get_message() /= 'original' .or. saved%get_status() /= 701) error stop 'independent status copy'
   call set_success(status,'recovered')
   if (error_occurred(status) .or. status%get_status() /= 0) error stop 'explicit recovery status'
   if (status%get_message() /= 'recovered') error stop 'explicit recovery message'
   if (.not. error_occurred(saved) .or. saved%get_message() /= 'original') error stop 'copy survived recovery'
   call status%initialize()
   if (error_occurred(status) .or. status%get_message() /= '') error stop 'status initialization reset'
   print '(a)', 'Nine success/failure/recovery calls, copied statuses, appended context and explicit reset checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS errstat-recovery-reference'
contains
   function safe_ratio_root(a,b,state) result(y)
      real(real64), intent(in) :: a,b
      type(error_stat_type), intent(out) :: state
      real(real64) :: y
      y = 0._real64
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(a) .or. .not. ieee_is_finite(b)) then
         call catch_error(103,'nonfinite input',state)
      else if (b == 0._real64) then
         call catch_error(101,'zero denominator',state)
      else if (a/b < 0._real64) then
         call catch_error(102,'negative radicand',state)
      else
         y = sqrt(a/b)
         call set_success(state,'ok')
      end if
   end function safe_ratio_root
end program recovery_reference

name: gams-gslib-kriging-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/kriging-network-drivers-MIT.txt.
program kriging_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dp = real64
   real(dp), parameter :: positions(*) = [-1._dp,0._dp,.5_dp,1._dp,1.5_dp,2._dp,3._dp]
   real(dp), parameter :: distances(*) = [0._dp,.5_dp,1._dp,2._dp,3._dp,4._dp]
   real(dp) :: rotation(1,3,3),matrix(3,3),packed(6),rhs(3),original_rhs(3),weights(3)
   real(dp) :: r,c1,c2,expected(3),analytic(3),estimate,variance,variance_ref,residual,total
   real(dp) :: estimates(size(positions)),variances(size(positions))
   real :: nugget(1),sill(1),parameter(1),cmax,covariance
   integer :: nested(1),model(1),i,j,k,tag,q,status,solves
   interface
      subroutine cova3(x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2,ivarg,nst,maxnst,c0,it,cc,aa,irot,maxrot,rotmat,cmax,cova)
         import dp
         real :: x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2,c0(*),cc(*),aa(*),cmax,cova
         integer :: ivarg,nst(*),maxnst,it(*),irot,maxrot
         real(dp) :: rotmat(maxrot,3,3)
      end subroutine cova3
      subroutine ksol(nright,neq,nsb,a,r,s,ising)
         import dp
         integer :: nright,neq,nsb,ising
         real(dp) :: a(*),r(*),s(*)
      end subroutine ksol
   end interface
   rotation = 0._dp
   do i = 1,3
      rotation(1,i,i) = 1._dp
   end do
   nested = 1
   nugget = 0.
   sill = 1.
   parameter = 3.
   solves = 0
   do tag = 1,3
      model = tag
      do i = 1,size(distances)
         r = observed_covariance(distances(i))
         if (abs(r-kernel(distances(i),tag)) > 2.e-7_dp) error stop 'covariance model reference'
      end do
      r = observed_covariance(2._dp)
      matrix = reshape([1._dp,r,1._dp, r,1._dp,1._dp, 1._dp,1._dp,0._dp],[3,3])
      do q = 1,size(positions)
         c1 = observed_covariance(abs(positions(q)))
         c2 = observed_covariance(abs(positions(q)-2._dp))
         if (abs(c1-kernel(abs(positions(q)),tag)) > 2.e-7_dp) error stop 'left target covariance'
         if (abs(c2-kernel(abs(positions(q)-2._dp),tag)) > 2.e-7_dp) error stop 'right target covariance'
         rhs = [c1,c2,1._dp]
         original_rhs = rhs
         k = 0
         do j = 1,3
            do i = 1,j
               k = k+1
               packed(k) = matrix(i,j)
            end do
         end do
         call ksol(1,3,1,packed,rhs,weights,status)
         if (status /= 0) error stop 'kriging linear solve status'
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(weights))) error stop 'nonfinite kriging weights'
         expected = closed_weights(r,c1,c2)
         if (maxval(abs(weights-expected)) > 1.e-11_dp) error stop 'closed weights for rounded covariances'
         if (abs(sum(weights(:2))-1._dp) > 1.e-11_dp) error stop 'ordinary kriging unbiasedness'
         residual = 0._dp
         do i = 1,3
            total = -original_rhs(i)
            do j = 1,3
               total = total+matrix(i,j)*weights(j)
            end do
            residual = max(residual,abs(total))
         end do
         if (residual > 1.e-11_dp) error stop 'independent kriging system residual'
         analytic = closed_weights(kernel(2._dp,tag),kernel(abs(positions(q)),tag), &
            kernel(abs(positions(q)-2._dp),tag))
         if (maxval(abs(weights-analytic)) > 5.e-7_dp) error stop 'end-to-end analytic weights'
         estimate = weights(1)+3*weights(2)
         variance = 1._dp-sum(weights(:2)*original_rhs(:2))-weights(3)
         variance_ref = 1._dp-analytic(1)*kernel(abs(positions(q)),tag) &
            -analytic(2)*kernel(abs(positions(q)-2._dp),tag)-analytic(3)
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite([estimate,variance]))) error stop 'nonfinite kriging outputs'
         if (abs(estimate-(analytic(1)+3*analytic(2))) > 1.e-6_dp) error stop 'analytic kriging estimate'
         if (variance < -1.e-11_dp .or. abs(variance-variance_ref) > 1.e-6_dp) error stop 'analytic kriging variance'
         if (abs(5*sum(weights(:2))-5._dp) > 1.e-11_dp) error stop 'constant field reproduction'
         estimates(q) = estimate
         variances(q) = variance
         solves = solves+1
         print '(a,i0,a,f5.1,a,f11.7,a,f11.7)', 'Model=',tag,' x=',positions(q), &
            ' estimate=',estimate,' variance=',variance
      end do
      if (abs(estimates(2)-1._dp) > 1.e-11_dp .or. abs(estimates(6)-3._dp) > 1.e-11_dp) &
         error stop 'observation interpolation'
      if (abs(estimates(4)-2._dp) > 1.e-11_dp) error stop 'symmetric midpoint estimate'
      do q = 1,size(positions)
         if (abs(estimates(q)+estimates(size(positions)+1-q)-4._dp) > 1.e-11_dp) error stop 'estimate reflection'
         if (abs(variances(q)-variances(size(positions)+1-q)) > 1.e-11_dp) error stop 'variance reflection'
      end do
   end do
   if (solves /= 21) error stop 'kriging solve count'
   print '(a)', 'Three covariance kernels and 21 two-observation ordinary kriging systems checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS gslib-kriging-reference'
contains
   real(dp) function observed_covariance(distance) result(value)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: distance
      call cova3(0.,0.,0.,real(distance),0.,0.,1,nested,1,nugget,model,sill,parameter,1,1,rotation,cmax,covariance)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite([cmax,covariance]))) error stop 'nonfinite covariance'
      if (cmax /= 1.) error stop 'unit sill'
      value = real(covariance,dp)
   end function observed_covariance
   real(dp) function kernel(distance,tag) result(value)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: distance
      integer, intent(in) :: tag
      real(dp) :: t
      t = distance/3
      select case(tag)
      case(1)
         value = 0._dp
         if (t < 1._dp) value = 1._dp-1.5_dp*t+.5_dp*t**3
      case(2)
         value = exp(-distance)
      case(3)
         value = exp(-distance*distance/3)
      end select
   end function kernel
   function closed_weights(r,c1,c2) result(w)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: r,c1,c2
      real(dp) :: w(3)
      w(1) = .5_dp*(1._dp+(c1-c2)/(1._dp-r))
      w(2) = 1._dp-w(1)
      w(3) = c1-w(1)-r*w(2)
   end function closed_weights
end program kriging_reference

name: gams-fkb-network-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/kriging-network-drivers-MIT.txt.
program network_reference
   use mod_kinds, only: rk
   use mod_network, only: network_type
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(network_type) :: original,restored
   real(rk) :: first(2,3),second(3,2),hidden_bias(3),output_bias(2),x(2),hidden(3),expected(2)
   real(rk), allocatable :: prediction(:),again(:)
   integer :: unit,status,i,j,k,l,cases
   first = reshape([1._rk,-2._rk, .5_rk,1.5_rk, -1._rk,.25_rk],[2,3])
   second = reshape([1._rk,.5_rk,-2._rk, -.25_rk,1.5_rk,.75_rk],[3,2])
   hidden_bias = [.5_rk,-.25_rk,1._rk]
   output_bias = [-.5_rk,.25_rk]
   open(newunit=unit,file='gams-fkb-model.txt',status='replace',action='write',iostat=status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'model creation'
   write(unit,'(a)') '5','input 2','dense 3','relu 0','dense 2','linear 0','0.01'
   write(unit,*) hidden_bias
   write(unit,*) output_bias
   write(unit,*) first
   write(unit,*) second
   close(unit,iostat=status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'model close'
   call original%load('gams-fkb-model.txt')
   if (original%input_size /= 2 .or. original%output_size /= 2) error stop 'original model dimensions'
   call original%save('gams-fkb-saved.txt')
   call restored%load('gams-fkb-saved.txt')
   if (restored%input_size /= 2 .or. restored%output_size /= 2) error stop 'restored model dimensions'
   cases = 0
   do i = -2,2
      do j = -2,2
         x = real([i,j],rk)
         hidden = hidden_bias
         do k = 1,3
            do l = 1,2
               hidden(k) = hidden(k)+first(l,k)*x(l)
            end do
            hidden(k) = max(0._rk,hidden(k))
         end do
         expected = output_bias
         do k = 1,2
            do l = 1,3
               expected(k) = expected(k)+second(l,k)*hidden(l)
            end do
         end do
         prediction = original%output(x)
         again = restored%output(x)
         if (size(prediction) /= 2 .or. size(again) /= 2) error stop 'prediction dimensions'
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(prediction)) .or. .not. all(ieee_is_finite(again))) &
            error stop 'nonfinite neural prediction'
         if (maxval(abs(prediction-expected)) > 1.e-12_rk) error stop 'independent scalar forward reference'
         if (maxval(abs(again-expected)) > 1.e-12_rk) error stop 'restored scalar forward reference'
         cases = cases+1
         print '(a,2i3,a,2f12.5)', 'Input=',i,j,' outputs=',prediction
      end do
   end do
   if (cases /= 25) error stop 'network input count'
   open(newunit=unit,file='gams-fkb-model.txt',status='old')
   close(unit,status='delete')
   open(newunit=unit,file='gams-fkb-saved.txt',status='old')
   close(unit,status='delete')
   print '(a)', '25 two-output predictions checked against scalar references for original and saved/reloaded networks.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fkb-network-reference'
end program network_reference

name: gams-lookup-services-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/lookup-fastmath-drivers-MIT.txt.
program lookup_services_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use m_lookup_table, only: LT_t, LT_loc_t, LT_create, LT_set_col, LT_set_col_data, LT_add_col, &
      LT_get_loc, LT_get_col, LT_get_mcol, LT_get_col_at_loc, LT_get_mcol_at_loc
   implicit none
   type(LT_t) :: table,original
   real(dp), parameter :: source_x(*) = [-2._dp,-1.25_dp,.25_dp,1._dp,2._dp]
   real(dp) :: grid(9),source_y(5),stored(9,3),baseline(9,3),q,max_error
   integer :: i,queries
   grid = [(-2._dp+.5_dp*i,i=0,8)]
   source_y = (source_x+1)**2
   table = LT_create(-2._dp,2._dp,n_points=9,n_cols=2)
   if (maxval(abs(table%x-grid)) > 1.e-14_dp) error stop 'linear grid creation'
   call LT_set_col_data(table,1,2*grid+1)
   call LT_set_col(table,2,source_x,source_y)
   call LT_add_col(table,source_x,[(7._dp,i=1,5)])
   if (table%n_cols /= 3 .or. table%n_points /= 9) error stop 'added column dimensions'
   stored(:,1) = 2*grid+1
   do i = 1,9
      stored(i,2) = reference(source_x,source_y,grid(i))
   end do
   stored(:,3) = 7._dp
   baseline = stored
   original = table
   call LT_set_col_data(table,1,[(3._dp,i=1,9)],add=.true.)
   call LT_set_col(table,2,source_x,[(-.5_dp,i=1,5)],add=.true.)
   stored(:,1) = stored(:,1)+3
   stored(:,2) = stored(:,2)-.5_dp
   queries = 0
   max_error = 0._dp
   do i = 0,48
      q = -3._dp+real(i,dp)/8
      call check(table,stored,q)
      call check(original,baseline,q)
   end do
   if (queries /= 98) error stop 'lookup query count'
   print '(a)', '98 queries: updated and independent copied tables, 3 columns, 4 lookup routes.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum error versus independent two-stage interpolation: ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'Location coordinates, endpoints, clamping, resampling, column addition and updates checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS lookup-services-reference'
contains
   real(dp) function reference(x,y,query) result(value)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: x(:),y(:),query
      integer :: j
      real(dp) :: fraction
      value = y(1)
      if (query <= x(1)) return
      value = y(size(y))
      if (query >= x(size(x))) return
      do j = 2,size(x)
         if (query <= x(j)) then
            fraction = (query-x(j-1))/(x(j)-x(j-1))
            value = y(j-1)+fraction*(y(j)-y(j-1))
            return
         end if
      end do
   end function reference
   subroutine check(t,values,query)
      type(LT_t), intent(in) :: t
      real(dp), intent(in) :: values(9,3),query
      type(LT_loc_t) :: loc
      real(dp) :: expected(3),direct(3),located(3),answers(4),coordinate
      integer :: c
      loc = LT_get_loc(t,query)
      if (loc%low_ix < 1 .or. loc%low_ix > 8) error stop 'location index bounds'
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(loc%low_frac)) error stop 'nonfinite location fraction'
      if (loc%low_frac < 0 .or. loc%low_frac > 1) error stop 'clamped location fraction'
      coordinate = loc%low_frac*grid(loc%low_ix)+(1-loc%low_frac)*grid(loc%low_ix+1)
      if (abs(coordinate-max(-2._dp,min(2._dp,query))) > 1.e-12_dp) error stop 'location coordinate'
      direct = LT_get_mcol(t,query)
      located = LT_get_mcol_at_loc(t,loc)
      do c = 1,3
         expected(c) = reference(grid,values(:,c),query)
         answers = [direct(c),located(c),LT_get_col(t,c,query),LT_get_col_at_loc(t,c,loc)]
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(answers))) error stop 'nonfinite lookup'
         max_error = max(max_error,maxval(abs(answers-expected(c))))
         if (maxval(abs(answers-expected(c))) > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'independent lookup reference'
      end do
      queries = queries+1
   end subroutine check
end program lookup_services_reference

name: gams-fastmath-exp-log-reference

program exp_log_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use fast_exp, only: fexp
   use fast_log, only: flog_quintic
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n = 641
   real(dp) :: x(n),positive(n),exponential(n),logarithm(n),exp_error,log_error,identity_error
   integer :: i
   x = [(real(i,dp)/4,i=-320,320)]
   positive = exp(x)
   exponential = fexp(x)
   logarithm = flog_quintic(positive)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(exponential))) error stop 'nonfinite exponential'
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(logarithm))) error stop 'nonfinite logarithm'
   if (any(exponential <= 0)) error stop 'nonpositive exponential'
   if (any(exponential(2:) <= exponential(:n-1))) error stop 'exponential grid monotonicity'
   if (any(logarithm(2:) <= logarithm(:n-1))) error stop 'logarithm grid monotonicity'
   exp_error = maxval(abs(exponential/positive-1))
   log_error = maxval(abs(logarithm-x))
   if (exp_error > 1.e-4_dp) error stop 'exponential intrinsic reference'
   if (log_error > 1.e-3_dp) error stop 'logarithm inverse reference'
   do i = 1,n
      if (abs(fexp(x(i))/exponential(i)-1) > 1.e-14_dp) error stop 'scalar/array exponential'
      if (abs(flog_quintic(positive(i))-logarithm(i)) > 1.e-12_dp) error stop 'scalar/array logarithm'
   end do
   identity_error = maxval(abs(fexp(logarithm)/positive-1))
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(identity_error) .or. identity_error > 1.2e-3_dp) error stop 'exp log round trip'
   print '(a)', '641 points x=-80..80 in steps of 0.25; log arguments exp(x).'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum exponential relative error versus intrinsic exp: ',exp_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum logarithm absolute error versus x: ',log_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum approximate exp/log round-trip relative error: ',identity_error
   print '(a)', 'Positive exponentials, grid monotonicity and scalar/array consistency checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fastmath-exp-log-reference'
end program exp_log_reference

name: gams-ecx-rlc-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/circuits-beta-drivers-MIT.txt.
program rlc_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64, int32
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use ecx, only: z
   implicit none
   real(dp), parameter :: resistances(*) = [1._dp,10._dp,100._dp]
   real(dp), parameter :: capacitances(*) = [.001_dp,.01_dp],inductances(*) = [.01_dp,.1_dp]
   real(dp) :: omega(18),resistance,capacitance,inductance,t,max_error
   complex(dp) :: resistor(18),capacitor(18),inductor(18),series(18),parallel(18),expected
   integer :: i,j,k,n,circuits,frequencies
   max_error = 0._dp
   circuits = 0
   frequencies = 0
   do i = 1,size(resistances)
      resistance = resistances(i)
      do j = 1,size(capacitances)
         capacitance = capacitances(j)
         do k = 1,size(inductances)
            inductance = inductances(k)
            omega(:17) = [(scale(1._dp,n),n=-8,8)]
            omega(18) = 1/sqrt(inductance*capacitance)
            call element(resistance,'R',resistor)
            call element(capacitance,'C',capacitor)
            call element(inductance,'L',inductor)
            series = resistor+capacitor+inductor
            parallel = resistor*capacitor/(resistor+capacitor)
            do n = 1,size(omega)
               call check(resistor(n),cmplx(resistance,0._dp,dp))
               call check(capacitor(n),cmplx(0._dp,-1/(omega(n)*capacitance),dp))
               call check(inductor(n),cmplx(0._dp,omega(n)*inductance,dp))
               expected = cmplx(resistance,omega(n)*inductance-1/(omega(n)*capacitance),dp)
               call check(series(n),expected)
               t = omega(n)*resistance*capacitance
               expected = cmplx(resistance/(1+t*t),-resistance*t/(1+t*t),dp)
               call check(parallel(n),expected)
            end do
            if (abs(aimag(series(18))) > 1.e-12_dp*max(1._dp,resistance)) error stop 'series resonance'
            if (abs(abs(series(18))-resistance) > 1.e-12_dp*max(1._dp,resistance)) &
               error stop 'resonant impedance magnitude'
            circuits = circuits+1
            frequencies = frequencies+size(omega)
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (circuits /= 12 .or. frequencies /= 216) error stop 'circuit count'
   print '(a)', '12 RLC parameter sets, 216 frequency cases, 648 element impedances checked.'
   print '(a)', 'Series RLC resonance and parallel RC real/imaginary formulas checked.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum complex error / max(1,abs(reference)): ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS ecx-rlc-reference'
contains
   subroutine element(parameter,code,values)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: parameter
      character, intent(in) :: code
      complex(dp), intent(out) :: values(18)
      integer(int32) :: status
      character(:), pointer :: message
      ! The public API requires three parameters even for a one-parameter element.
      call z([parameter,0._dp,0._dp],omega,values,code,status,message)
      if (status /= 0) error stop 'element status'
      if (.not. associated(message)) error stop 'missing element diagnostic'
      if (message /= 'No error') error stop 'element success diagnostic'
   end subroutine element
   subroutine check(actual,reference)
      complex(dp), intent(in) :: actual,reference
      real(dp) :: error
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(real(actual)) .or. .not. ieee_is_finite(aimag(actual))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite impedance'
      error = abs(actual-reference)/max(1._dp,abs(reference))
      max_error = max(max_error,error)
      if (error > 2.e-13_dp) error stop 'independent circuit reference'
   end subroutine check
end program rlc_reference

name: gams-rpn-sinc-sech-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/circuits-beta-drivers-MIT.txt.
program elementary_reference
   use assert, only: wp
   use funcs, only: sinc,sech
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(133),s(133),h(133),reference,term,a,max_sinc_error,max_sech_error
   integer :: i,k
   x(:129) = [(real(i,wp)/8,i=-64,64)]
   x(130:) = [-1.e-10_wp,1.e-10_wp,-1.e-6_wp,1.e-6_wp]
   s = sinc(x)
   h = sech(x)
   if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(s)) .or. .not. all(ieee_is_finite(h))) error stop 'nonfinite function'
   max_sinc_error = 0._wp
   max_sech_error = 0._wp
   do i = 1,size(x)
      term = 1._wp
      reference = term
      ! Independent sinc series: sum (-x*x)**k/(2*k+1)!, no sin call.
      do k = 1,63
         term = -term*x(i)*x(i)/real((2*k)*(2*k+1),wp)
         reference = reference+term
      end do
      max_sinc_error = max(max_sinc_error,abs(s(i)-reference))
      a = exp(-abs(x(i)))
      reference = 2*a/(1+a*a)
      max_sech_error = max(max_sech_error,abs(h(i)-reference))
      if (abs(sinc(x(i))-s(i)) > 1.e-14_wp) error stop 'scalar/array sinc'
      if (abs(sech(x(i))-h(i)) > 1.e-14_wp) error stop 'scalar/array sech'
      if (h(i) <= 0 .or. h(i) > 1) error stop 'sech range'
   end do
   if (max_sinc_error > 5.e-13_wp) error stop 'sinc power series reference'
   if (max_sech_error > 5.e-14_wp) error stop 'sech exponential reference'
   if (s(65) /= 1 .or. h(65) /= 1) error stop 'values at zero'
   if (maxval(abs(s(:129)-s(129:1:-1))) > 1.e-14_wp) error stop 'sinc even symmetry'
   if (maxval(abs(h(:129)-h(129:1:-1))) > 1.e-14_wp) error stop 'sech even symmetry'
   print '(a)', '133 real arguments: -8..8 step 0.125, plus signed near-zero values.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sinc absolute error versus 64-term power series: ',max_sinc_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum sech absolute error versus exponential formula: ',max_sech_error
   print '(a)', 'Zero values, even symmetry, sech range and scalar/array consistency checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS rpn-sinc-sech-reference'
end program elementary_reference

name: gams-rpn-beta-reference
source:

program beta_reference
   use assert, only: wp
   use funcs, only: beta
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: int64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(int64) :: factorial(0:15)
   integer :: i,j,cases
   real(wp) :: x,y,reference,pi,max_error,values(4),expected(4)
   factorial(0) = 1_int64
   do i = 1,15
      factorial(i) = i*factorial(i-1)
   end do
   pi = acos(-1._wp)
   cases = 0
   max_error = 0._wp
   do i = 1,8
      do j = 1,8
         x = real(i,wp)
         y = real(j,wp)
         reference = real(factorial(i-1),wp)*real(factorial(j-1),wp)/real(factorial(i+j-1),wp)
         call check
      end do
   end do
   do i = 0,7
      do j = 0,7
         x = real(i,wp)+.5_wp
         y = real(j,wp)+.5_wp
         reference = pi*real(factorial(2*i),wp)/real(factorial(i),wp) &
            *real(factorial(2*j),wp)/real(factorial(j),wp)/4._wp**(i+j)/real(factorial(i+j),wp)
         call check
      end do
   end do
   if (cases /= 128) error stop 'beta case count'
   print '(a)', '128 positive integer/half-integer pairs; 512 beta evaluations checked.'
   print '(a)', 'Independent factorial identities, symmetry and both one-step recurrences checked.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum relative error against closed-form references: ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS rpn-beta-reference'
contains
   subroutine check
      values = [beta(x,y),beta(y,x),beta(x+1,y),beta(x,y+1)]
      expected = [reference,reference,x/(x+y)*reference,y/(x+y)*reference]
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(values))) error stop 'nonfinite beta'
      if (any(values <= 0)) error stop 'nonpositive beta'
      max_error = max(max_error,maxval(abs(values/expected-1)))
      if (maxval(abs(values/expected-1)) > 2.e-13_wp) error stop 'independent beta reference'
      cases = cases+1
   end subroutine check
end program beta_reference

name: gams-linalg-inverse-factor-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/inverse-tvd-drivers-MIT.txt.
program inverse_factor_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use linalg_fortran, only: linalg
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(*) = [1,2,3,4,5,8]
   real(dp), parameter :: lower_values(*) = [-.5_dp,.25_dp],upper_values(*) = [-.25_dp,.5_dp]
   real(dp), parameter :: scales(*) = [.5_dp,1._dp,8._dp]
   real(dp), allocatable :: a(:,:),expected(:,:),inverse(:,:),d(:),lower(:,:),upper(:,:),row(:)
   real(dp) :: det_expected,ell,up,fac,max_inverse_error,max_residual,max_det_error
   real(dp) :: singular2(2,2),singular3(3,3)
   integer :: dimension,il,iu,is,n,i,j,k,cases
   cases = 0
   max_inverse_error = 0._dp
   max_residual = 0._dp
   max_det_error = 0._dp
   do dimension = 1,size(sizes)
      n = sizes(dimension)
      allocate(a(n,n),expected(n,n),d(n),lower(n,n),upper(n,n),row(n))
      d = [(real((-1)**(i+1)*(i+1),dp),i=1,n)]
      do il = 1,2
         ell = lower_values(il)
         do iu = 1,2
            up = upper_values(iu)
            lower = 0._dp
            upper = 0._dp
            do i = 1,n
               lower(i,i) = 1._dp
               upper(i,i) = 1._dp
               if (i < n) then
                  lower(i+1,i) = ell
                  upper(i,i+1) = up
               end if
            end do
            do is = 1,size(scales)
               fac = scales(is)
               a = 0._dp
               expected = 0._dp
               do j = 1,n
                  do i = 1,n
                     do k = 1,n
                        a(i,j) = a(i,j)+fac*lower(i,k)*d(k)*upper(k,j)
                     end do
                     do k = max(i,j),n
                        expected(i,j) = expected(i,j)+(-up)**(k-i)*(-ell)**(k-j)/(fac*d(k))
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               det_expected = product(d)*fac**n
               call check
               if (n > 1) then
                  row = a(1,:)
                  a(1,:) = a(n,:)
                  a(n,:) = row
                  row = expected(:,1)
                  expected(:,1) = expected(:,n)
                  expected(:,n) = row
                  det_expected = -det_expected
                  call check
               end if
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,expected,d,lower,upper,row)
   end do
   singular2 = reshape([1._dp,2._dp,2._dp,4._dp],[2,2])
   if (linalg%det(singular2) /= 0) error stop 'singular 2x2 determinant'
   if (linalg%inv(singular2)) error stop 'singular 2x2 accepted'
   singular3 = 0._dp
   singular3(1,1) = 1._dp
   singular3(3,3) = 2._dp
   if (linalg%det(singular3) /= 0) error stop 'singular 3x3 determinant'
   if (linalg%inv(singular3)) error stop 'singular 3x3 accepted'
   if (cases /= 132) error stop 'matrix fixture count'
   print '(a)', '132 scaled/permuted known-factor matrices, dimensions 1,2,3,4,5,8; two singular rejections.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum inverse error / max(1,maxabs(reference)): ',max_inverse_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum independently accumulated left/right inverse residual: ',max_residual
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum determinant relative error: ',max_det_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS linalg-inverse-factor-reference'
contains
   subroutine check
      real(dp) :: determinant,error,left,right,identity
      inverse = a
      if (.not. linalg%inv(inverse)) error stop 'nonsingular inverse status'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(inverse))) error stop 'nonfinite inverse'
      error = maxval(abs(inverse-expected))/max(1._dp,maxval(abs(expected)))
      max_inverse_error = max(max_inverse_error,error)
      if (error > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'closed-form inverse'
      do j = 1,n
         do i = 1,n
            identity = 0._dp
            if (i == j) identity = 1._dp
            left = -identity
            right = -identity
            do k = 1,n
               left = left+a(i,k)*inverse(k,j)
               right = right+inverse(i,k)*a(k,j)
            end do
            max_residual = max(max_residual,abs(left),abs(right))
            if (max(abs(left),abs(right)) > 5.e-12_dp) error stop 'left/right inverse residual'
         end do
      end do
      determinant = linalg%det(a)
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(determinant)) error stop 'nonfinite determinant'
      error = abs(determinant/det_expected-1)
      max_det_error = max(max_det_error,error)
      if (error > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'factor/permutation determinant'
      cases = cases+1
   end subroutine check
end program inverse_factor_reference

name: gams-hrweno-tvd-ode-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/inverse-tvd-drivers-MIT.txt.
module tvd_reference_problem
   use hrweno_kinds, only: rk
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine rhs(t,u,du)
      real(rk), intent(in) :: t,u(:)
      real(rk), intent(out) :: du(:)
      du = [-u(1),-2*u(2),2*t]
   end subroutine rhs
end module tvd_reference_problem

program tvd_ode_reference
   use tvd_reference_problem
   use hrweno_tvdode, only: rktvd
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: steps(*) = [8,16,32,64]
   real(rk), parameter :: finest_bounds(*) = [.01_rk,.0001_rk,.000001_rk]
   type(rktvd) :: solver
   real(rk) :: u(3),time,h,expected(3),errors(4),ratio,lambda,z,polynomial,max_discrete_error
   integer :: order,grid,i,j,n,runs
   runs = 0
   max_discrete_error = 0._rk
   do order = 1,3
      do grid = 1,size(steps)
         n = steps(grid)
         h = 1._rk/n
         solver = rktvd(rhs,3,order=order)
         u = [1._rk,2._rk,0._rk]
         time = 0._rk
         do i = 1,n
            ! Explicit single-step mode avoids the ordinary mode's final-step overshoot policy.
            call solver%integrate(u,time,time+2*h,h,itask=2)
            if (abs(time-real(i,rk)*h) > 1.e-14_rk) error stop 'single-step time'
         end do
         if (solver%istate /= 2 .or. solver%fevals /= order*n) error stop 'TVD state/evaluation count'
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(u))) error stop 'nonfinite ODE solution'
         do j = 1,2
            lambda = real(j,rk)
            z = -lambda*h
            polynomial = 1+z
            if (order >= 2) polynomial = polynomial+z*z/2
            if (order >= 3) polynomial = polynomial+z*z*z/6
            expected(j) = real(j,rk)*polynomial**n
         end do
         expected(3) = 1._rk
         if (order == 1) expected(3) = 1-h
         max_discrete_error = max(max_discrete_error,maxval(abs(u-expected)))
         if (maxval(abs(u-expected)) > 2.e-12_rk) error stop 'independent discrete reference'
         errors(grid) = maxval(abs(u(:2)-[exp(-1._rk),2*exp(-2._rk)]))
         if (.not. ieee_is_finite(errors(grid)) .or. errors(grid) <= 0) error stop 'continuous ODE error'
         if (grid > 1) then
            ratio = errors(grid-1)/errors(grid)
            if (ratio < .7_rk*2**order .or. ratio > 1.5_rk*2**order) error stop 'convergence order'
         end if
         print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,es12.4)', 'Order=',order,' steps=',n,' continuous error=',errors(grid)
         runs = runs+1
      end do
      if (errors(4) > finest_bounds(order)) error stop 'finest-grid error'
   end do
   if (runs /= 12) error stop 'ODE run count'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum error against independent discrete references: ',max_discrete_error
   print '(a)', '12 ODE runs: orders 1..3, exponential decay, nonautonomous forcing and grid convergence.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS hrweno-tvd-ode-reference'
end program tvd_ode_reference

name: gams-fortranlib-quadratic-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/roots-splines-quadrature-drivers-MIT.txt.
program quadratic_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use lib_algebra, only: quadratic
   implicit none
   real(dp), parameter :: roots(*) = [-4._dp,-2._dp,-.5_dp,0._dp,.5_dp,2._dp,4._dp]
   real(dp), parameter :: scales(*) = [-8._dp,-.5_dp,.5_dp,8._dp]
   real(dp) :: a,b,c,x(2),sorted(2),expected(2),residual,max_error,max_residual
   integer :: i,j,k,l,cases
   cases = 0
   max_error = 0._dp
   max_residual = 0._dp
   do i = 1,size(roots)-1
      do j = i+1,size(roots)
         expected = [roots(i),roots(j)]
         do k = 1,size(scales)
            a = scales(k)
            b = -a*sum(expected)
            c = a*product(expected)
            call quadratic(a,b,c,x(1),x(2))
            if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite quadratic roots'
            sorted = [minval(x),maxval(x)]
            max_error = max(max_error,maxval(abs(sorted-expected)))
            if (maxval(abs(sorted-expected)) > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'known distinct roots'
            do l = 1,2
               residual = abs((a*x(l)+b)*x(l)+c)/max(1._dp,abs(a*x(l)*x(l))+abs(b*x(l))+abs(c))
               max_residual = max(max_residual,residual)
               if (residual > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'quadratic normalized residual'
            end do
            if (abs(sum(x)-sum(expected)) > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'root sum'
            if (abs(product(x)-product(expected)) > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'root product'
            cases = cases+1
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (cases /= 84) error stop 'quadratic fixture count'
   print '(a)', '84 quadratics: 21 distinct dyadic root pairs and four positive/negative coefficient scales.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum absolute root error: ',max_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized polynomial residual: ',max_residual
   print '(a)', 'Root order normalized by caller; sums and products checked independently.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortranlib-quadratic-reference'
end program quadratic_reference

name: gams-fortran-utils-spline-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/roots-splines-quadrature-drivers-MIT.txt.
program spline_reference
   use types, only: dp
   use splines, only: spline3ders
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: sizes(*) = [5,9,17,9]
   real(dp), parameter :: coefficients(0:3,4) = reshape([ &
      1._dp,0._dp,0._dp,0._dp, -1._dp,2._dp,0._dp,0._dp, &
      .5_dp,-2._dp,3._dp,0._dp, -1._dp,2._dp,-.5_dp,1._dp],[4,4])
   real(dp), allocatable :: x(:),y(:)
   real(dp) :: q(65),value(65),first(65),second(65),only(65),reference(65,3),errors(3),c(0:3)
   integer :: grid,polynomial,i,n,cases
   q = [(-1._dp+real(i,dp)/32,i=0,64)]
   errors = 0._dp
   cases = 0
   do grid = 1,4
      n = sizes(grid)
      allocate(x(n),y(n))
      x = [(-1._dp+2*real(i,dp)/(n-1),i=0,n-1)]
      if (grid == 4) x = [-1._dp,-.875_dp,-.625_dp,-.25_dp,0._dp,.1875_dp,.5_dp,.75_dp,1._dp]
      do polynomial = 1,4
         c = coefficients(:,polynomial)
         y = ((c(3)*x+c(2))*x+c(1))*x+c(0)
         reference(:,1) = ((c(3)*q+c(2))*q+c(1))*q+c(0)
         reference(:,2) = (3*c(3)*q+2*c(2))*q+c(1)
         reference(:,3) = 6*c(3)*q+2*c(2)
         call spline3ders(x,y,q,value,first,second)
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(value)) .or. .not. all(ieee_is_finite(first)) &
            .or. .not. all(ieee_is_finite(second))) error stop 'nonfinite spline values/derivatives'
         errors = max(errors,[maxval(abs(value-reference(:,1))),maxval(abs(first-reference(:,2))), &
            maxval(abs(second-reference(:,3)))])
         if (any(errors > 5.e-10_dp)) error stop 'polynomial spline reproduction'
         call spline3ders(x,y,q,dynew=only)
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(only)) .or. maxval(abs(only-first)) > 5.e-12_dp) &
            error stop 'first derivative optional output'
         call spline3ders(x,y,q,d2ynew=only)
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(only)) .or. maxval(abs(only-second)) > 5.e-12_dp) &
            error stop 'second derivative optional output'
         call spline3ders(x,y,q(65:1:-1),ynew=only)
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(only)) .or. maxval(abs(only-value(65:1:-1))) > 5.e-12_dp) &
            error stop 'reversed query order and value-only output'
         cases = cases+1
      end do
      deallocate(x,y)
   end do
   if (cases /= 16) error stop 'spline fixture count'
   print '(a)', '16 polynomial/grid fixtures, 65 queries each, 3120 value/derivative references.'
   print '(a,3es12.4)', 'Maximum errors: value, first derivative, second derivative: ',errors
   print '(a)', 'Uniform/nonuniform knots, endpoints, optional outputs and reversed query order checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortran-utils-spline-reference'
end program spline_reference

name: gams-scifortran-quadrature-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/roots-splines-quadrature-drivers-MIT.txt.
module quadrature_reference_functions
   implicit none
   integer :: degree
   real(8) :: rate
contains
   real(8) function polynomial(t)
      real(8) :: t
      polynomial = t**degree
   end function polynomial
   real(8) function decay(t)
      real(8) :: t
      decay = exp(-rate*t)
   end function decay
   real(8) function gaussian(t)
      real(8) :: t
      gaussian = exp(-t*t)
   end function gaussian
   real(8) function cauchy(t)
      real(8) :: t
      cauchy = 1/(1+t*t)
   end function cauchy
   real(8) function root(t)
      real(8) :: t
      root = sqrt(t)
   end function root
   real(8) function inverse_root(t)
      real(8) :: t
      inverse_root = 1/sqrt(t)
   end function inverse_root
end module quadrature_reference_functions

program quadrature_reference
   use quadrature_reference_functions
   use SF_INTEGRATE, only: simps,trapz,quad
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: counts(*) = [5,8,9,16,17]
   real(8), parameter :: starts(*) = [-1.d0,0.d0,-.5d0],ends(*) = [1.d0,1.d0,1.5d0]
