   real(8), parameter :: rates(*) = [.5d0,1.d0,2.d0]
   real(8), allocatable :: x(:),y(:)
   real(8) :: a,b,h,exact,trapezoid_exact,value,max_sample_error,max_quad_error
   integer :: interval,grid,n,i,key,j,sample_cases,quad_calls
   sample_cases = 0
   quad_calls = 0
   max_sample_error = 0.d0
   max_quad_error = 0.d0
   do interval = 1,3
      a = starts(interval)
      b = ends(interval)
      do grid = 1,size(counts)
         n = counts(grid)
         h = (b-a)/(n-1)
         allocate(x(n),y(n))
         x = [(a+real(i,8)*h,i=0,n-1)]
         do degree = 0,3
            y = x**degree
            exact = (b**(degree+1)-a**(degree+1))/(degree+1)
            trapezoid_exact = exact
            if (degree == 2) trapezoid_exact = exact+(b-a)*h*h/6
            if (degree == 3) trapezoid_exact = exact+(b*b-a*a)*h*h/4
            call check(simps(y,a,b),exact,2.d-12,max_sample_error)
            call check(simps(y,h),exact,2.d-12,max_sample_error)
            call check(trapz(y,a,b),trapezoid_exact,2.d-12,max_sample_error)
            call check(trapz(y,h),trapezoid_exact,2.d-12,max_sample_error)
            sample_cases = sample_cases+1
         end do
         deallocate(x,y)
      end do
      do degree = 0,7
         exact = (b**(degree+1)-a**(degree+1))/(degree+1)
         do key = 0,6
            if (key == 0) then
               call quad(polynomial,a,b,epsabs=1.d-11,epsrel=1.d-11,result=value)
            else
               call quad(polynomial,a,b,key=key,epsabs=1.d-11,epsrel=1.d-11,result=value)
            end if
            call checked_quad(exact)
         end do
      end do
   end do
   do i = 1,size(rates)
      rate = rates(i)
      do j = 0,1
         a = real(j,8)
         call quad(decay,a,inf=1,epsabs=1.d-11,epsrel=1.d-11,result=value)
         call checked_quad(exp(-rate*a)/rate)
      end do
   end do
   call quad(gaussian,0.d0,inf=2,epsabs=1.d-11,epsrel=1.d-11,result=value)
   call checked_quad(sqrt(acos(-1.d0)))
   call quad(cauchy,0.d0,inf=2,epsabs=1.d-11,epsrel=1.d-11,result=value)
   call checked_quad(acos(-1.d0))
   call quad(root,0.d0,1.d0,singular_endpoint=.true.,epsabs=1.d-11,epsrel=1.d-11,result=value)
   call checked_quad(2.d0/3)
   call quad(inverse_root,0.d0,1.d0,singular_endpoint=.true.,epsabs=1.d-11,epsrel=1.d-11,result=value)
   call checked_quad(2.d0)
   if (sample_cases /= 60 .or. quad_calls /= 178) error stop 'quadrature fixture count'
   print '(a)', '60 sampled-polynomial cases, 240 Simpson/trapezoid calls, even/odd panel counts.'
   print '(a)', '178 adaptive calls: polynomial rules, exponential tails, whole-line and endpoint-singular integrals.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized sampled-rule reference error: ',max_sample_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized adaptive closed-form error: ',max_quad_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS scifortran-quadrature-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,reference,tolerance,maximum)
      real(8), intent(in) :: actual,reference,tolerance
      real(8), intent(inout) :: maximum
      real(8) :: error
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'nonfinite integral'
      error = abs(actual-reference)/max(1.d0,abs(reference))
      maximum = max(maximum,error)
      if (error > tolerance) error stop 'independent quadrature reference'
   end subroutine check
   subroutine checked_quad(reference)
      real(8), intent(in) :: reference
      call check(value,reference,5.d-11,max_quad_error)
      quad_calls = quad_calls+1
   end subroutine checked_quad
end program quadrature_reference

name: gams-io-numeric-file-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/io-bounds-drivers-MIT.txt.
program numeric_file_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use io_fortran_lib, only: to_file,from_file
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dimensions(2,4) = reshape([1,1,2,3,4,2,3,4],[2,4])
   character, parameter :: separators(*) = [',',';']
   real(dp), allocatable :: values(:,:),loaded(:,:),row(:)
   real(dp) :: native_expected(4,3),max_error
   character(512) :: message
   character(2048) :: line
   integer :: unit,status,shape_case,separator,i,j,rows,cols,cases,k
   max_error = 0._dp
   cases = 0
   do shape_case = 1,4
      rows = dimensions(1,shape_case)
      cols = dimensions(2,shape_case)
      allocate(values(rows,cols),row(cols))
      do j = 1,cols
         do i = 1,rows
            values(i,j) = real(10*i-7*j,dp)/8
         end do
      end do
      values(1,1) = 0._dp
      do separator = 1,2
         call to_file(values,'gams-io-output.csv',delim=separators(separator),fmt='e',stat=status,errmsg=message)
         if (status /= 0) error stop 'library numeric write status'
         ! Independent native reader verifies row orientation, delimiter and values.
         open(newunit=unit,file='gams-io-output.csv',status='old',action='read',iostat=status)
         if (status /= 0) error stop 'native output open'
         do i = 1,rows
            read(unit,'(a)',iostat=status) line
            if (status /= 0) error stop 'missing numeric output row'
            if (count([(line(k:k)==separators(separator),k=1,len_trim(line))]) /= cols-1) &
               error stop 'output column delimiter count'
            do k = 1,len_trim(line)
               if (line(k:k) == separators(separator)) line(k:k) = ' '
            end do
            read(line,*,iostat=status) row
            if (status /= 0) error stop 'native output numeric parse'
            call compare(row,values(i,:))
         end do
         read(unit,'(a)',iostat=status) line
         if (status >= 0) error stop 'extra numeric output row'
         close(unit)
         call from_file('gams-io-output.csv',into=loaded,delim=separators(separator),stat=status,errmsg=message)
         if (status /= 0) error stop 'library numeric read status'
         if (.not. allocated(loaded)) error stop 'missing numeric read allocation'
         if (any(shape(loaded) /= shape(values))) error stop 'numeric read dimensions'
         do i = 1,rows
            call compare(loaded(i,:),values(i,:))
         end do
         deallocate(loaded)
         open(newunit=unit,file='gams-io-output.csv',status='old')
         close(unit,status='delete')
         cases = cases+1
      end do
      deallocate(values,row)
   end do
   ! This fixture is written without the library, so reader/writer mistakes cannot cancel.
   native_expected = reshape([1.25_dp,0._dp,-8._dp,.125_dp, &
      -2.5_dp,4._dp,.5_dp,-.25_dp, 0._dp,-.75_dp,16._dp,2._dp],[4,3])
   open(newunit=unit,file='gams-io-native.csv',status='replace',action='write',iostat=status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'native CSV creation'
   write(unit,'(a)') '1.25,-2.5,0.0','0.0,4.0,-0.75','-8.0,0.5,16.0','0.125,-0.25,2.0'
   close(unit)
   call from_file('gams-io-native.csv',into=loaded,delim=',',stat=status,errmsg=message)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'native CSV library read'
   if (.not. allocated(loaded)) error stop 'native CSV allocation'
   if (any(shape(loaded) /= [4,3])) error stop 'native CSV shape'
   do i = 1,4
      call compare(loaded(i,:),native_expected(i,:))
   end do
   deallocate(loaded)
   open(newunit=unit,file='gams-io-native.csv',status='old')
   close(unit,status='delete')
   call from_file('gams-io-missing.csv',into=loaded,stat=status,errmsg=message)
   if (status == 0 .or. len_trim(message) == 0) error stop 'missing-file error status/message'
   if (cases /= 8) error stop 'numeric file fixture count'
   print '(a)', '8 real64 matrix files: four shapes, comma/semicolon delimiters, independent native parsing.'
   print '(a)', 'Hand-written CSV, row/column layout, library round trips and missing-file diagnostics checked.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized numeric file error: ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS io-numeric-file-reference'
contains
   subroutine compare(actual,reference)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: actual(:),reference(:)
      real(dp) :: error
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(actual))) error stop 'nonfinite numeric file data'
      error = maxval(abs(actual-reference)/max(1._dp,abs(reference)))
      max_error = max(max_error,error)
      if (error > 5.e-14_dp) error stop 'independent numeric file reference'
   end subroutine compare
end program numeric_file_reference

name: gams-error-bounds-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/io-bounds-drivers-MIT.txt.
program bounds_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: sp => real32,dp => real64
   use ErrorCriteriaModule, only: ErrorCriteria
   use ErrorInstanceModule, only: ErrorInstance
   implicit none
   type(ErrorCriteria) :: handler
   type(ErrorInstance) :: problem
   real(sp) :: single(11),s
   real(dp) :: double(11),d
   integer :: i,cases,rejections
   call handler%init(bashColors=.false.)
   cases = 0
   rejections = 0
   do i = -4,4
      problem = handler%limit(i,-2,2,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(i >= -2 .and. i <= 2)
      problem = handler%limit(i,lbound=-2,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(i >= -2)
      problem = handler%limit(i,ubound=2,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(i <= 2)
   end do
   single(:7) = [(-3._sp+real(i,sp),i=0,6)]
   double(:7) = [(-3._dp+real(i,dp),i=0,6)]
   single(8:) = [nearest(-2._sp,-1._sp),nearest(-2._sp,1._sp),nearest(2._sp,-1._sp),nearest(2._sp,1._sp)]
   double(8:) = [nearest(-2._dp,-1._dp),nearest(-2._dp,1._dp),nearest(2._dp,-1._dp),nearest(2._dp,1._dp)]
   do i = 1,11
      s = single(i)
      d = double(i)
      problem = handler%limit(s,-2._sp,2._sp,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(s >= -2 .and. s <= 2)
      problem = handler%limit(s,lbound=-2._sp,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(s >= -2)
      problem = handler%limit(s,ubound=2._sp,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(s <= 2)
      problem = handler%limit(d,-2._dp,2._dp,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(d >= -2 .and. d <= 2)
      problem = handler%limit(d,lbound=-2._dp,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(d >= -2)
      problem = handler%limit(d,ubound=2._dp,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(d <= 2)
   end do
   do i = -1,1
      problem = handler%limit(i,0,0,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(i == 0)
      s = real(i,sp)*epsilon(1._sp)
      problem = handler%limit(s,0._sp,0._sp,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(s == 0)
      d = real(i,dp)*epsilon(1._dp)
      problem = handler%limit(d,0._dp,0._dp,message='bounded input',traceMessage='check_data')
      call check(d == 0)
   end do
   if (cases /= 102 .or. rejections /= 30) error stop 'bounds case count'
   print '(a)', '102 integer/real32/real64 bounds checks; 30 expected rejections.'
   print '(a)', 'Inclusive endpoints, nearest inside/outside floats, one-sided and equal bounds checked.'
   print '(a)', 'Expected failures retain code 105, the custom message and one application trace.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS error-bounds-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(accepted)
      logical, intent(in) :: accepted
      if (problem%isError() .eqv. accepted) error stop 'native comparison reference'
      if (accepted) then
         if (problem%code /= 0) error stop 'success code'
      else
         if (problem%code /= 105) error stop 'bounds failure code'
         if (index(problem%message,'bounded input') /= 1) error stop 'bounds custom message'
         if (.not. allocated(problem%trace)) error stop 'missing bounds trace'
         if (size(problem%trace) /= 1) error stop 'bounds trace size'
         if (trim(problem%trace(1)) /= 'check_data') error stop 'bounds trace content'
         rejections = rejections+1
      end if
      cases = cases+1
   end subroutine check
end program bounds_reference

name: gams-fortimize-nelder-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/optimization-spacing-drivers-MIT.txt.
module nelder_reference_problem
   use ForTimize, only: pr
   implicit none
   type :: problem_data
      logical :: rosenbrock = .false.
      real(pr) :: center(5) = 0._pr
   end type problem_data
contains
   subroutine objective(x,f,df,data)
      real(pr), intent(in) :: x(:)
      real(pr), intent(out) :: f
      real(pr), optional, intent(out) :: df(:)
      class(*), optional, intent(inout) :: data
      real(pr) :: e(size(x)),mixed(size(x))
      integer :: i
      if (present(df)) error stop 'unexpected derivative request'
      if (.not. present(data)) error stop 'missing objective data'
      select type(data)
      type is(problem_data)
         if (data%rosenbrock) then
            f = (1-x(1))**2+100*(x(2)-x(1)**2)**2
         else
            e = x-data%center(:size(x))
            mixed = e
            mixed(:size(x)-1) = e(:size(x)-1)+.25_pr*e(2:)
            f = sum([(real(i,pr)*mixed(i)**2,i=1,size(x))])
         end if
      class default
         error stop 'objective data type'
      end select
   end subroutine objective
end module nelder_reference_problem

program nelder_reference
   use nelder_reference_problem
   use ForTimize, only: NelderMead,minimize
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: dimensions(*) = [2,3,5]
   type(NelderMead) :: solver
   type(problem_data), target :: data
   real(pr), allocatable :: x(:),expected(:)
   real(pr) :: f,reference,error,term,max_position_error,max_objective
   integer :: dimension,start,n,i,runs
   runs = 0
   max_position_error = 0._pr
   max_objective = 0._pr
   do dimension = 1,3
      n = dimensions(dimension)
      allocate(x(n),expected(n))
      expected = [(real((-1)**i*i,pr)/2,i=1,n)]
      data%center(:n) = expected
      data%rosenbrock = .false.
      do start = 1,3
         select case(start)
         case(1)
            x = expected-3
         case(2)
            x = expected+[(real((-1)**i*2,pr),i=1,n)]
         case(3)
            x = expected+4
         end select
         call solve
      end do
      deallocate(x,expected)
   end do
   allocate(x(2),expected(2))
   expected = 1._pr
   data%rosenbrock = .true.
   do start = 1,3
      select case(start)
      case(1)
         x = [-1.2_pr,1._pr]
      case(2)
         x = [0._pr,0._pr]
      case(3)
         x = [2._pr,2._pr]
      end select
      call solve
   end do
   if (runs /= 12) error stop 'optimization case count'
   print '(a)', '12 derivative-free solves: coupled quadratics in 2/3/5 variables and Rosenbrock, three starts each.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum coordinate error versus known minimizer: ',max_position_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum returned objective: ',max_objective
   print '(a)', 'PASS fortimize-nelder-reference'
contains
   subroutine solve
      solver%convergence_tolerance = 1.e-20_pr
      solver%konvge = 20
      solver%kcount = 50000
      solver%step = [( .4_pr,i=1,size(x))]
      call minimize(objective,x,f,solver,data=data)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x)) .or. .not. ieee_is_finite(f)) error stop 'nonfinite optimizer output'
      if (data%rosenbrock) then
         reference = (x(2)-x(1)*x(1))**2*100+(x(1)-1)**2
      else
         reference = 0._pr
         do i = 1,size(x)
            term = x(i)-expected(i)
            if (i < size(x)) term = term+.25_pr*(x(i+1)-expected(i+1))
            reference = reference+real(i,pr)*term*term
         end do
      end if
      if (abs(f-reference) > 1.e-12_pr) error stop 'returned objective consistency'
      error = maxval(abs(x-expected))
      max_position_error = max(max_position_error,error)
      max_objective = max(max_objective,f)
      if (error > 2.e-4_pr .or. f < 0 .or. f > 1.e-8_pr) error stop 'known optimum reference'
      runs = runs+1
      print '(a,i0,a,l1,a,es12.4)', 'Variables=',size(x),' Rosenbrock=',data%rosenbrock,' coordinate error=',error
   end subroutine solve
end program nelder_reference

name: gams-pointsets-spacing-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/optimization-spacing-drivers-MIT.txt.
program spacing_reference
   use select_precision, only: wp
   use pointsets, only: arithmetic_spacing,geometric_spacing
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: counts(*) = [2,3,5,9,17]
   real(wp), parameter :: starts(*) = [0._wp,-2._wp,3._wp,1._wp],ends(*) = [1._wp,3._wp,-2._wp,1._wp]
   real(wp), parameter :: ratios(*) = [.5_wp,.75_wp,1.25_wp,2._wp]
   real(wp) :: singleton(1),empty(0),guard(5),before(5)
   real(wp), allocatable :: x(:)
   real(dp), allocatable :: expected(:)
   real(dp) :: a,b,q,error,max_error,tolerance
   integer :: grid,interval,ratio,n,i,arithmetic_calls,geometric_calls,guards
   arithmetic_calls = 0
   geometric_calls = 0
   guards = 0
   max_error = 0._dp
   tolerance = 32*real(epsilon(1._wp),dp)
   do grid = 1,size(counts)
      n = counts(grid)
      allocate(x(n),expected(n))
      do interval = 1,4
         a = real(starts(interval),dp)
         b = real(ends(interval),dp)
         expected = [(a+(b-a)*real(i,dp)/(n-1),i=0,n-1)]
         call arithmetic_spacing(x,starts(interval),ends(interval))
         call check
         arithmetic_calls = arithmetic_calls+1
         do ratio = 1,4
            q = real(ratios(ratio),dp)
            expected = [(a+(b-a)*(q**i-1)/(q**(n-1)-1),i=0,n-1)]
            call geometric_spacing(x,starts(interval),ends(interval),ratios(ratio))
            call check
            geometric_calls = geometric_calls+1
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(x,expected)
   end do
   ! Guarded inputs are no-ops at this pin, rather than requests for a filled grid.
   singleton = 7._wp
   call arithmetic_spacing(singleton,0._wp,1._wp)
   if (singleton(1) /= 7) error stop 'arithmetic singleton guard'
   call geometric_spacing(singleton,0._wp,1._wp,2._wp)
   if (singleton(1) /= 7) error stop 'geometric singleton guard'
   call arithmetic_spacing(empty,0._wp,1._wp)
   call geometric_spacing(empty,0._wp,1._wp,2._wp)
   guards = 4
   before = [(real(i,wp),i=1,5)]
   do i = -1,1
      guard = before
      call geometric_spacing(guard,0._wp,1._wp,real(i,wp))
      if (any(guard /= before)) error stop 'geometric guarded ratio no-op'
      guards = guards+1
   end do
   if (arithmetic_calls /= 20 .or. geometric_calls /= 80 .or. guards /= 7) error stop 'spacing case count'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Working precision decimal digits: ',precision(1._wp)
   print '(a)', '20 arithmetic and 80 geometric grids; increasing, decreasing and equal endpoints.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized error versus real64 formulas: ',max_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Acceptance tolerance, 32 working-kind epsilons: ',tolerance
   print '(a)', 'Seven empty/singleton/ratio guards checked as unchanged-array behavior.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS pointsets-spacing-reference'
contains
   subroutine check
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite grid'
      error = maxval(abs(real(x,dp)-expected))/max(1._dp,abs(a),abs(b))
      max_error = max(max_error,error)
      if (error > tolerance) error stop 'independent spacing formula'
      if (abs(real(x(1),dp)-a) > tolerance*max(1._dp,abs(a))) error stop 'first endpoint'
      if (abs(real(x(n),dp)-b) > tolerance*max(1._dp,abs(b))) error stop 'last endpoint'
      if (b > a) then
         if (any(x(2:) <= x(:n-1))) error stop 'increasing grid'
      else if (b < a) then
         if (any(x(2:) >= x(:n-1))) error stop 'decreasing grid'
      else
         if (any(x /= starts(interval))) error stop 'constant grid'
      end if
   end subroutine check
end program spacing_reference

name: gams-sdl-raster-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/raster-distributions-drivers-MIT.txt.
program raster_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding, only: c_int,c_int32_t,c_int64_t,c_char,c_null_char,c_f_pointer
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: int8
   use sdl2, only: sdl_surface,sdl_pixel_format,sdl_rect,sdl_init,sdl_quit,sdl_create_rgb_surface, &
      sdl_fill_rect,sdl_map_rgb,sdl_convert_surface,sdl_free_surface
   use sdl2_image, only: img_init,IMG_INIT_PNG,img_load,img_quit
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: width=85,height=65
   integer, parameter :: boxes(4,4) = reshape([10,15,45,30,35,25,40,35,-15,-10,35,30,70,50,40,35],[4,4])
   integer, parameter :: rgb(3,5) = reshape([12,34,56,240,20,60,30,200,80,40,70,230,250,220,15],[3,5])
   type(sdl_surface), pointer :: surface,loaded,converted
   type(sdl_pixel_format), pointer :: format
   type(sdl_rect) :: rectangle
   integer(c_int32_t) :: expected(width,height)
   integer(int8) :: header(24)
   integer :: i,x,y,color,status,unit,checks
   interface
      ! The pinned bindings omit this standard SDL2_image save declaration.
      function save_png(image,name) bind(c,name='IMG_SavePNG') result(rc)
         import sdl_surface,c_char,c_int
         type(sdl_surface), intent(in) :: image
         character(c_char), intent(in) :: name(*)
         integer(c_int) :: rc
      end function save_png
   end interface
   if (sdl_init(0) /= 0) error stop 'SDL initialization'
   if (iand(img_init(IMG_INIT_PNG),IMG_INIT_PNG) == 0) error stop 'PNG initialization'
   surface => sdl_create_rgb_surface(0,width,height,32,int(z'00FF0000',c_int64_t), &
      int(z'0000FF00',c_int64_t),int(z'000000FF',c_int64_t),0_c_int64_t)
   if (.not. associated(surface)) error stop 'software surface creation'
   call c_f_pointer(surface%format,format)
   if (.not. associated(format)) error stop 'surface pixel format'
   rectangle = sdl_rect(0,0,width,height)
   status = sdl_fill_rect(surface,rectangle,sdl_map_rgb(format,rgb(1,1),rgb(2,1),rgb(3,1)))
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'background fill'
   do i = 1,4
      rectangle = sdl_rect(boxes(1,i),boxes(2,i),boxes(3,i),boxes(4,i))
      status = sdl_fill_rect(surface,rectangle,sdl_map_rgb(format,rgb(1,i+1),rgb(2,i+1),rgb(3,i+1)))
      if (status /= 0) error stop 'rectangle fill'
   end do
   do y = 0,height-1
      do x = 0,width-1
         color = 1
         do i = 1,4
            if (x >= boxes(1,i) .and. x < boxes(1,i)+boxes(3,i) &
               .and. y >= boxes(2,i) .and. y < boxes(2,i)+boxes(4,i)) color = i+1
         end do
         ! Native mask arithmetic supplies the expected pixel; no SDL mapping call.
         expected(x+1,y+1) = ior(ishft(int(rgb(1,color),c_int32_t),16), &
            ior(ishft(int(rgb(2,color),c_int32_t),8),int(rgb(3,color),c_int32_t)))
      end do
   end do
   checks = 0
   call check_pixels(surface)
   status = save_png(surface,'gams-sdl-raster.png'//c_null_char)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'PNG export'
   open(newunit=unit,file='gams-sdl-raster.png',access='stream',form='unformatted',status='old',iostat=status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'native PNG open'
   read(unit,iostat=status) header
   close(unit)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'native PNG header read'
   if (any(iand(int(header(:8)),255) /= [137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10])) error stop 'PNG signature'
   if (any(iand(int(header(13:16)),255) /= [73,72,68,82])) error stop 'PNG IHDR chunk'
   if (big_endian(header(17:20)) /= width .or. big_endian(header(21:24)) /= height) &
      error stop 'independent PNG dimensions'
   loaded => img_load('gams-sdl-raster.png'//c_null_char)
   if (.not. associated(loaded)) error stop 'PNG import'
   if (loaded%w /= width .or. loaded%h /= height) error stop 'imported PNG dimensions'
   converted => sdl_convert_surface(loaded,format,0)
   if (.not. associated(converted)) error stop 'standard pixel format conversion'
   call check_pixels(converted)
   call sdl_free_surface(converted)
   call sdl_free_surface(loaded)
   call sdl_free_surface(surface)
   nullify(converted,loaded,surface,format)
   call img_quit()
   call sdl_quit()
   if (checks /= 11050) error stop 'raster pixel count'
   print '(a)', '85x65 software surface: four overlapping/clipped rectangles and five known colors.'
   print '(a)', '11050 exact pixel references checked before and after PNG save/load.'
   print '(a)', 'Native PNG signature/dimensions checked; generated image is available for browser display.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS sdl-raster-reference'
contains
   subroutine check_pixels(image)
      type(sdl_surface), intent(in) :: image
      integer(c_int32_t), pointer :: pixels(:)
      integer :: ix,iy,index
      if (image%w /= width .or. image%h /= height .or. mod(image%pitch,4) /= 0) &
         error stop '32-bit image geometry'
      call c_f_pointer(image%pixels,pixels,[image%pitch*image%h/4])
      if (.not. associated(pixels)) error stop 'image pixels'
      do iy = 0,height-1
         do ix = 0,width-1
            index = iy*(image%pitch/4)+ix+1
            if (iand(pixels(index),int(z'00FFFFFF',c_int32_t)) /= expected(ix+1,iy+1)) &
               error stop 'independent raster reference'
            checks = checks+1
         end do
      end do
      nullify(pixels)
   end subroutine check_pixels
   integer function big_endian(bytes) result(value)
      integer(int8), intent(in) :: bytes(4)
      integer :: j
      value = 0
      do j = 1,4
         value = 256*value+iand(int(bytes(j)),255)
      end do
   end function big_endian
end program raster_reference

name: gams-rng-distributions-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/raster-distributions-drivers-MIT.txt.
program distributions_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64,int64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use m_random, only: rng_t
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: n=20000,geometry_n=1000
   integer(int64), parameter :: seeds(2,3) = reshape([123456789_int64,987654321_int64, &
      13579_int64,24680_int64,112233_int64,998877_int64],[2,3])
   real(dp), parameter :: rates(*) = [.5_dp,2._dp,8._dp],radii(*) = [.25_dp,1._dp,3._dp]
   integer :: run
   do run = 1,3
      call moments(seeds(:,run),rates(run))
      call geometry(seeds(:,run),radii(run))
   end do
   print '(a)', '60000 normal and 60000 Poisson samples, each replayed exactly with fresh seeded objects.'
   print '(a)', '3000 circle and 3000 sphere samples: exact replay, analytic norms and broad coordinate moments.'
   print '(a)', 'Fixed-seed smoke checks do not certify statistical quality or cryptographic safety.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS rng-distributions-reference'
contains
   subroutine moments(seed,lambda)
      integer(int64), intent(in) :: seed(2)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: lambda
      type(rng_t), allocatable :: normal_rng,normal_replay,poisson_rng,poisson_replay
      real(dp) :: z,mean_z,second_z,mean_p,centered_p,zero_mass
      integer :: i,p,zeros
      ! Fresh allocations avoid the known cached-normal reseeding behavior at this pin.
      allocate(normal_rng,normal_replay,poisson_rng,poisson_replay)
      call normal_rng%set_seed(seed)
      call normal_replay%set_seed(seed)
      call poisson_rng%set_seed(seed)
      call poisson_replay%set_seed(seed)
      mean_z = 0._dp
      second_z = 0._dp
      mean_p = 0._dp
      centered_p = 0._dp
      zeros = 0
      do i = 1,n
         z = normal_rng%normal()
         if (.not. ieee_is_finite(z)) error stop 'nonfinite normal'
         if (z /= normal_replay%normal()) error stop 'normal fresh-object replay'
         mean_z = mean_z+z
         second_z = second_z+z*z
         p = poisson_rng%poisson(lambda)
         if (p < 0) error stop 'negative Poisson count'
         if (p /= poisson_replay%poisson(lambda)) error stop 'Poisson fresh-object replay'
         mean_p = mean_p+real(p,dp)
         centered_p = centered_p+(real(p,dp)-lambda)**2
         if (p == 0) zeros = zeros+1
      end do
      mean_z = mean_z/n
      second_z = second_z/n
      mean_p = mean_p/n
      centered_p = centered_p/n
      zero_mass = real(zeros,dp)/n
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite([mean_z,second_z,mean_p,centered_p]))) error stop 'nonfinite moments'
      if (abs(mean_z) > .04_dp .or. abs(second_z-1) > .08_dp) error stop 'normal analytic moments'
      if (abs(mean_p-lambda) > .04_dp*max(1._dp,lambda)) error stop 'Poisson analytic mean'
      if (abs(centered_p-lambda) > .12_dp*max(1._dp,lambda)) error stop 'Poisson centered moment'
      if (abs(zero_mass-exp(-lambda)) > .02_dp) error stop 'Poisson analytic zero probability'
      print '(a,f5.2,a,2f10.5)', 'Rate=',lambda,' normal mean/second moment=',mean_z,second_z
      print '(a,3f10.5)', 'Poisson mean/centered moment/zero mass=',mean_p,centered_p,zero_mass
      deallocate(normal_rng,normal_replay,poisson_rng,poisson_replay)
   end subroutine moments
   subroutine geometry(seed,radius)
      integer(int64), intent(in) :: seed(2)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: radius
      type(rng_t), allocatable :: generator,replay
      real(dp) :: xy(2),xyz(3),again2(2),again3(3),mean2(2),mean3(3),second2(2),second3(3),norm_error
      integer :: i
      allocate(generator,replay)
      call generator%set_seed(seed)
      call replay%set_seed(seed)
      mean2 = 0._dp
      mean3 = 0._dp
      second2 = 0._dp
      second3 = 0._dp
      norm_error = 0._dp
      do i = 1,geometry_n
         xy = generator%circle(radius)
         xyz = generator%sphere(radius)
         again2 = replay%circle(radius)
         again3 = replay%sphere(radius)
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(xy)) .or. .not. all(ieee_is_finite(xyz))) error stop 'nonfinite geometry'
         if (any(xy /= again2) .or. any(xyz /= again3)) error stop 'geometric fresh-object replay'
         xy = xy/radius
         xyz = xyz/radius
         norm_error = max(norm_error,abs(sum(xy*xy)-1),abs(sum(xyz*xyz)-1))
         mean2 = mean2+xy
         mean3 = mean3+xyz
         second2 = second2+xy*xy
         second3 = second3+xyz*xyz
      end do
      if (norm_error > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'analytic circle/sphere radius'
      if (maxval(abs(mean2/geometry_n)) > .15_dp .or. maxval(abs(mean3/geometry_n)) > .15_dp) &
         error stop 'geometric coordinate means'
      if (maxval(abs(second2/geometry_n-.5_dp)) > .12_dp &
         .or. maxval(abs(second3/geometry_n-1._dp/3)) > .12_dp) error stop 'geometric coordinate moments'
      print '(a,f5.2,a,es12.4)', 'Radius=',radius,' maximum normalized norm error=',norm_error
      deallocate(generator,replay)
   end subroutine geometry
end program distributions_reference

name: gams-quaff-quantity-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/quantities-spherical-drivers-MIT.txt.
program quantity_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use quaff, only: length_t,time_t,speed_t,METERS,CENTIMETERS,MILLIMETERS,FEET,INCHES, &
      SECONDS,MINUTES,HOURS,METERS_PER_SECOND,FEET_PER_SECOND,operator(.unit.), &
      operator(/),operator(*),operator(+),operator(-),quantity_abs=>abs,quantity_sum=>sum
   implicit none
   real(dp), parameter :: lengths(*) = [-8._dp,-.125_dp,0._dp,.25_dp,3._dp,1000._dp]
   real(dp), parameter :: times(*) = [.25_dp,1._dp,10._dp]
   type(length_t) :: distance,other,converted,quantities(3)
   type(time_t) :: duration
   type(speed_t) :: speed
   real(dp) :: v,t,max_error
   integer :: i,j,cases
   max_error = 0._dp
   cases = 0
   do i = 1,size(lengths)
      v = lengths(i)
      distance = v.unit.METERS
      call check(distance.in.METERS,v)
      call check(distance.in.CENTIMETERS,100*v)
      call check(distance.in.MILLIMETERS,1000*v)
      call check(distance.in.FEET,v/.3048_dp)
      call check(distance.in.INCHES,v/.0254_dp)
      converted = v.unit.FEET
      call check(converted.in.METERS,.3048_dp*v)
      call check(converted.in.INCHES,12*v)
      converted = v.unit.INCHES
      call check(converted.in.METERS,.0254_dp*v)
      converted = v.unit.CENTIMETERS
      call check(converted.in.METERS,.01_dp*v)
      converted = v.unit.MILLIMETERS
      call check(converted.in.METERS,.001_dp*v)
      other = (2*v+.5_dp).unit.METERS
      call check((distance+other).in.METERS,3*v+.5_dp)
      call check((distance-other).in.METERS,-v-.5_dp)
      call check((-distance).in.METERS,-v)
      call check((2._dp*distance).in.METERS,2*v)
      call check((distance/4._dp).in.METERS,v/4)
      call check(distance/(2._dp.unit.METERS),v/2)
      call check(quantity_abs(distance).in.METERS,abs(v))
      quantities = [distance,other,-distance]
      call check(quantity_sum(quantities).in.METERS,2*v+.5_dp)
      speed = v.unit.FEET_PER_SECOND
      call check(speed.in.METERS_PER_SECOND,.3048_dp*v)
      do j = 1,size(times)
         t = times(j)
         duration = t.unit.SECONDS
         speed = distance/duration
         call check(speed.in.METERS_PER_SECOND,v/t)
         call check(speed.in.FEET_PER_SECOND,v/t/.3048_dp)
         converted = speed*duration
         call check(converted.in.METERS,v)
      end do
   end do
   do j = 1,size(times)
      t = times(j)
      duration = t.unit.SECONDS
      call check(duration.in.MINUTES,t/60)
      call check(duration.in.HOURS,t/3600)
      duration = t.unit.MINUTES
      call check(duration.in.SECONDS,t*60)
      duration = t.unit.HOURS
      call check(duration.in.SECONDS,t*3600)
   end do
   if (cases /= 180) error stop 'quantity fixture count'
   print '(a)', '180 numeric references: signed/zero lengths, five units, time conversions and typed arithmetic.'
   print '(a)', 'Length/time speed and speed*time length checked against scalar SI formulas.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum error / max(1,abs(reference)): ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS quaff-quantity-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,reference)
      real(dp), intent(in) :: actual,reference
      real(dp) :: error
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'nonfinite quantity result'
      error = abs(actual-reference)/max(1._dp,abs(reference))
      max_error = max(max_error,error)
      if (error > 2.e-12_dp) error stop 'independent quantity reference'
      cases = cases+1
   end subroutine check
end program quantity_reference

name: gams-spherepack-zonal-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/quantities-spherical-drivers-MIT.txt.
program zonal_reference
   use spherepack, only: GaussianSphere,wp,ip
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(ip), parameter :: latitudes(*) = [9,13,17],longitudes(*) = [16,24,32]
   type(GaussianSphere) :: globe
   real(wp), allocatable :: field(:,:),synthesized(:,:),z(:,:),expected_a(:,:)
   real(wp) :: amplitudes(0:4),max_coefficient_error,max_round_trip_error,max_injected_error,error
   integer :: grid,fixture,nlat,nlon,l,m,i,j,cases
   max_coefficient_error = 0._wp
   max_round_trip_error = 0._wp
   max_injected_error = 0._wp
   cases = 0
   do grid = 1,3
      nlat = latitudes(grid)
      nlon = longitudes(grid)
      globe = GaussianSphere(nlat,nlon)
      allocate(field(nlat,nlon),synthesized(nlat,nlon),z(nlat,nlon),expected_a(nlat,nlat))
      do j = 1,nlon
         do i = 1,nlat
            z(i,j) = globe%unit_vectors%radial(i,j)%z
         end do
      end do
      do fixture = 0,5
         amplitudes = 0._wp
         if (fixture <= 4) then
            amplitudes(fixture) = 1._wp
         else
            amplitudes = [1._wp,-2._wp,.5_wp,.25_wp,-.75_wp]
         end if
         field = amplitudes(0)+amplitudes(1)*z+amplitudes(2)*(3*z*z-1)/2 &
            +amplitudes(3)*(5*z**3-3*z)/2+amplitudes(4)*(35*z**4-30*z*z+3)/8
         expected_a = 0._wp
         do l = 0,4
            ! Spherepack's m=0 half-weight and normalized Legendre basis.
            expected_a(1,l+1) = 2*sqrt(2._wp/real(2*l+1,wp))*amplitudes(l)
         end do
         globe%workspace%scalar_coefficients%real_component = 0._wp
         globe%workspace%scalar_coefficients%imaginary_component = 0._wp
         call globe%perform_scalar_analysis(field)
         do l = 0,nlat-1
            do m = 0,min(l,(nlon-1)/2)
               error = abs(globe%workspace%scalar_coefficients%real_component(m+1,l+1)-expected_a(m+1,l+1))
               if (.not. ieee_is_finite(error)) error stop 'nonfinite real harmonic coefficient'
               max_coefficient_error = max(max_coefficient_error,error)
               error = abs(globe%workspace%scalar_coefficients%imaginary_component(m+1,l+1))
               if (.not. ieee_is_finite(error)) error stop 'nonfinite imaginary harmonic coefficient'
               max_coefficient_error = max(max_coefficient_error,error)
            end do
         end do
         if (max_coefficient_error > 2.e-11_wp) error stop 'independent Legendre coefficient reference'
         call globe%perform_scalar_synthesis(synthesized)
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(synthesized))) error stop 'nonfinite spherical round trip'
         max_round_trip_error = max(max_round_trip_error,maxval(abs(synthesized-field)))
         if (max_round_trip_error > 2.e-11_wp) error stop 'spherical round trip'
         ! Erase the analyzed data: independently inject exact coefficients before synthesis.
         globe%workspace%scalar_coefficients%real_component = expected_a
         globe%workspace%scalar_coefficients%imaginary_component = 0._wp
         call globe%perform_scalar_synthesis(synthesized)
         if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(synthesized))) error stop 'nonfinite injected synthesis'
         max_injected_error = max(max_injected_error,maxval(abs(synthesized-field)))
         if (max_injected_error > 2.e-11_wp) error stop 'independent injected coefficient synthesis'
         cases = cases+1
      end do
      call globe%destroy()
      deallocate(field,synthesized,z,expected_a)
   end do
   if (cases /= 18) error stop 'spherical fixture count'
   print '(a)', '18 zonal harmonic fixtures: degrees 0..4 and a mixed field on three Gaussian grids.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized-basis coefficient error: ',max_coefficient_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum analysis/synthesis round-trip error: ',max_round_trip_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum independent coefficient-injection synthesis error: ',max_injected_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS spherepack-zonal-reference'
end program zonal_reference

name: gams-dde-method-steps-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/delay-embedding-drivers-MIT.txt.
module delay_reference_problem
   implicit none
   double precision :: rate,history_value
   logical :: oscillator
contains
   subroutine rhs(t,y,z,dy)
      double precision, intent(in) :: t,y(:),z(:,:)
      double precision, intent(out) :: dy(:)
      if (oscillator) then
         dy(1) = -rate*z(1,1)
      else
         dy(1) = rate*z(1,1)
      end if
   end subroutine rhs
   subroutine history(t,y)
      double precision, intent(in) :: t
      double precision, intent(out) :: y(:)
      if (oscillator) then
         y(1) = sin(rate*t)
      else
         y(1) = history_value
      end if
   end subroutine history
end module delay_reference_problem

program delay_reference
   use delay_reference_problem
   use dde_solver_m, only: dde_set,dde_solver,dde_sol,dde_opts,dde_int,dde_val,release_arrays,release_int
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   double precision, parameter :: delays(*) = [.25d0,1.d0,2.d0],rates(*) = [.5d0,1.d0],histories(*) = [1.d0,-2.d0]
   double precision, parameter :: frequencies(*) = [.5d0,1.d0,2.d0]
   type(dde_sol) :: solution
   type(dde_opts) :: options
   type(dde_int) :: sampled
   double precision :: tau,times(65),expected(65),error,max_error,elapsed
   integer :: delay,coefficient,initial,i,runs
   runs = 0
   max_error = 0.d0
   oscillator = .false.
   do delay = 1,3
      tau = delays(delay)
      do coefficient = 1,2
         rate = rates(coefficient)
         do initial = 1,2
            history_value = histories(initial)
            times = [(real(i,8)*tau/16,i=0,64)]
            expected = history_value*(1+rate*times &
               +rate**2*max(0.d0,times-tau)**2/2 &
               +rate**3*max(0.d0,times-2*tau)**3/6 &
               +rate**4*max(0.d0,times-3*tau)**4/24)
            call solve
         end do
      end do
   end do
   oscillator = .true.
   do coefficient = 1,3
      rate = frequencies(coefficient)
      tau = acos(-1.d0)/(2*rate)
      times = [(real(i,8)*tau/16,i=0,64)]
      expected = sin(rate*times)
      call solve
   end do
   if (runs /= 15) error stop 'delay fixture count'
   print '(a)', '15 delayed solves, 975 dense-output references: method-of-steps polynomials and sinusoidal oscillators.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum error / max(1,abs(reference)): ',max_error
   print '(a)', 'Constant positive delays, signed history scaling, delay knots and interior samples checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS dde-method-steps-reference'
contains
   subroutine solve
      options = dde_set(re=1.d-10,ae=1.d-12,interpolation=.true.)
      elapsed = times(65)
      solution = dde_solver([1,1],rhs,[tau],history,[0.d0,elapsed],options=options)
      if (solution%flag /= 0) error stop 'delay solve status'
      sampled = dde_val(times,solution)
      if (any(shape(sampled%yt) /= [65,1])) error stop 'delay dense-output shape'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(sampled%yt))) error stop 'nonfinite delayed solution'
      error = maxval(abs(sampled%yt(:,1)-expected)/max(1.d0,abs(expected)))
      max_error = max(max_error,error)
      if (error > 2.d-7) error stop 'independent delayed solution'
      print '(a,l1,a,f9.5,a,f6.2,a,es12.4)', 'Oscillator=',oscillator,' delay=',tau,' rate=',rate,' error=',error
      call release_arrays(solution,options)
      call release_int(sampled)
      runs = runs+1
   end subroutine solve
end program delay_reference

name: gams-lua-numeric-embedding-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/delay-embedding-drivers-MIT.txt.
program numeric_embedding_reference
   use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding, only: c_associated
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use lua
   implicit none
   character(*), parameter :: source = &
      'function fact(n) if n<0 then error("negative factorial") end local p=1 '// &
      'for k=2,n do p=p*k end return p end '// &
      'function squares(n) local s=0 for k=1,n do s=s+k*k end return s end '// &
      'function polynomial(n) return (n-3)*(n+2) end '// &
      'function norm(a,b) return math.sqrt(a*a+b*b) end'
   real(lua_number), parameter :: triples(3,5) = reshape([3.d0,4.d0,5.d0,5.d0,12.d0,13.d0, &
      8.d0,15.d0,17.d0,-3.d0,4.d0,5.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0],[3,5])
   type(c_ptr) :: state
   integer(lua_integer) :: factorial,n
   real(lua_number) :: answer,max_real_error
   character(:), allocatable :: message
   integer :: status,i,kind,integer_calls,real_calls
   state = lual_newstate()
   if (.not. c_associated(state)) error stop 'Lua state creation'
   call lual_openlibs(state)
   status = lual_loadstring(state,source)
   if (status /= LUA_OK) error stop 'numeric script load'
   status = lua_pcall(state,0,0,0)
   if (status /= LUA_OK) error stop 'numeric script definition'
   if (lua_gettop(state) /= 0) error stop 'definition stack balance'
   integer_calls = 0
   real_calls = 0
   max_real_error = 0.d0
   factorial = 1_lua_integer
   do i = 0,20
      n = int(i,lua_integer)
      if (i > 0) factorial = factorial*n
      call integer_case('fact',n,factorial)
   end do
   do i = 0,64
      n = int(i,lua_integer)
      call integer_case('squares',n,n*(n+1)*(2*n+1)/6)
   end do
   do i = -20,20
      n = int(i,lua_integer)
      call integer_case('polynomial',n,(n-3)*(n+2))
   end do
   do i = 1,5
      kind = lua_getglobal(state,'norm')
      if (kind /= LUA_TFUNCTION) error stop 'Lua real function type'
      call lua_pushnumber(state,triples(1,i))
      call lua_pushnumber(state,triples(2,i))
      status = lua_pcall(state,2,1,0)
      if (status /= LUA_OK .or. lua_gettop(state) /= 1) error stop 'Lua real return/stack'
      if (lua_isnumber(state,-1) == 0) error stop 'Lua real result type'
      answer = lua_tonumber(state,-1)
      if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer)) error stop 'nonfinite embedded result'
      max_real_error = max(max_real_error,abs(answer-triples(3,i)))
      if (abs(answer-triples(3,i)) > 1.d-12) error stop 'known Pythagorean norm'
      call lua_settop(state,0)
      real_calls = real_calls+1
   end do
   kind = lua_getglobal(state,'fact')
   call lua_pushinteger(state,-1_lua_integer)
   status = lua_pcall(state,1,1,0)
   if (status /= LUA_ERRRUN .or. lua_gettop(state) /= 1) error stop 'expected runtime error'
   message = lua_tostring(state,-1)
   if (.not. allocated(message)) error stop 'missing runtime diagnostic'
   if (index(message,'negative factorial') == 0) error stop 'runtime diagnostic content'
   call lua_settop(state,0)
   status = lual_loadstring(state,'function broken(')
   if (status /= LUA_ERRSYNTAX .or. lua_gettop(state) /= 1) error stop 'expected syntax error'
   message = lua_tostring(state,-1)
   if (.not. allocated(message)) error stop 'missing syntax diagnostic'
   if (len_trim(message) == 0) error stop 'empty syntax diagnostic'
   call lua_settop(state,0)
   call integer_case('fact',6_lua_integer,720_lua_integer)
   if (lua_gettop(state) /= 0) error stop 'final stack balance'
   call lua_close(state)
   if (integer_calls /= 128 .or. real_calls /= 5) error stop 'embedding case count'
   print '(a)', '128 exact integer calls: factorials through 20!, sums of squares, signed polynomials and error recovery.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Five real Pythagorean norm calls, maximum absolute error: ',max_real_error
   print '(a)', 'Return types, stack balance, expected runtime/syntax diagnostics and subsequent state reuse checked.'
   print '(a)', 'PASS lua-numeric-embedding-reference'
contains
   subroutine integer_case(name,value,expected)
      character(*), intent(in) :: name
      integer(lua_integer), intent(in) :: value,expected
      if (lua_gettop(state) /= 0) error stop 'integer call initial stack'
      kind = lua_getglobal(state,name)
      if (kind /= LUA_TFUNCTION) error stop 'Lua integer function type'
      call lua_pushinteger(state,value)
      status = lua_pcall(state,1,1,0)
      if (status /= LUA_OK .or. lua_gettop(state) /= 1) error stop 'Lua integer return/stack'
      if (lua_isinteger(state,-1) == 0) error stop 'Lua integer result type'
      if (lua_tointeger(state,-1) /= expected) error stop 'independent integer reference'
      call lua_settop(state,0)
      integer_calls = integer_calls+1
   end subroutine integer_case
end program numeric_embedding_reference

name: gams-ntpoly-matrix-root-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/matrix-roots-box-drivers-MIT.txt.
program matrix_root_reference
   use mpi, only: MPI_Init_thread,MPI_THREAD_SERIALIZED,MPI_Finalize,MPI_Comm_size,MPI_COMM_WORLD,MPI_SUCCESS
   use DataTypesModule, only: NTREAL
   use ProcessGridModule, only: ConstructProcessGrid,DestructProcessGrid
   use PSMatrixModule, only: Matrix_ps,ConstructEmptyMatrix,FillMatrixFromTripletList, &
      GatherMatrixTripletList,DestructMatrix
   use TripletModule, only: Triplet_r
   use TripletListModule, only: TripletList_r,ConstructTripletList,AppendToTripletList,DestructTripletList
   use SolverParametersModule, only: SolverParameters_t,ConstructSolverParameters,DestructSolverParameters
   use SquareRootSolversModule, only: SquareRoot,InverseSquareRoot
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(NTREAL), parameter :: root_pairs(2,4) = reshape([1._NTREAL,2._NTREAL,1._NTREAL,3._NTREAL, &
      .5_NTREAL,2._NTREAL,2._NTREAL,4._NTREAL],[2,4])
   type(Matrix_ps) :: matrix,root_matrix,inverse_matrix
   type(TripletList_r) :: entries
   type(Triplet_r) :: entry
   type(SolverParameters_t) :: parameters
   real(NTREAL), allocatable :: a(:,:),q(:,:),r(:),root(:,:),inverse_root(:,:),expected(:,:),expected_inverse(:,:)
   real(NTREAL) :: c,s,left,right,product,value,identity,max_error,max_residual,error
   integer :: ierr,provided,processes,n,pair,rotation,i,j,k,l,cases
   call MPI_Init_thread(MPI_THREAD_SERIALIZED,provided,ierr)
   if (ierr /= MPI_SUCCESS .or. provided < MPI_THREAD_SERIALIZED) error stop 'MPI initialization/thread support'
   call MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD,processes,ierr)
   if (ierr /= MPI_SUCCESS .or. processes /= 1) error stop 'one MPI process required'
   call ConstructProcessGrid(MPI_COMM_WORLD,1,1,1)
   cases = 0
   max_error = 0._NTREAL
   max_residual = 0._NTREAL
   do n = 2,3
      allocate(a(n,n),q(n,n),r(n),root(n,n),inverse_root(n,n),expected(n,n),expected_inverse(n,n))
      do pair = 1,4
         r(:2) = root_pairs(:,pair)
         if (n == 3) r(3) = sum(r(:2))/2
         do rotation = 1,3
            select case(rotation)
            case(1)
               c = 1._NTREAL
               s = 0._NTREAL
            case(2)
               c = .6_NTREAL
               s = .8_NTREAL
            case(3)
               c = sqrt(.5_NTREAL)
               s = c
            end select
            q = 0._NTREAL
            q(1,1) = c
            q(1,2) = -s
            q(2,1) = s
            q(2,2) = c
            if (n == 3) q(3,3) = 1._NTREAL
            a = 0._NTREAL
            expected = 0._NTREAL
            expected_inverse = 0._NTREAL
            do j = 1,n
               do i = 1,n
                  do k = 1,n
                     a(i,j) = a(i,j)+q(i,k)*r(k)**2*q(j,k)
                     expected(i,j) = expected(i,j)+q(i,k)*r(k)*q(j,k)
                     expected_inverse(i,j) = expected_inverse(i,j)+q(i,k)/r(k)*q(j,k)
                  end do
               end do
            end do
            call ConstructTripletList(entries)
            do j = 1,n
               do i = 1,n
                  if (a(i,j) == 0) cycle
                  entry%index_row = i
                  entry%index_column = j
                  entry%point_value = a(i,j)
                  call AppendToTripletList(entries,entry)
               end do
            end do
            call ConstructEmptyMatrix(matrix,n)
            call FillMatrixFromTripletList(matrix,entries)
            call DestructTripletList(entries)
            call ConstructSolverParameters(parameters,converge_diff_in=1.e-12_NTREAL,threshold_in=1.e-14_NTREAL, &
               max_iterations_in=200,be_verbose_in=.false.)
            call SquareRoot(matrix,root_matrix,parameters)
            call extract(root_matrix,root)
            call InverseSquareRoot(matrix,inverse_matrix,parameters)
            call extract(inverse_matrix,inverse_root)
            error = max(maxval(abs(root-expected))/max(1._NTREAL,maxval(abs(expected))), &
               maxval(abs(inverse_root-expected_inverse))/max(1._NTREAL,maxval(abs(expected_inverse))))
            max_error = max(max_error,error)
            if (error > 2.e-8_NTREAL) error stop 'known principal matrix functions'
            if (maxval(abs(root-transpose(root))) > 2.e-9_NTREAL &
               .or. maxval(abs(inverse_root-transpose(inverse_root))) > 2.e-9_NTREAL) error stop 'matrix symmetry'
            do j = 1,n
               do i = 1,n
                  identity = 0._NTREAL
                  if (i == j) identity = 1._NTREAL
                  left = -a(i,j)
                  right = -identity
                  product = -identity
                  do k = 1,n
                     left = left+root(i,k)*root(k,j)
                     product = product+root(i,k)*inverse_root(k,j)
                     do l = 1,n
                        right = right+inverse_root(i,k)*a(k,l)*inverse_root(l,j)
                     end do
                  end do
                  value = max(abs(left)/max(1._NTREAL,maxval(abs(a))),abs(right),abs(product))
                  max_residual = max(max_residual,value)
                  if (value > 5.e-8_NTREAL) error stop 'independent matrix-function residual'
               end do
            end do
            print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,i0,a,es12.4)', 'Dimension=',n,' pair=',pair,' rotation=',rotation,' error=',error
            call DestructMatrix(inverse_matrix)
            call DestructMatrix(root_matrix)
            call DestructMatrix(matrix)
            call DestructSolverParameters(parameters)
            cases = cases+1
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,q,r,root,inverse_root,expected,expected_inverse)
   end do
   call DestructProcessGrid()
   call MPI_Finalize(ierr)
   if (ierr /= MPI_SUCCESS .or. cases /= 24) error stop 'MPI finalization/fixture count'
   print '(a)', '24 SPD fixtures, 48 matrix functions: known orthogonal factors and positive square-root eigenvalues.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized closed-form error: ',max_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum independent product residual: ',max_residual
   print '(a)', 'PASS ntpoly-matrix-root-reference'
contains
   subroutine extract(source,dense)
      type(Matrix_ps), intent(in) :: source
      real(NTREAL), intent(out) :: dense(:,:)
      type(TripletList_r) :: list
      integer :: index,row,column
      call GatherMatrixTripletList(source,list)
      dense = 0._NTREAL
      do index = 1,list%CurrentSize
         row = list%data(index)%index_row
         column = list%data(index)%index_column
         if (min(row,column) < 1 .or. max(row,column) > size(dense,1)) error stop 'matrix triplet bounds'
         dense(row,column) = dense(row,column)+list%data(index)%point_value
      end do
      call DestructTripletList(list)
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(dense))) error stop 'nonfinite matrix function'
   end subroutine extract
end program matrix_root_reference

name: gams-qnstop-box-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/matrix-roots-box-drivers-MIT.txt.
module box_reference_problem
   use qnstops_mod, only: r8
   implicit none
   real(r8) :: center(3),weights(3)
contains
   function objective(x,iflag) result(f)
      real(r8), intent(in) :: x(:)
      integer, intent(out) :: iflag
      real(r8) :: f
      f = sum(weights(:size(x))*(x-center(:size(x)))**2)
      iflag = 0
   end function objective
end module box_reference_problem

program box_reference
   use box_reference_problem
   use qnstops_mod, only: qnstops
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer, allocatable :: seed(:)
   real(r8), allocatable :: x(:),expected(:),lower(:),upper(:)
   real(r8) :: minimum,reference,optimum,error,gap,max_error,max_gap
   integer :: fixture,n,seed_size,i,status,iterations,evaluations,runs
   call random_seed(size=seed_size)
   allocate(seed(seed_size))
   runs = 0
   max_error = 0._r8
   max_gap = 0._r8
   do fixture = 1,4
      n = 2
      if (fixture == 4) n = 3
      allocate(x(n),expected(n),lower(n),upper(n))
      lower = -2._r8
      upper = 2._r8
      weights = [1._r8,2._r8,3._r8]
      center = [.25_r8,-.5_r8,0._r8]
      select case(fixture)
      case(1)
         x = [-1.5_r8,1.5_r8]
      case(2)
         x = [1.5_r8,1._r8]
      case(3)
         x = 0._r8
      case(4)
         center = [-.5_r8,0._r8,.75_r8]
         x = [1._r8,1._r8,-1._r8]
      end select
      expected = max(lower,min(upper,center(:n)))
      optimum = sum(weights(:n)*(expected-center(:n))**2)
      seed = 1728+fixture
      call random_seed(put=seed)
      iterations = 500
      evaluations = 0
      call qnstops(n,lower,upper,objective,x,'G',minimum,status,n=32,max_iter=iterations, &
         max_eval=evaluations,tau=1._r8,gain=10._r8)
      if (status < 1 .or. status > 3) error stop 'QNSTOP stopping status'
      if (.not. all(ieee_is_finite(x)) .or. .not. ieee_is_finite(minimum)) error stop 'nonfinite box result'
      if (any(x < lower) .or. any(x > upper)) error stop 'box feasibility'
      reference = 0._r8
      do i = 1,n
         reference = reference+weights(i)*(x(i)-center(i))*(x(i)-center(i))
      end do
      if (abs(minimum-reference) > 1.e-10_r8*max(1._r8,reference)) error stop 'returned objective consistency'
      error = maxval(abs(x-expected))
      gap = (minimum-optimum)/max(1._r8,optimum)
      print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,es12.4,a,es12.4)', 'Fixture=',fixture,' status=',status,' position error=',error,' gap=',gap
      if (error > .03_r8 .or. gap < -1.e-10_r8 .or. gap > .1_r8) error stop 'projected box minimum'
      if (optimum == 0 .and. minimum > 1.e-3_r8) error stop 'interior quadratic minimum'
      if (evaluations <= 0) error stop 'missing function evaluation count'
      max_error = max(max_error,error)
      max_gap = max(max_gap,gap)
      runs = runs+1
      deallocate(x,expected,lower,upper)
   end do
   if (runs /= 4) error stop 'box fixture count'
   print '(a)', 'Four seeded box-constrained quadratics with interior minima; active bounds are not verified.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum coordinate error versus projected minimizer: ',max_error
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized objective gap: ',max_gap
   print '(a)', 'PASS qnstop-box-reference'
end program box_reference

name: gams-libmbd-dimer-spectrum
source:
! SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
! Independent two-oscillator consumer; see licenses/dispersion-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use mbd_constants, only: dp, MBD_LOG_LVL_ERROR
   use mbd_geom, only: geom_t
   use mbd_damping, only: damping_t
   use mbd_gradients, only: grad_request_t
   use mbd_utils, only: result_t
   use mbd_hamiltonian, only: get_mbd_hamiltonian_energy
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type(geom_t) :: geom
   type(damping_t) :: damp
   type(grad_request_t) :: grad
   type(result_t) :: result
   real(dp) :: alpha(2), omega(2), direction(3), r, a, b, c, disc
   real(dp) :: expected(6), h(6,6), energy, value, error, worst, residual, orthogonal
   integer :: iw, ia, ir, idir, mode, i, j, k, n
   worst=0; residual=0; orthogonal=0; n=0
   damp%version='bare'
   do iw=1,2
      omega=[1.0_dp,1.0_dp]
      if (iw==2) omega=[0.5_dp,1.5_dp]
      do ia=1,2
         alpha=[0.5_dp,1.0_dp]*real(ia,dp)
         do ir=1,3
            r=real(ir+1,dp)
            a=omega(1)**2; b=omega(2)**2
            c=omega(1)*omega(2)*sqrt(product(alpha))/r**3
            ! The three independent 2x2 blocks have couplings c,c,-2c.
            do i=1,3
               value=c
               if (i==3) value=-2*c
               disc=sqrt((a-b)**2+4*value**2)
               expected(2*i-1)=(a+b-disc)/2
               expected(2*i)=(a+b+disc)/2
            end do
            call sort(expected)
            energy=0.5_dp*sum(sqrt(expected))-1.5_dp*sum(omega)
            do idir=1,3
               select case(idir)
               case(1)
                  direction=[0.0_dp,0.0_dp,1.0_dp]
               case(2)
                  direction=[0.6_dp,0.8_dp,0.0_dp]
               case(3)
                  direction=[1.0_dp,2.0_dp,2.0_dp]/3
               end select
               ! Independently assemble the 6x6 Hamiltonian using scalar loops.
               h=0
               do i=1,3
                  h(i,i)=a; h(i+3,i+3)=b
                  do j=1,3
                     value=-3*direction(i)*direction(j)
                     if (i==j) value=value+1
                     h(i,j+3)=c*value; h(j+3,i)=c*value
                  end do
               end do
               do mode=1,2
                  geom%coords=reshape([1.0_dp,-2.0_dp,0.5_dp, &
                     1.0_dp+r*direction(1),-2.0_dp+r*direction(2),0.5_dp+r*direction(3)],[3,2])
                  geom%get_eigs=.true.; geom%get_modes=mode==2
                  geom%log%level=MBD_LOG_LVL_ERROR
                  call geom%init()
                  result=get_mbd_hamiltonian_energy(geom,alpha,omega,damp,grad)
                  if (geom%has_exc()) then
                     print '(a)',geom%exc%msg
                     error stop 'Hamiltonian exception'
                  end if
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(result%mode_eigs))) error stop 'nonfinite eigenvalues'
                  if (.not.ieee_is_finite(result%energy)) error stop 'nonfinite energy'
                  error=maxval(abs(result%mode_eigs-expected))/max(1.0_dp,maxval(abs(expected)))
                  worst=max(worst,error)
                  if (error>1e-12_dp) error stop 'closed-form spectrum'
                  if (abs(result%energy-energy)>1e-12_dp) error stop 'zero-point energy'
                  if (mode==2) then
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(result%modes))) error stop 'nonfinite modes'
                     do i=1,6
                        do j=1,6
                           value=0
                           do k=1,6
                              value=value+h(j,k)*result%modes(k,i)
                           end do
                           value=value-result%mode_eigs(i)*result%modes(j,i)
                           residual=max(residual,abs(value))
                           value=sum(result%modes(:,i)*result%modes(:,j))
                           if (i==j) value=value-1
                           orthogonal=max(orthogonal,abs(value))
                        end do
                     end do
                  end if
                  call geom%destroy()
                  n=n+1
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (residual>1e-12_dp .or. orthogonal>1e-12_dp) error stop 'eigenvector residual/orthogonality'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Bare two-oscillator Hamiltonian calls: ',n
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized closed-form eigenvalue error: ',worst
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scalar eigenvector residual: ',residual
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum orthogonality error: ',orthogonal
   print '(a)', 'PASS libmbd-dimer-spectrum'
contains
   subroutine sort(x)
      real(dp),intent(inout)::x(:)
      real(dp)::t
      integer::i,j
      do i=2,size(x)
         t=x(i); j=i-1
         do while(j>=1)
            if (x(j)<=t) exit
            x(j+1)=x(j); j=j-1
         end do
         x(j+1)=t
      end do
   end subroutine sort
end program main

name: gams-dftd4-dispersion-reference
source:
! DFT-D4 PBE two-body reference: test_pbed4_mb01 in the pinned upstream tests.
! MB16-43/01 geometry adapted from mstore v0.4.0 (Apache-2.0).
! SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later AND Apache-2.0
! Modified playground driver: all 48 Cartesian finite differences and rigid rotations.
! Upstream DFT-D4 LGPL notices are retained in licenses/dftd4-COPYING*.
! MB16-43 geometry: mstore v0.4.0, Apache-2.0; see accompanying attribution.
program main
   use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use dftd4, only: d4_model, new_d4_model, rational_damping_param, &
      get_dispersion, realspace_cutoff
   use mctc_env, only: wp, error_type
   use mctc_io, only: new, structure_type
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: nat = 16
   character(len=*), parameter :: sym(nat) = [character(len=4)::&
      & "Na", "H", "O", "H", "F", "H", "H", "O", "N", "H", "H", "Cl", "B", "B", "N", "Al"]
   real(wp), parameter :: xyz(3, nat) = reshape([&
      & -1.85528263484662_wp,  3.58670515364616_wp, -2.41763729306344_wp, &
      &  4.40178023537845_wp,  0.02338844412653_wp, -4.95457749372945_wp, &
      & -2.98706033463438_wp,  4.76252065456814_wp,  1.27043301573532_wp, &
      &  0.79980886075526_wp,  1.41103455609189_wp, -5.04655321620119_wp, &
      & -4.20647469409936_wp,  1.84275767548460_wp,  4.55038084858449_wp, &
      & -3.54356121843970_wp, -3.18835665176557_wp,  1.46240021785588_wp, &
      &  2.70032160109941_wp,  1.06818452504054_wp, -1.73234650374438_wp, &
      &  3.73114088824361_wp, -2.07001543363453_wp,  2.23160937604731_wp, &
      & -1.75306819230397_wp,  0.35951417150421_wp,  1.05323406177129_wp, &
      &  5.41755788583825_wp, -1.57881830078929_wp,  1.75394002750038_wp, &
      & -2.23462868255966_wp, -2.13856505054269_wp,  4.10922285746451_wp, &
      &  1.01565866207568_wp, -3.21952154552768_wp, -3.36050963020778_wp, &
      &  2.42119255723593_wp,  0.26626435093114_wp, -3.91862474360560_wp, &
      & -3.02526098819107_wp,  2.53667889095925_wp,  2.31664984740423_wp, &
      & -2.00438948664892_wp, -2.29235136977220_wp,  2.19782807357059_wp, &
      &  1.12226554109716_wp, -1.36942007032045_wp,  0.48455055461782_wp],&
      & shape(xyz))

   real(wp), parameter :: reference = -1.8578752883363366e-2_wp
   real(wp), parameter :: step = 1.0e-5_wp
   integer :: atom, axis, i, j
   real(wp) :: energy, plus, minus, translated, fd_error, worst_fd, rotation_error
   real(wp) :: rotation(3,3), rotated(3,nat), rotated_gradient(3,nat), expected_gradient(3,nat)
   real(wp) :: gradient(3,nat), scratch(3,nat), positions(3,nat)

   call evaluate(xyz, energy, gradient)
   if (abs(energy-reference) > 1.0e-10_wp) error stop 'upstream energy reference'
   if (maxval(abs(sum(gradient,dim=2))) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'net force'
   worst_fd=0
   do atom=1,nat
      do axis=1,3
         positions=xyz
         positions(axis,atom)=positions(axis,atom)+step
         call evaluate(positions,plus,scratch)
         positions(axis,atom)=positions(axis,atom)-2*step
         call evaluate(positions,minus,scratch)
         fd_error=abs((plus-minus)/(2*step)-gradient(axis,atom))
         worst_fd=max(worst_fd,fd_error)
         if (fd_error>1.0e-6_wp) error stop 'Cartesian finite-difference gradient'
      end do
   end do
   rotation=reshape([0.6_wp,0.8_wp,0.0_wp,-0.8_wp,0.6_wp,0.0_wp,0.0_wp,0.0_wp,1.0_wp],[3,3])
   rotated=0; expected_gradient=0
   do atom=1,nat
      do i=1,3
         do j=1,3
            rotated(i,atom)=rotated(i,atom)+rotation(i,j)*xyz(j,atom)
            expected_gradient(i,atom)=expected_gradient(i,atom)+rotation(i,j)*gradient(j,atom)
         end do
      end do
   end do
   call evaluate(rotated,plus,rotated_gradient)
   if (abs(plus-energy)>1e-11_wp) error stop 'rotation energy'
   rotation_error=maxval(abs(rotated_gradient-expected_gradient))
   if (rotation_error>1e-9_wp) error stop 'gradient rotation covariance'
   positions=xyz+1.25_wp
   call evaluate(positions,translated,scratch)
   if (abs(translated-energy) > 1.0e-11_wp) error stop 'translation invariance'
   print '(a,f20.14)', 'PBE-D4 dispersion energy (Hartree): ',energy
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Absolute reference error: ',abs(energy-reference)
   if (maxval(abs(scratch-gradient))>1e-9_wp) error stop 'translation gradient'
   print '(a)', '48 Cartesian derivatives checked by central finite differences (step 1e-5 bohr).'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum gradient finite-difference error: ',worst_fd
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum gradient rotation error: ',rotation_error
   print '(a)', 'PASS dftd4-dispersion-reference'
contains
   subroutine evaluate(pos,e,g)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: pos(3,nat)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: e,g(3,nat)
      type(structure_type) :: mol
      type(d4_model) :: model
      type(error_type), allocatable :: error
      type(rational_damping_param), parameter :: param=rational_damping_param( &
         s6=1.0_wp,s9=0.0_wp,alp=16.0_wp, &
         s8=0.95948085_wp,a1=0.38574991_wp,a2=4.80688534_wp)
      real(wp) :: sigma(3,3)
      call new(mol,sym,pos)
      call new_d4_model(error,model,mol)
      if (allocated(error)) then
         print '(a)',error%message
         error stop 'D4 model initialization'
      end if
      call get_dispersion(mol,model,param,realspace_cutoff(),e,g,sigma)
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(e)) error stop 'nonfinite energy'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(g))) error stop 'nonfinite gradient'
   end subroutine evaluate
end program main

name: gams-kronrod-moments-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/rules-differences-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use mpmodule
   use playground_kronrod, only: init, kronrod, nwds2
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::orders(*)=[2,3,4,5,6,7,10]
   type(mp_real),allocatable::x(:),w(:),g(:)
   type(mp_real)::tol,integral,expected,term,zero,one,three,worst,scaled,error
   integer::j,n,i,p,degree,nk,ng,na,gauss_nodes
   if (mpipl<1000) error stop 'MPFUN precision configuration'
   call init()
   zero=mpreal(0.0_real64,nwds2); one=mpreal(1.0_real64,nwds2)
   three=mpreal(3.0_real64,nwds2)
   tol=mpreal(10.0_real64,nwds2)**(-50)
   worst=zero; nk=0; ng=0; na=0
   do j=1,size(orders)
      n=orders(j)
      allocate(x(n+1),w(n+1),g(n+1))
      call kronrod(n,tol,x,w,g)
      if (abs(x(n+1))>tol) error stop 'central node'
      gauss_nodes=0
      do i=1,n+1
         if (x(i)<zero.or.x(i)>=one) error stop 'node outside half interval'
         if (w(i)<=zero.or.g(i)<zero) error stop 'nonpositive weights'
         if (i<=n) then
            if (x(i)<=x(i+1)) error stop 'node ordering'
         end if
         if (g(i)>zero) then
            gauss_nodes=gauss_nodes+2
            if (i==n+1) gauss_nodes=gauss_nodes-1
         end if
      end do
      if (gauss_nodes/=n) error stop 'embedded Gauss node count'
      degree=3*n+1+mod(n,2)
      do p=0,degree,2
         integral=zero
         do i=1,n
            integral=integral+2*w(i)*x(i)**p
         end do
         if (p==0) integral=integral+w(n+1)
         expected=2*one/(p+1)
         call check(integral,expected)
         nk=nk+1
      end do
      do p=0,2*n-2,2
         integral=zero
         do i=1,n
            integral=integral+2*g(i)*x(i)**p
         end do
         if (p==0) integral=integral+g(n+1)
         expected=2*one/(p+1)
         call check(integral,expected)
         ng=ng+1
      end do
      ! Translate [-1,1] to [1,3]; nonsymmetric powers check both reflected halves.
      do p=0,min(2*n-1,8)
         integral=zero
         do i=1,n
            term=(2*one+x(i))**p+(2*one-x(i))**p
            integral=integral+w(i)*term
         end do
         integral=integral+w(n+1)*(2*one)**p
         expected=(three**(p+1)-one)/(p+1)
         call check(integral,expected)
         na=na+1
      end do
      print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Gauss order ',n,'; Kronrod nodes ',2*n+1
      deallocate(x,w,g)
   end do
   if (nk/=64.or.ng/=37.or.na/=54) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,3i5)', 'Kronrod / Gauss / translated polynomial moments: ',nk,ng,na
   print '(a,es14.4e3)', 'Maximum normalized moment error: ',dble(worst)
   print '(a)', 'PASS kronrod-moments-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,reference)
      type(mp_real),intent(in)::actual,reference
      error=abs(actual-reference)
      scaled=one
      if (abs(reference)>one) scaled=abs(reference)
      error=error/scaled
      if (error>mpreal(10.0_real64,nwds2)**(-40)) then
         print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,es12.4)', 'Failed n=',n,' power=',p,' normalized error=',dble(error)
         print '(a,2es22.12)', 'Actual/reference: ',dble(actual),dble(reference)
         error stop 'exact polynomial moment'
      end if
      if (error>worst) worst=error
   end subroutine check
end program main

name: gams-tsunami-differences-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/rules-differences-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real32,real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use mod_diff, only: diff_centered,diff_upwind
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::sizes(*)=[16,32,64,128,256]
   real(real64),parameter::phases(*)=[0.0_real64,0.37_real64,1.1_real64]
   real(real32),allocatable::f(:),dc(:),du(:)
   real(real64),allocatable::ec(:),eu(:),truth(:)
   real(real64)::pi,h,kh,theta,s,c,phase,tol,error,worst
   real(real64)::rc(5),ru(5),ratio_c,ratio_u,minimum_c,minimum_u
   integer::j,n,k,ip,kind,i,cases,fixtures,left,right
   pi=acos(-1.0_real64); worst=0; cases=0; fixtures=0
   minimum_c=huge(1.0_real64); minimum_u=minimum_c
   do j=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(j); h=2*pi/n
      allocate(f(n),ec(n),eu(n),truth(n))
      do k=1,3
         kh=k*h
         do ip=1,size(phases)
            phase=phases(ip)
            do kind=1,2
               do i=1,n
                  theta=k*(i-1)*h+phase; s=sin(theta); c=cos(theta)
                  if (kind==1) then
                     f(i)=real(s,real32)
                     ec(i)=sin(kh)*c/h
                     eu(i)=((1-cos(kh))*s+sin(kh)*c)/h
                     truth(i)=k*c
                  else
                     f(i)=real(c,real32)
                     ec(i)=-sin(kh)*s/h
                     eu(i)=((1-cos(kh))*c-sin(kh)*s)/h
                     truth(i)=-k*s
                  end if
               end do
               dc=diff_centered(f); du=diff_upwind(f)
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(dc)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(du))) error stop 'nonfinite'
               error=max(maxval(abs(real(dc,real64)/h-ec)),maxval(abs(real(du,real64)/h-eu)))
               worst=max(worst,error)
               tol=8*epsilon(1.0_real32)/h
               if (error>tol) error stop 'Fourier discrete derivative'
               if (k==1.and.ip==1.and.kind==1) then
                  rc(j)=sqrt(sum((real(dc,real64)/h-truth)**2)/n)
                  ru(j)=sqrt(sum((real(du,real64)/h-truth)**2)/n)
               end if
               cases=cases+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
      ! Exactly representable nonsmooth data exercise both wraparound boundaries.
      do i=1,n
         f(i)=real(modulo(17*i+3,31)-15,real32)/8
      end do
      dc=diff_centered(f); du=diff_upwind(f)
      do i=1,n
         left=modulo(i-2,n)+1; right=modulo(i,n)+1
         if (dc(i)/=(f(right)-f(left))/2) error stop 'centered periodic indexing'
         if (du(i)/=f(i)-f(left)) error stop 'upwind periodic indexing'
      end do
      if (sum(real(dc,real64))/=0.or.sum(real(du,real64))/=0) error stop 'periodic telescoping'
      f=3.25_real32
      dc=diff_centered(f); du=diff_upwind(f)
      if (any(dc/=0).or.any(du/=0)) error stop 'constant derivative'
      fixtures=fixtures+2
      print '(a,i0,a,2es13.5)', 'N=',n,'; centered/upwind RMS errors: ',rc(j),ru(j)
      deallocate(f,ec,eu,truth,dc,du)
   end do
   do j=2,size(sizes)
      ratio_c=rc(j-1)/rc(j); ratio_u=ru(j-1)/ru(j)
      if (ratio_c<3.8_real64.or.ratio_c>4.2_real64) error stop 'second-order convergence'
      if (ratio_u<1.9_real64.or.ratio_u>2.1_real64) error stop 'first-order convergence'
      minimum_c=min(minimum_c,ratio_c); minimum_u=min(minimum_u,ratio_u)
   end do
   if (cases/=90.or.fixtures/=10) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Fourier fixtures: ',cases,'; nonsmooth/constant fixtures: ',fixtures
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum exact-discrete derivative error: ',worst
   print '(a,2f10.5)', 'Minimum refinement ratios, centered/upwind: ',minimum_c,minimum_u
   print '(a)', 'PASS tsunami-differences-reference'
end program main

name: gams-linalg-qr-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/qr-autodiff-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64,int32
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use linalg, only: qr_factor
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::rows(*)=[1,2,4,6],cols(*)=[1,2,3,5]
   real(real64),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:),original(:,:),q(:,:),r(:,:),p(:,:)
   integer(int32),allocatable::pivot(:)
   real(real64)::value,expected,scale,reconstruction,orthogonal,lower,worst_r,worst_o
   integer::im,jn,pattern,is,mode,m,n,i,j,k,calls,fixtures
   calls=0; fixtures=0; worst_r=0; worst_o=0
   do im=1,size(rows)
      m=rows(im)
      do jn=1,size(cols)
         n=cols(jn)
         allocate(a(m,n),original(m,n),pivot(n))
         do pattern=1,4
            do is=1,size(scales)
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,m
                     a(i,j)=real(modulo(7*i+11*j+3*i*j,19)-9,real64)/4
                     if (i==j) a(i,j)=a(i,j)+3
                  end do
               end do
               if (pattern==2.and.n>1) a(:,n)=a(:,1)
               if (pattern==3) a(:,1)=0
               if (pattern==4) a=0
               a=a*scales(is); original=a
               scale=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(a)))
               fixtures=fixtures+1
               do mode=1,3
                  if (mode==1) then
                     call qr_factor(a,q=q,r=r)
                     pivot=[(i,i=1,n)]
                  else
                     pivot=0
                     if (mode==3) pivot(1)=1
                     call qr_factor(a,pivot,q=q,r=r,p=p)
                     if (any(pivot<1).or.any(pivot>n)) error stop 'pivot range'
                     do j=1,n
                        if (count(pivot==j)/=1) error stop 'pivot permutation'
                     end do
                     if (mode==3.and.pivot(1)/=1) error stop 'locked column'
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(p))) error stop 'nonfinite permutation'
                     do j=1,n
                        do i=1,n
                           expected=0
                           if (i==pivot(j)) expected=1
                           if (p(i,j)/=expected) error stop 'permutation matrix'
                        end do
                     end do
                  end if
                  if (any(a/=original)) error stop 'input changed'
                  if (any(shape(q)/=[m,m]).or.any(shape(r)/=[m,n])) error stop 'factor shapes'
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(q)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(r))) error stop 'nonfinite factor'
                  reconstruction=0; orthogonal=0; lower=0
                  do j=1,n
                     do i=1,m
                        value=0
                        do k=1,m
                           value=value+q(i,k)*r(k,j)
                        end do
                        reconstruction=max(reconstruction,abs(value-a(i,pivot(j)))/scale)
                        if (i>j) lower=max(lower,abs(r(i,j))/scale)
                     end do
                  end do
                  do j=1,m
                     do i=1,m
                        value=0
                        do k=1,m
                           value=value+q(k,i)*q(k,j)
                        end do
                        if (i==j) value=value-1
                        orthogonal=max(orthogonal,abs(value))
                     end do
                  end do
                  if (reconstruction>2e-12_real64) error stop 'A P = Q R'
                  if (orthogonal>5e-12_real64) error stop 'Q orthogonality'
                  if (lower>1e-12_real64) error stop 'upper trapezoidal R'
                  worst_r=max(worst_r,reconstruction); worst_o=max(worst_o,orthogonal)
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
            end do
         end do
         deallocate(a,original,pivot)
      end do
   end do
   if (fixtures/=192.or.calls/=576) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Real matrix fixtures: ',fixtures,'; QR factorizations: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Square/tall/wide, repeated/zero columns, zero matrices; free and locked pivots.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized scalar reconstruction error: ',worst_r
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scalar orthogonality error: ',worst_o
   print '(a)', 'PASS linalg-qr-reference'
end program main

name: gams-differentia-analytic-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/qr-autodiff-drivers-MIT.txt.
module callbacks
   use differentia
   implicit none
contains
   function polynomial(x) result(y)
      type(dual),intent(in)::x
      type(dual)::y
      y=x**5-3*x**3+2*x-7
   end function polynomial
   function oscillatory(x) result(y)
      type(dual),intent(in)::x
      type(dual)::y
      y=exp(x)*sin(x)+cos(2*x)
   end function oscillatory
   function positive(x) result(y)
      type(dual),intent(in)::x
      type(dual)::y
      y=log(x+3)+sqrt(x+3)+1/(x+3)
   end function positive
   function coupled(x) result(y)
      type(dual),target,intent(in)::x(:)
      type(dual)::y
      y=x(1)**2*x(2)+sin(x(3))+exp(x(1)-x(2))
   end function coupled
   subroutine vector_map(x,y)
      type(dual),target,intent(in)::x(:)
