      type(dual),target,intent(out)::y(:)
      y(1)=x(1)*x(2)+sin(x(3))
      y(2)=exp(x(1))+x(2)**2-x(3)
      y(3)=x(1)/(x(3)+4)+cos(x(2))
   end subroutine vector_map
end module callbacks
program main
   use callbacks
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp)::t,z,f,df,reference,slope,x(3),g(3),eg(3),v(3),ev(3),jac(3,3),ej(3,3)
   real(wp)::bad_g(2),bad_v(2),worst,value_error,error,e
   type(JacobianWorkMemory)::work
   character(:),allocatable::err
   integer::i,which,pass,nscalar,ngrad,njac
   worst=0; value_error=0; nscalar=0; ngrad=0; njac=0
   x=[0.0_wp,0.0_wp,0.0_wp]
   call gradient(coupled,x,f,bad_g,err)
   if (.not.allocated(err)) error stop 'gradient dimension guard'
   call jacobian(vector_map,x,bad_v,jac,err=err)
   if (.not.allocated(err)) error stop 'Jacobian dimension guard'
   work=JacobianWorkMemory(3,err=err)
   if (allocated(err)) error stop 'Jacobian workspace initialization'
   do i=-16,16
      t=real(i,wp)/8
      do which=1,3
         select case(which)
         case(1)
            call derivative(polynomial,t,f,df)
            reference=t**5-3*t**3+2*t-7
            slope=5*t**4-9*t**2+2
         case(2)
            call derivative(oscillatory,t,f,df)
            reference=exp(t)*sin(t)+cos(2*t)
            slope=exp(t)*(sin(t)+cos(t))-2*sin(2*t)
         case(3)
            call derivative(positive,t,f,df)
            z=t+3
            reference=log(z)+sqrt(z)+1/z
            slope=1/z+0.5_wp/sqrt(z)-1/z**2
         end select
         call check(f,reference)
         value_error=max(value_error,error)
         call check(df,slope)
         nscalar=nscalar+1
      end do
      x=[t,real(modulo(i,7)-3,wp)/4,real(modulo(i,5)-2,wp)/3]
      e=exp(x(1)-x(2))
      reference=x(1)**2*x(2)+sin(x(3))+e
      eg=[2*x(1)*x(2)+e,x(1)**2-e,cos(x(3))]
      call gradient(coupled,x,f,g,err)
      if (allocated(err)) error stop err
      call check(f,reference)
      do which=1,3
         call check(g(which),eg(which))
      end do
      ngrad=ngrad+1
      ev=[x(1)*x(2)+sin(x(3)),exp(x(1))+x(2)**2-x(3),x(1)/(x(3)+4)+cos(x(2))]
      ej(1,:)=[x(2),x(1),cos(x(3))]
      ej(2,:)=[exp(x(1)),2*x(2),-1.0_wp]
      ej(3,:)=[1/(x(3)+4),-sin(x(2)),-x(1)/(x(3)+4)**2]
      do pass=1,2
         if (pass==1) then
            call jacobian(vector_map,x,v,jac,err=err)
         else
            call jacobian(vector_map,x,v,jac,wrk=work,err=err)
         end if
         if (allocated(err)) error stop err
         do which=1,3
            call check(v(which),ev(which))
         end do
         do which=1,3
            call check(jac(which,1),ej(which,1))
            call check(jac(which,2),ej(which,2))
            call check(jac(which,3),ej(which,3))
         end do
         njac=njac+1
      end do
   end do
   if (nscalar/=99.or.ngrad/=33.or.njac/=66) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,3i5)', 'Scalar / gradient / Jacobian calls: ',nscalar,ngrad,njac
   print '(a)', 'Dense Jacobians checked with temporary and reused workspace; two dimension guards.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized analytical error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS differentia-analytic-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,expected)
      real(wp),intent(in)::actual,expected
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'nonfinite result'
      error=abs(actual-expected)/max(1.0_wp,abs(expected))
      worst=max(worst,error)
      if (error>2e-12_wp) error stop 'analytical reference'
   end subroutine check
end program main

name: gams-linalg-eigen-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/lapack-spectra-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use linalg, only: eigen
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::sizes(*)=[1,2,3,5]
   real(real64),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:),input(:,:),saved(:,:),q(:,:),v(:,:),w(:),expected(:),d(:)
   real(real64)::normalization,t,value,residual,orthogonal,worst_w,worst_r,worst_o
   integer::in,n,pattern,is,rotation,mode,i,j,k,calls,fixtures
   calls=0; fixtures=0; worst_w=0; worst_r=0; worst_o=0
   do in=1,size(sizes)
      n=sizes(in)
      allocate(a(n,n),input(n,n),saved(n,n),q(n,n),expected(n),d(n))
      do pattern=1,4
         do is=1,size(scales)
            do i=1,n
               select case(pattern)
               case(1)
                  d(i)=real(2*i-n-1,real64)
               case(2)
                  d(i)=2
               case(3)
                  d(i)=real(i-1,real64)
               case(4)
                  d(i)=0
               end select
            end do
            d=d*scales(is); expected=d
            call sort(expected)
            normalization=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(d)))
            do rotation=1,2
               q=0
               do i=1,n
                  q(i,i)=1
               end do
               if (rotation==2) then
                  t=real(sum([(i*i,i=1,n)]),real64)
                  do j=1,n
                     do i=1,n
                        q(i,j)=q(i,j)-2*real(i*j,real64)/t
                     end do
                  end do
               end if
               a=0
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,n
                     do k=1,n
                        a(i,j)=a(i,j)+q(i,k)*d(k)*q(j,k)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               fixtures=fixtures+1
               input=a
               ! Finite poison verifies that the API uses only the lower triangle.
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,n
                     if (i<j) &
                        input(i,j)=real(1000+17*i+31*j,real64)
                  end do
               end do
               saved=input
               do mode=1,2
                  if (mode==1) then
                     call eigen(input,w)
                  else
                     call eigen(input,w,v)
                  end if
                  if (size(w)/=n) error stop 'eigenvalue shape'
                  if (any(input/=saved)) error stop 'default input preservation'
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(w))) error stop 'nonfinite eigenvalues'
                  value=maxval(abs(w-expected))/normalization
                  worst_w=max(worst_w,value)
                  if (value>2e-12_real64) error stop 'known eigenvalues'
                  if (mode==2) then
                     if (any(shape(v)/=[n,n])) error stop 'eigenvector shape'
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(v))) error stop 'nonfinite eigenvectors'
                     residual=0; orthogonal=0
                     do j=1,n
                        do i=1,n
                           value=0
                           do k=1,n
                              value=value+a(i,k)*v(k,j)
                           end do
                           residual=max(residual,abs(value-w(j)*v(i,j))/normalization)
                           value=0
                           do k=1,n
                              value=value+v(k,i)*v(k,j)
                           end do
                           if (i==j) value=value-1
                           orthogonal=max(orthogonal,abs(value))
                        end do
                     end do
                     if (residual>5e-12_real64.or.orthogonal>5e-12_real64) &
                        error stop 'eigenvector residual/orthogonality'
                     worst_r=max(worst_r,residual); worst_o=max(worst_o,orthogonal)
                  end if
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,input,saved,q,v,w,expected,d)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=96.or.calls/=192) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Known-spectrum symmetric matrices: ',fixtures,'; eigen calls: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Lower triangle with unused-upper-half poison; eigenvalues only and eigenvectors.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized eigenvalue error: ',worst_w
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized scalar eigenvector residual: ',worst_r
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scalar orthogonality error: ',worst_o
   print '(a)', 'PASS linalg-eigen-reference'
contains
   subroutine sort(x)
      real(real64),intent(inout)::x(:)
      real(real64)::tmp
      integer::i,j
      do i=2,size(x)
         tmp=x(i); j=i-1
         do while(j>=1)
            if (x(j)<=tmp) exit
            x(j+1)=x(j); j=j-1
         end do
         x(j+1)=tmp
      end do
   end subroutine sort
end program main

name: gams-linalg-svd-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/lapack-spectra-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use linalg, only: svd
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::shapes(2,6)=reshape([1,1,2,3,3,2,3,3,4,2,2,5],[2,6])
   real(real64),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:),input(:,:),left(:,:),right(:,:),u(:,:),vt(:,:),s(:),expected(:),d(:)
   real(real64)::value,normalization,reconstruction,orthogonal,worst_s,worst_r,worst_o,triplet,worst_t,lambda
   integer::shape_id,m,n,k,pattern,is,rotation,mode,i,j,l,b,c,cols_u,rows_v,calls,fixtures
   calls=0; fixtures=0; worst_s=0; worst_r=0; worst_o=0; worst_t=0
   do shape_id=1,size(shapes,2)
      m=shapes(1,shape_id); n=shapes(2,shape_id); k=min(m,n)
      allocate(a(m,n),input(m,n),left(m,m),right(n,n),expected(k),d(k))
      do pattern=1,4
         do is=1,size(scales)
            do i=1,k
               select case(pattern)
               case(1)
                  d(i)=real(k-i+1,real64)
               case(2)
                  d(i)=2
               case(3)
                  d(i)=0
                  if (i==1) d(i)=3
               case(4)
                  d(i)=0
               end select
            end do
            expected=d*abs(scales(is))
            d=d*scales(is)
            normalization=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(d)))
            do rotation=1,2
               call orthogonal_factor(left,rotation)
               call orthogonal_factor(right,rotation)
               a=0
               do j=1,n
                  do i=1,m
                     do l=1,k
                        a(i,j)=a(i,j)+left(i,l)*d(l)*right(j,l)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               fixtures=fixtures+1
               do mode=1,4
                  input=a
                  select case(mode)
                  case(1)
                     call svd(input,s,u,vt)
                  case(2)
                     call svd(input,s)
                  case(3)
                     call svd(input,s,u=u)
                  case(4)
                     call svd(input,s,vt=vt)
                  end select
                  if (size(s)/=k) error stop 'singular value shape'
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(s))) error stop 'nonfinite singular values'
                  cols_u=0; rows_v=0
                  if (allocated(u)) then
                     if (any(shape(u)/=[m,m])) error stop 'U shape'
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(u))) error stop 'nonfinite U'
                     cols_u=m
                  end if
                  if (allocated(vt)) then
                     if (any(shape(vt)/=[n,n])) error stop 'VT shape'
                     if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(vt))) error stop 'nonfinite VT'
                     rows_v=n
                  end if
                  if (any(input/=a)) error stop 'default input preservation'
                  value=maxval(abs(s-expected))/normalization
                  if (value>2e-12_real64) error stop 'known singular values'
                  worst_s=max(worst_s,value)
                  if (any(s<0)) error stop 'negative singular value'
                  do i=2,k
                     if (s(i)>s(i-1)) error stop 'singular value ordering'
                  end do
                  reconstruction=0; orthogonal=0
                  if (mode==1) then
                     do j=1,n
                        do i=1,m
                           value=0
                           do l=1,k
                              value=value+u(i,l)*s(l)*vt(l,j)
                           end do
                           reconstruction=max(reconstruction,abs(value-a(i,j))/normalization)
                        end do
                     end do
                  end if
                  do j=1,cols_u
                     do i=1,cols_u
                        value=0
                        do l=1,m
                           value=value+u(l,i)*u(l,j)
                        end do
                        if (i==j) value=value-1
                        orthogonal=max(orthogonal,abs(value))
                     end do
                  end do
                  do j=1,rows_v
                     do i=1,rows_v
                        value=0
                        do l=1,n
                           value=value+vt(i,l)*vt(j,l)
                        end do
                        if (i==j) value=value-1
                        orthogonal=max(orthogonal,abs(value))
                     end do
                  end do
                  ! Independently check all returned singular-vector eigenspaces,
                  ! including full-storage null vectors and one-sided output modes.
                  triplet=0
                  do j=1,cols_u
                     lambda=0
                     if (j<=k) lambda=s(j)**2
                     do i=1,m
                        value=0
                        do b=1,n
                           do c=1,m
                              value=value+a(i,b)*a(c,b)*u(c,j)
                           end do
                        end do
                        triplet=max(triplet,abs(value-lambda*u(i,j))/normalization**2)
                     end do
                  end do
                  do j=1,rows_v
                     lambda=0
                     if (j<=k) lambda=s(j)**2
                     do i=1,n
                        value=0
                        do b=1,m
                           do c=1,n
                              value=value+a(b,i)*a(b,c)*vt(j,c)
                           end do
                        end do
                        triplet=max(triplet,abs(value-lambda*vt(j,i))/normalization**2)
                     end do
                  end do
                  if (triplet>1e-11_real64) error stop 'singular-vector eigenspace residual'
                  worst_t=max(worst_t,triplet)
                  if (reconstruction>5e-12_real64.or.orthogonal>5e-12_real64) &
                     error stop 'SVD reconstruction/orthogonality'
                  worst_r=max(worst_r,reconstruction); worst_o=max(worst_o,orthogonal)
                  if (allocated(u)) deallocate(u)
                  if (allocated(vt)) deallocate(vt)
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,input,left,right,s,expected,d)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=144.or.calls/=576) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Known-spectrum rectangular matrices: ',fixtures,'; SVD calls: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Full/values-only/U-only/VT-only; distinct/repeated/rank-one/zero spectra at signed scales.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized singular-value error: ',worst_s
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized scalar reconstruction error: ',worst_r
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum scalar orthogonality error: ',worst_o
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized scalar singular-vector residual: ',worst_t
   print '(a)', 'PASS linalg-svd-reference'
contains
   subroutine orthogonal_factor(q,variant)
      real(real64),intent(out)::q(:,:)
      integer,intent(in)::variant
      real(real64)::norm
      integer::i,j,n
      n=size(q,1); q=0
      do i=1,n
         q(i,i)=1
      end do
      if (variant==1) return
      norm=real(sum([(i*i,i=1,n)]),real64)
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            q(i,j)=q(i,j)-2*real(i*j,real64)/norm
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine orthogonal_factor
end program main

name: gams-linalg-least-squares-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/least-interpolation-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   use linalg,only:solve_least_squares
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::shapes(2,6)=reshape([1,1,2,1,3,2,5,3,2,3,3,5],[2,6])
   real(real64),parameter::scales(*)=[-4.0_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::a(:,:),saved_a(:,:),b(:,:),saved_b(:,:),left(:,:),right(:,:)
   real(real64),allocatable::expected(:,:),noise(:,:),x(:,:),v(:),r(:,:),d(:)
   real(real64)::value,z,rho,normalization,answer_error,residual_error,stationary,worst_x,worst_r,worst_s
   integer::shape_id,m,n,k,is,rotation,level,i,j,l,c,fixtures,calls,nonzero
   fixtures=0; calls=0; nonzero=0; worst_x=0; worst_r=0; worst_s=0
   do shape_id=1,size(shapes,2)
      m=shapes(1,shape_id); n=shapes(2,shape_id); k=min(m,n)
      allocate(a(m,n),saved_a(m,n),b(m,3),saved_b(m,3),left(m,m),right(n,n))
      allocate(expected(n,3),noise(m,3),r(m,3),d(k))
      do is=1,size(scales)
         d=[(real(i,real64)*scales(is),i=1,k)]
         do rotation=1,2
            call orthogonal_factor(left,rotation); call orthogonal_factor(right,rotation)
            a=0
            do j=1,n
               do i=1,m
                  do l=1,k
                     a(i,j)=a(i,j)+left(i,l)*d(l)*right(j,l)
                  end do
               end do
            end do
            do level=1,2
               rho=0
               if (level==2.and.m>n) rho=0.25_real64
               noise=0; expected=0
               do c=1,3
                  do j=1,n
                     do l=1,k
                        z=real(2*l-c,real64)/4
                        expected(j,c)=expected(j,c)+right(j,l)*z
                     end do
                  end do
                  if (m>n) noise(:,c)=rho*c*left(:,n+1)
               end do
               if (rho>0) nonzero=nonzero+1
               b=noise
               do c=1,3
                  do i=1,m
                     do j=1,n
                        b(i,c)=b(i,c)+a(i,j)*expected(j,c)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               saved_a=a; saved_b=b
               x=solve_least_squares(a,b)
               if (any(shape(x)/=[n,3])) error stop 'matrix solution shape'
               if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x))) error stop 'nonfinite matrix solution'
               calls=calls+1
               do c=1,3
                  v=solve_least_squares(a,b(:,c))
                  if (size(v)/=n.or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(v))) error stop 'vector solution'
                  answer_error=max(maxval(abs(x(:,c)-expected(:,c))),maxval(abs(v-expected(:,c)))) &
                     /max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(expected(:,c))))
                  if (answer_error>3e-12_real64) error stop 'known minimum-norm solution'
                  worst_x=max(worst_x,answer_error)
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
               if (any(a/=saved_a).or.any(b/=saved_b)) error stop 'inputs changed'
               r=-b
               do c=1,3
                  do i=1,m
                     do j=1,n
                        r(i,c)=r(i,c)+a(i,j)*x(j,c)
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
               normalization=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(b)))
               residual_error=maxval(abs(r+noise))/normalization
               if (residual_error>5e-12_real64) error stop 'known residual'
               worst_r=max(worst_r,residual_error)
               stationary=0
               do c=1,3
                  do j=1,n
                     value=0
                     do i=1,m
                        value=value+a(i,j)*r(i,c)
                     end do
                     stationary=max(stationary,abs(value)/(normalization*max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(a)))))
                  end do
                  value=abs(sum(r(:,c)**2)-(rho*c)**2)/max(1.0_real64,(rho*c)**2)
                  if (value>1e-11_real64) error stop 'known residual norm'
               end do
               if (stationary>1e-11_real64) error stop 'normal-equation residual'
               worst_s=max(worst_s,stationary)
               fixtures=fixtures+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
      deallocate(a,saved_a,b,saved_b,left,right,expected,noise,r,d,x,v)
   end do
   if (fixtures/=72.or.calls/=288.or.nonzero/=18) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Full-rank least-squares fixtures: ',fixtures,'; solver calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Overdetermined fixtures with prescribed nonzero residuals: ',nonzero
   print '(a)', 'Square/tall/wide; one matrix RHS and three vector RHS calls per fixture.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized solution error: ',worst_x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized prescribed-residual error: ',worst_r
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized normal-equation residual: ',worst_s
   print '(a)', 'PASS linalg-least-squares-reference'
contains
   subroutine orthogonal_factor(q,variant)
      real(real64),intent(out)::q(:,:)
      integer,intent(in)::variant
      real(real64)::norm
      integer::i,j,n
      n=size(q,1); q=0
      do i=1,n
         q(i,i)=1
      end do
      if (variant==1) return
      norm=real(sum([(i*i,i=1,n)]),real64)
      do j=1,n
         do i=1,n
            q(i,j)=q(i,j)-2*real(i*j,real64)/norm
         end do
      end do
   end subroutine orthogonal_factor
end program main

name: gams-interp1-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/least-interpolation-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite,ieee_is_nan
   use interpolation,only:interp1
   implicit none
   character(6),parameter::methods(*)=[character(6)::'linear','pchip','cubic']
   real(real64),parameter::slope(3)=[2.0_real64,-0.75_real64,0.0_real64],offset(3)=[1.0_real64,2.0_real64,-3.0_real64]
   real(real64)::x(5),y(3,5),query(41),got(3,41),one(41),point(3),extra(3,2),outside(2)
   real(real64)::dense(129),smooth(129),knots(5),profile(5),hx(3),hy(3),t,reference,worst,lower,upper
   integer::grid,method,i,c,profile_id,sgn,interval,nref,nnan,nbound,nmono,affine_refs,hump_refs
   worst=0; nref=0; nnan=0; nbound=0; nmono=0
   query=[(-2.0_real64+real(i,real64)/10,i=0,40)]; outside=[-3.0_real64,3.0_real64]
   do grid=1,2
      x=[-2.0_real64,-1.0_real64,0.0_real64,1.0_real64,2.0_real64]
      if (grid==2) x=[-2.0_real64,-1.5_real64,-0.25_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
      do c=1,3
         y(c,:)=slope(c)*x+offset(c)
      end do
      do method=1,size(methods)
         got=interp1(x,y,query,method=trim(methods(method)))
         do c=1,3
            one=interp1(x,y(c,:),query,method=trim(methods(method)))
            do i=1,size(query)
               reference=slope(c)*query(i)+offset(c)
               call check(got(c,i),reference); call check(one(i),reference)
               call check(interp1(x,y(c,:),query(i),method=trim(methods(method))),reference)
            end do
         end do
         do i=1,size(query)
            point=interp1(x,y,query(i),method=trim(methods(method)))
            do c=1,3
               call check(point(c),slope(c)*query(i)+offset(c))
            end do
         end do
         extra=interp1(x,y,outside,method=trim(methods(method)))
         if (.not.all(ieee_is_nan(extra))) error stop 'default out-of-range NaN'
         nnan=nnan+size(extra)
         extra=interp1(x,y,outside,method=trim(methods(method)),extrap='extrap')
         do c=1,3
            do i=1,2
               call check(extra(c,i),slope(c)*outside(i)+offset(c))
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   affine_refs=nref
   do grid=1,2
      x=[-2.0_real64,-1.0_real64,0.0_real64,1.0_real64,2.0_real64]
      if (grid==2) x=[-2.0_real64,-1.5_real64,-0.25_real64,0.5_real64,2.0_real64]
      dense=[(-2.0_real64+real(i,real64)/32,i=0,128)]
      do profile_id=1,2
         profile=[0.0_real64,1.0_real64,1.0_real64,2.0_real64,3.0_real64]
         if (profile_id==2) profile=[0.0_real64,2.0_real64,-1.0_real64,3.0_real64,1.0_real64]
         do sgn=-1,1,2
            smooth=interp1(x,sgn*profile,dense,method='pchip')
            knots=interp1(x,sgn*profile,x,method='pchip')
            do i=1,size(x)
               call check(knots(i),sgn*profile(i))
            end do
            do i=1,size(dense)
               interval=1
               do while(interval<4)
                  if (dense(i)<=x(interval+1)) exit
                  interval=interval+1
               end do
               lower=min(sgn*profile(interval),sgn*profile(interval+1))
               upper=max(sgn*profile(interval),sgn*profile(interval+1))
               if (.not.ieee_is_finite(smooth(i))) error stop 'nonfinite shape interpolation'
               if (smooth(i)<lower-2e-12_real64.or.smooth(i)>upper+2e-12_real64) error stop 'interval overshoot'
               nbound=nbound+1
               if (profile_id==1.and.i>1) then
                  if (sgn*(smooth(i)-smooth(i-1)) < -2e-12_real64) error stop 'monotonicity'
                  nmono=nmono+1
               end if
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   hump_refs=0
   hx=[0.0_real64,1.0_real64,2.0_real64]; hy=[0.0_real64,1.0_real64,0.0_real64]
   dense=[(real(i,real64)/64,i=0,128)]
   do method=2,3
      smooth=interp1(hx,hy,dense,method=trim(methods(method)))
      do i=1,size(dense)
         t=dense(i)
         if (t>1) t=2-t
         ! Endpoint secant slope 1 and stationary middle knot give this cubic.
         reference=-t**3+t**2+t
         call check(smooth(i),reference)
         hump_refs=hump_refs+1
      end do
   end do
   if (nref/=3286.or.nnan/=36.or.nbound/=1032.or.nmono/=512) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exact affine references across all four overloads, including extrapolation: ',affine_refs
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exact mirrored cubic references (pchip/cubic aliases): ',hump_refs
   print '(a,4i6)', 'Total exact / NaN / interval-bound / monotonicity checks: ',nref,nnan,nbound,nmono
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized exact-reference error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS interp1-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,expected)
      real(real64),intent(in)::actual,expected
      real(real64)::error
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'nonfinite interpolated value'
      error=abs(actual-expected)/max(1.0_real64,abs(expected))
      if (error>2e-12_real64) error stop 'exact interpolation reference'
      worst=max(worst,error); nref=nref+1
   end subroutine check
end program main

source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/rkf-qags-drivers-MIT.txt.
module models
   use rkf45_module,only:rk
   implicit none
   integer::family,evaluations
   real(rk)::rate,frequency,start,initial(2),offset(2)
contains
   subroutine rhs(t,y,dy)
      real(rk),intent(in)::t,y(:)
      real(rk),intent(out)::dy(:)
      evaluations=evaluations+1
      select case(family)
      case(1)
         dy=[-rate*y(1)-frequency*y(2),frequency*y(1)-rate*y(2)]
      case(2)
         dy(1)=-rate*(y(1)-sin(frequency*t)-t*t)+frequency*cos(frequency*t)+2*t
         dy(2)=-rate*(y(2)-cos(frequency*t)-t)-frequency*sin(frequency*t)+1
      case(3)
         dy=[rate*y(1)*(1-y(1)),0.5_rk*rate*y(2)*(1-y(2))]
      end select
   end subroutine rhs
   function exact(t) result(y)
      real(rk),intent(in)::t
      real(rk)::y(2),elapsed,angle,factor
      elapsed=t-start
      select case(family)
      case(1)
         angle=frequency*elapsed; factor=exp(-rate*elapsed)
         y=factor*[initial(1)*cos(angle)-initial(2)*sin(angle), &
                   initial(1)*sin(angle)+initial(2)*cos(angle)]
      case(2)
         y=[sin(frequency*t)+t*t,cos(frequency*t)+t]+exp(-rate*elapsed)*offset
      case(3)
         y(1)=initial(1)/(initial(1)+(1-initial(1))*exp(-rate*elapsed))
         y(2)=initial(2)/(initial(2)+(1-initial(2))*exp(-0.5_rk*rate*elapsed))
      end select
   end function exact
end module models
program main
   use models
   use rkf45_module,only:rkf45
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(rk)::y(2),expected(2),t,finish,target,relative,absolute,work(15),error,worst,invariant
   integer::iwork(5),flag,rate_id,init_id,direction,i,runs,calls,total_evaluations
   if (precision(1.0_rk)<15) error stop 'double precision required'
   runs=0; calls=0; total_evaluations=0; worst=0
   do family=1,3
      do rate_id=1,2
         rate=0.25_rk
         if (rate_id==2) rate=1
         frequency=real(2*rate_id-1,rk)
         do init_id=1,2
            do direction=1,2
               start=-0.5_rk; finish=1.5_rk
               if (direction==2) then
                  start=1.5_rk; finish=-0.5_rk
               end if
               initial=[1.0_rk,-0.5_rk]; offset=[0.25_rk,-0.5_rk]
               if (init_id==2) then
                  initial=[-0.25_rk,2.0_rk]; offset=[-0.75_rk,0.125_rk]
               end if
               if (family==3) then
                  initial=[0.25_rk,0.75_rk]
                  if (init_id==2) initial=[0.1_rk,0.6_rk]
               end if
               y=exact(start); t=start; evaluations=0
               relative=1e-10_rk; absolute=1e-12_rk
               work=0; iwork=0; flag=1
               do i=1,16
                  target=start+(finish-start)*real(i,rk)/16
                  call rkf45(rhs,2,y,t,target,relative,absolute,flag,work,iwork)
                  if (flag/=2) then
                     print '(a,5i5)', 'Family/rate/start/direction/flag: ',family,rate_id,init_id,direction,flag
                     error stop 'RKF45 did not reach target normally'
                  end if
                  if (abs(t-target)>16*epsilon(t)*max(1.0_rk,abs(target))) error stop 'wrong target time'
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(y))) error stop 'nonfinite ODE state'
                  expected=exact(target)
                  error=maxval(abs(y-expected))/max(1.0_rk,maxval(abs(expected)))
                  if (error>5e-8_rk) error stop 'analytical ODE reference'
                  worst=max(worst,error)
                  if (family==1) then
                     invariant=sum(initial**2)*exp(-2*rate*(target-start))
                     if (abs(sum(y**2)-invariant)/max(1.0_rk,invariant)>1e-7_rk) &
                        error stop 'oscillator decay invariant'
                  end if
                  if (family==3) then
                     if (any(y<=0).or.any(y>=1)) error stop 'logistic invariant interval'
                  end if
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
               if (evaluations<=0) error stop 'RHS callback not used'
               total_evaluations=total_evaluations+evaluations
               runs=runs+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
      print '(a,i0,a)', 'Family ',family,': forward/backward runs at two rates and two initial states passed.'
   end do
   if (runs/=24.or.calls/=384) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Integration runs: ',runs,'; requested target calls: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'RHS evaluations: ',total_evaluations
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized analytical state error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS rkf45-analytic-reference'
end program main

name: gams-fgsl-qags-reference

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/rkf-qags-drivers-MIT.txt.
module integrands
   use iso_c_binding,only:c_int,c_double,c_ptr,c_f_pointer
   implicit none
   type,bind(c)::settings
      integer(c_int)::family
      real(c_double)::parameter
   end type settings
   integer::evaluations=0
contains
   function integrand(x,params) bind(c) result(y)
      real(c_double),value::x
      type(c_ptr),value::params
      real(c_double)::y,p
      type(settings),pointer::s
      call c_f_pointer(params,s)
      evaluations=evaluations+1; p=s%parameter
      select case(s%family)
      case(1)
         y=x**p
      case(2)
         y=x**p*log(x)
      case(3)
         y=1/(1+(p*x)**2)
      case(4)
         y=exp(p*x)
      case(5)
         y=sin(p*x)
      end select
   end function integrand
end module integrands
program main
   use fgsl
   use integrands
   use iso_c_binding,only:c_loc
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer(fgsl_size_t),parameter::limit=1000
   real(fgsl_double),parameter::powers(*)=[-0.5_fgsl_double,-0.25_fgsl_double,0.5_fgsl_double, &
      2.0_fgsl_double,5.0_fgsl_double]
   type(settings),target::parameters
   type(fgsl_function)::function
   type(fgsl_integration_workspace)::workspace
   real(fgsl_double)::a,b,p,tolerance,reference,value,estimate,error,budget,worst,worst_estimate,pi
   integer(fgsl_int)::status
   integer::family_id,case_id,tolerance_id,ncases,calls,total_evaluations
   calls=0; total_evaluations=0; worst=0; worst_estimate=0; pi=acos(-1.0_fgsl_double)
   function=fgsl_function_init(integrand,c_loc(parameters))
   workspace=fgsl_integration_workspace_alloc(limit)
   if (.not.fgsl_well_defined(workspace)) error stop 'workspace allocation'
   do tolerance_id=1,2
      tolerance=1e-7_fgsl_double
      if (tolerance_id==2) tolerance=1e-10_fgsl_double
      do family_id=1,5
         ncases=3
         if (family_id<=2) ncases=5
         if (family_id==5) ncases=4
         do case_id=1,ncases
            parameters%family=family_id
            select case(family_id)
            case(1,2)
               p=powers(case_id); a=0; b=1
               reference=1/(p+1)
               if (family_id==2) reference=-1/(p+1)**2
            case(3)
               p=real(case_id,fgsl_double)/2
               if (case_id==3) p=2
               a=-2; b=3
               reference=(atan(p*b)-atan(p*a))/p
            case(4)
               p=-1
               if (case_id==2) p=0.5_fgsl_double
               if (case_id==3) p=2
               a=-1; b=2
               reference=(exp(p*b)-exp(p*a))/p
            case(5)
               p=real(2*case_id-1,fgsl_double)
               if (case_id==4) p=16
               a=0; b=pi
               reference=(1-cos(p*pi))/p
            end select
            parameters%parameter=p; evaluations=0
            status=fgsl_integration_qags(function,a,b,tolerance,tolerance,limit,workspace,value,estimate)
            if (status/=fgsl_success) then
               print '(a,4i5)', 'Family/case/tolerance/status: ',family_id,case_id,tolerance_id,status
               error stop 'QAGS status'
            end if
            if (.not.ieee_is_finite(value).or..not.ieee_is_finite(estimate)) error stop 'nonfinite quadrature'
            if (evaluations<=0) error stop 'integrand not called'
            error=abs(value-reference)/max(1.0_fgsl_double,abs(reference))
            if (error>5*tolerance) error stop 'analytical integral'
            budget=max(tolerance,tolerance*abs(value))
            if (estimate<0.or.estimate>budget+32*epsilon(value)*max(1.0_fgsl_double,abs(value))) &
               error stop 'error estimate outside requested budget'
            worst=max(worst,error)
            worst_estimate=max(worst_estimate,estimate/max(1.0_fgsl_double,abs(reference)))
            total_evaluations=total_evaluations+evaluations; calls=calls+1
         end do
      end do
      print '(a,es12.4,a)', 'Requested absolute/relative tolerance ',tolerance,': all five integral families passed.'
   end do
   call fgsl_function_free(function)
   call fgsl_integration_workspace_free(workspace)
   if (calls/=40) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0)', 'Adaptive finite-interval integrals with one reused workspace: ',calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Integrand evaluations: ',total_evaluations
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized analytical integral error: ',worst
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized reported error estimate: ',worst_estimate
   print '(a)', 'PASS fgsl-qags-reference'
end program main

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/jacobian-roots-drivers-MIT.txt.
module fit_problem
   use minpack_module,only:wp
   implicit none
   integer::family,residual_calls,jacobian_calls
   real(wp)::amplitude,exponent,rho
contains
   subroutine model(x,f,jac)
      real(wp),intent(in)::x(2)
      real(wp),intent(out)::f(5),jac(5,2)
      real(wp),parameter::noise(5)=[1.0_wp,-2.0_wp,2.0_wp,-2.0_wp,1.0_wp]
      real(wp)::t,v
      integer::i
      do i=1,5
         if (family==1) then
            t=real(i-3,wp)/2; v=exp(x(2)*t)
            f(i)=x(1)*v-amplitude*exp(exponent*t)
            jac(i,:)=[v,x(1)*t*v]
         else
            t=real(i-3,wp)
            f(i)=exp(x(1))-2+t*(x(2)**3-1)+rho*noise(i)
            jac(i,:)=[exp(x(1)),3*t*x(2)**2]
         end if
      end do
   end subroutine model
   subroutine callback(m,n,x,f,jac,ldjac,iflag)
      integer,intent(in)::m,n,ldjac
      real(wp),intent(in)::x(n)
      real(wp),intent(inout)::f(m),jac(ldjac,n)
      integer,intent(inout)::iflag
      real(wp)::values(5),derivatives(5,2)
      call model(x,values,derivatives)
      select case(iflag)
      case(1)
         f=values; residual_calls=residual_calls+1
      case(2)
         jac=derivatives; jacobian_calls=jacobian_calls+1
      end select
   end subroutine callback
end module fit_problem
program main
   use fit_problem
   use minpack_module,only:lmder1
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp),parameter::amplitudes(*)=[0.5_wp,2.0_wp],exponents(*)=[-1.0_wp,0.25_wp,1.0_wp]
   real(wp),parameter::noise_scales(*)=[-0.5_wp,-0.125_wp,0.125_wp,0.5_wp]
   real(wp)::x(2),expected(2),f(5),jac(5,2),wa(15),check_f(5),check_j(5,2),plus(5),minus(5),scratch(5,2),xp(2)
   real(wp)::step,error,worst_x,worst_j,objective,expected_objective,gradient,worst_g,value
   integer::ia,ib,start_a,start_b,noise_id,info,pivots(2),runs,exact_runs,noisy_runs,jac_entries,c
   runs=0; exact_runs=0; noisy_runs=0; jac_entries=0; worst_x=0; worst_j=0; worst_g=0
   family=1; rho=0
   do ia=1,size(amplitudes)
      amplitude=amplitudes(ia)
      do ib=1,size(exponents)
         exponent=exponents(ib); expected=[amplitude,exponent]
         do start_a=1,2
            do start_b=1,2
               x=[amplitude*real(2*start_a-1,wp)/2,exponent+real(2*start_b-3,wp)/2]
               call fit()
               exact_runs=exact_runs+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   family=2; expected=[log(2.0_wp),1.0_wp]
   do noise_id=1,size(noise_scales)
      rho=noise_scales(noise_id)
      do start_a=1,2
         do start_b=1,2
            x=[expected(1)+real(2*start_a-3,wp)*0.7_wp,real(2*start_b-1,wp)/2]
            call fit()
            noisy_runs=noisy_runs+1
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (runs/=40.or.exact_runs/=24.or.noisy_runs/=16.or.jac_entries/=400) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,3i5)', 'Total / exact-fit / nonzero-residual fits: ',runs,exact_runs,noisy_runs
   print '(a,i0)', 'Analytical Jacobian entries checked by central differences at starting points: ',jac_entries
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized parameter error: ',worst_x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized Jacobian finite-difference error: ',worst_j
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum absolute J-transpose-residual component: ',worst_g
   print '(a)', 'PASS minpack-lmder-reference'
contains
   subroutine fit()
      call model(x,check_f,check_j)
      do c=1,2
         step=1e-5_wp*max(1.0_wp,abs(x(c)))
         xp=x; xp(c)=xp(c)+step; call model(xp,plus,scratch)
         xp=x; xp(c)=xp(c)-step; call model(xp,minus,scratch)
         error=maxval(abs((plus-minus)/(2*step)-check_j(:,c)))/max(1.0_wp,maxval(abs(check_j(:,c))))
         if (error>2e-7_wp) error stop 'user Jacobian finite-difference check'
         worst_j=max(worst_j,error); jac_entries=jac_entries+5
      end do
      residual_calls=0; jacobian_calls=0; wa=0
      call lmder1(callback,5,2,x,f,jac,5,1e-12_wp,info,pivots,wa,size(wa))
      if (info<1.or.info>4) error stop 'MINPACK normal stopping status'
      if (residual_calls<=0.or.jacobian_calls<=0) error stop 'both callbacks required'
      if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(x)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(f))) error stop 'nonfinite fit'
      call model(x,check_f,check_j)
      if (maxval(abs(check_f-f))>1e-11_wp) error stop 'returned residual consistency'
      error=maxval(abs(x-expected))/max(1.0_wp,maxval(abs(expected)))
      if (error>2e-7_wp) error stop 'known fit parameters'
      worst_x=max(worst_x,error)
      objective=sum(f*f); expected_objective=0
      if (family==2) expected_objective=14*rho**2
      if (abs(objective-expected_objective)/max(1.0_wp,expected_objective)>1e-10_wp) &
         error stop 'known minimum residual norm'
      gradient=maxval(abs([sum(check_j(:,1)*f),sum(check_j(:,2)*f)]))
      if (gradient>1e-6_wp) error stop 'least-squares stationarity'
      worst_g=max(worst_g,gradient)
      if (family==1.and.maxval(abs(f))>1e-8_wp) error stop 'exact-fit residual'
      runs=runs+1
   end subroutine fit
end program main

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/jacobian-roots-drivers-MIT.txt.
module root_problem
   use forsolver,only:rk
   implicit none
   integer::family,f_calls,df_calls,complex_calls
   real(rk)::center,scale
contains
   function f(x) result(y)
      real(rk),intent(in)::x
      real(rk)::y,u
      u=x-center; f_calls=f_calls+1
      select case(family)
      case(1)
         y=scale*(u+u**3)
      case(2)
         y=scale*(exp(u)-1)
      case(3)
         y=scale*(u+0.25_rk*sin(u))
      end select
   end function f
   function df(x) result(y)
      real(rk),intent(in)::x
      real(rk)::y,u
      u=x-center; df_calls=df_calls+1
      select case(family)
      case(1)
         y=scale*(1+3*u*u)
      case(2)
         y=scale*exp(u)
      case(3)
         y=scale*(1+0.25_rk*cos(u))
      end select
   end function df
   function fc(x) result(y)
      complex(rk),intent(in)::x
      complex(rk)::y,u
      u=x-center; complex_calls=complex_calls+1
      select case(family)
      case(1)
         y=scale*(u+u**3)
      case(2)
         y=scale*(exp(u)-1)
      case(3)
         y=scale*(u+0.25_rk*sin(u))
      end select
   end function fc
end module root_problem
program main
   use root_problem
   use forsolver,only:nlsolver
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(rk),parameter::centers(*)=[-2.0_rk,0.0_rk,0.5_rk,3.0_rk],scales(*)=[0.5_rk,2.0_rk]
   real(rk),parameter::starts(*)=[-2.0_rk,-0.5_rk,0.5_rk,2.0_rk]
   type(nlsolver)::solver
   real(rk)::roots(3),x0,error,residual,worst_x,worst_f,spread,worst_spread
   complex(rk)::z
   integer::ic,is,istart,method,calls,cases
   calls=0; cases=0; worst_x=0; worst_f=0; worst_spread=0
   do family=1,3
      do ic=1,size(centers)
         center=centers(ic)
         do is=1,size(scales)
            scale=scales(is)
            do istart=1,size(starts)
               x0=center+starts(istart)
               do method=1,3
                  f_calls=0; df_calls=0; complex_calls=0
                  select case(method)
                  case(1)
                     call solver%set_options(nl_method='newton',maxit=100,TolFun=1e-12_rk,verbosity=0)
                     call solver%solve(F=f,dFdx=df,x0=x0,x_sol=roots(method))
                     if (f_calls<=0.or.df_calls<=0) error stop 'analytic Newton callbacks'
                  case(2)
                     call solver%set_options(nl_method='newton-quasi-fd',fdm_method='central', &
                        fdm_tol=1e-6_rk,maxit=100,TolFun=1e-12_rk,verbosity=0)
                     call solver%solve(F=f,x0=x0,x_sol=roots(method))
                     if (f_calls<=0) error stop 'finite-difference callbacks'
                  case(3)
                     call solver%set_options(nl_method='newton-quasi-cs',cs_tol=1e-20_rk, &
                        maxit=100,TolFun=1e-12_rk,verbosity=0)
                     call solver%solve(F=fc,x0=cmplx(x0,0.0_rk,rk),x_sol=z)
                     if (complex_calls<=0) error stop 'complex-step callbacks'
                     if (.not.ieee_is_finite(real(z,rk)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(aimag(z))) &
                        error stop 'nonfinite complex root'
                     if (abs(aimag(z))>1e-12_rk) error stop 'unexpected imaginary root'
                     roots(method)=real(z,rk)
                  end select
                  if (.not.ieee_is_finite(roots(method))) error stop 'nonfinite real root'
                  error=abs(roots(method)-center)/max(1.0_rk,abs(center))
                  residual=abs(f(roots(method)))/max(1.0_rk,abs(scale))
                  if (error>1e-9_rk.or.residual>1e-10_rk) error stop 'known root/residual'
                  worst_x=max(worst_x,error); worst_f=max(worst_f,residual)
                  calls=calls+1
               end do
               spread=(maxval(roots)-minval(roots))/max(1.0_rk,abs(center))
               if (spread>1e-9_rk) error stop 'Newton method disagreement'
               worst_spread=max(worst_spread,spread); cases=cases+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (cases/=96.or.calls/=288) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Unique-root fixtures: ',cases,'; three-method solves: ',calls
   print '(a)', 'Analytic Newton, central finite differences and complex step; all roots independently prescribed.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized root error: ',worst_x
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized residual: ',worst_f
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized inter-method spread: ',worst_spread
   print '(a)', 'PASS forsolver-newton-reference'
end program main

! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/higher-ad-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use config_mod,only:prec,max_order_dualzn
   use dualzn_mod
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(prec),parameter::reals(*)=[-1.0_prec,-0.25_prec,0.0_prec,0.5_prec,1.0_prec]
   real(prec),parameter::imags(*)=[-0.5_prec,0.0_prec,0.25_prec]
   real(prec),parameter::a_values(*)=[0.5_prec,1.0_prec,2.0_prec],b_values(*)=[-2.0_prec,0.5_prec,1.0_prec]
   integer,parameter::coeff(0:5)=[1,3,0,-2,0,1]
   type(dualzn)::x,y
   complex(prec)::z,expected,u,polynomial
   real(prec)::a,b,error,worst
   integer::ir,ii,order,k,pair,j,d,expressions,checks,transcendental,composed,algebraic
   if (max_order_dualzn<5.or.precision(1.0_prec)<15) error stop 'configured order/precision'
   expressions=0; checks=0; transcendental=0; composed=0; algebraic=0; worst=0
   do ir=1,size(reals)
      do ii=1,size(imags)
         z=cmplx(reals(ir),imags(ii),prec)
         do order=0,5
            x=xto_dzn(z,order)
            if (order>=1) x%f(1)=1
            do pair=1,3
               a=a_values(pair); b=b_values(pair)
               y=exp(a*x)+sin(b*x)
               if (y%ord/=order) error stop 'result derivative order'
               expressions=expressions+1
               do k=0,order
                  select case(modulo(k,4))
                  case(0)
                     expected=b**k*sin(b*z)
                  case(1)
                     expected=b**k*cos(b*z)
                  case(2)
                     expected=-b**k*sin(b*z)
                  case(3)
                     expected=-b**k*cos(b*z)
                  end select
                  expected=expected+a**k*exp(a*z)
                  call check(y%f(k),expected)
                  transcendental=transcendental+1
               end do
            end do
            y=exp(x*x+x)
            if (y%ord/=order) error stop 'composition derivative order'
            expressions=expressions+1
            u=2*z+1
            do k=0,order
               polynomial=0
               do j=0,k/2
                  polynomial=polynomial+real(factorial(k)/(factorial(j)*factorial(k-2*j)),prec)*u**(k-2*j)
               end do
               expected=exp(z*z+z)*polynomial
               call check(y%f(k),expected)
               composed=composed+1
            end do
            y=x*x*x*x*x-2*x*x*x+3*x+1
            if (y%ord/=order) error stop 'polynomial derivative order'
            expressions=expressions+1
            do k=0,order
               expected=0
               do d=k,5
                  expected=expected+real(coeff(d)*factorial(d)/factorial(d-k),prec)*z**(d-k)
               end do
               call check(y%f(k),expected)
               algebraic=algebraic+1
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end do
   if (expressions/=450.or.checks/=1575.or.transcendental/=945.or.composed/=315.or.algebraic/=315) &
      error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Dual expressions at 15 real/complex points and requested orders 0..5: ',expressions, &
      '; derivative references: ',checks
   print '(a,3i6)', 'Scaled exp/sin / composed exp / polynomial derivatives: ',transcendental,composed,algebraic
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized complex derivative error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS dnaoad-higher-reference'
contains
   integer function factorial(n) result(value)
      integer,intent(in)::n
      integer::i
      value=1
      do i=2,n
         value=value*i
      end do
   end function factorial
   subroutine check(actual,reference)
      complex(prec),intent(in)::actual,reference
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(real(actual,prec)).or..not.ieee_is_finite(aimag(actual))) &
         error stop 'nonfinite complex derivative'
      error=abs(actual-reference)/max(1.0_prec,abs(reference))
      if (error>2e-11_prec) error stop 'closed-form complex derivative'
      worst=max(worst,error); checks=checks+1
   end subroutine check
end program main

name: gams-diffstruc-hessian-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/higher-ad-drivers-MIT.txt.
! This short process retains derivative graphs until exit; disposal is not tested.
program main
   use diffstruc
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   type node_handle
      type(array_type),pointer::p=>null()
   end type node_handle
   type(array_type),target::x(5)
   type(node_handle)::f(5),derivative(6,5)
   real(real32),parameter::points(3,5)=reshape([0.5_real32,-1.0_real32,2.0_real32, &
      -0.75_real32,0.5_real32,1.25_real32,0.0_real32,0.0_real32,0.0_real32, &
      2.0_real32,-0.5_real32,-1.0_real32,1.0_real32,2.0_real32,-2.0_real32],[3,5])
   real(real32)::directions(3,6),v(3),expected_value,gradient(3),hessian(3,3),actual_hessian(3,3)
   real(real32)::forward(6),reverse(3),expected,error,worst
   integer::sample,j,i,checks,forward_calls,reverse_calls
   directions=0
   do j=1,3
      directions(j,j)=1
   end do
   directions(:,4)=[1.0_real32,-2.0_real32,0.5_real32]
   directions(:,5)=[-0.5_real32,0.0_real32,2.0_real32]
   worst=0; checks=0; forward_calls=0; reverse_calls=0
   do sample=1,5
      v=points(:,sample)
      call x(sample)%allocate(array_shape=[3,1])
      x(sample)%is_temporary=.false.
      x(sample)%val(:,1)=v
      call x(sample)%set_requires_grad(.true.)
      f(sample)%p => pack(x(sample),[1],1)**3 + pack(x(sample),[1],1)*pack(x(sample),[2],1) &
         + pack(x(sample),[2],1)*pack(x(sample),[3],1)**2 + pack(x(sample),[3],1)**2
      if (.not.associated(f(sample)%p)) error stop 'expression graph missing'
      f(sample)%p%is_temporary=.false.
      expected_value=v(1)**3+v(1)*v(2)+v(2)*v(3)**2+v(3)**2
      gradient=[3*v(1)**2+v(2),v(1)+v(3)**2,2*(v(2)+1)*v(3)]
      hessian=reshape([6*v(1),1.0_real32,0.0_real32,1.0_real32,0.0_real32,2*v(3), &
                      0.0_real32,2*v(3),2*(v(2)+1)],[3,3])
      call check(f(sample)%p%val(1,1),expected_value)
      do j=1,6
         call x(sample)%set_direction(directions(:,j))
         derivative(j,sample)%p => f(sample)%p%grad_forward(x(sample))
         if (.not.associated(derivative(j,sample)%p)) error stop 'forward graph missing'
         derivative(j,sample)%p%is_temporary=.false.
         forward(j)=derivative(j,sample)%p%val(1,1)
         expected=sum(gradient*directions(:,j))
         call check(forward(j),expected)
         forward_calls=forward_calls+1
      end do
      ! Reverse mode needs the full direction mask restored after directional passes.
      call x(sample)%set_direction([1.0_real32,1.0_real32,1.0_real32])
      call f(sample)%p%grad_reverse(reset_graph=.true.)
      if (.not.associated(x(sample)%grad)) error stop 'reverse gradient missing'
      reverse=x(sample)%grad%val(:,1)
      do i=1,3
         call check(reverse(i),gradient(i))
      end do
      reverse_calls=reverse_calls+1
      do j=1,3
         call derivative(j,sample)%p%grad_reverse(reset_graph=.true.)
         if (.not.associated(x(sample)%grad)) error stop 'Hessian row missing'
         actual_hessian(:,j)=x(sample)%grad%val(:,1)
         do i=1,3
            call check(actual_hessian(i,j),hessian(i,j))
         end do
         reverse_calls=reverse_calls+1
      end do
      if (maxval(abs(actual_hessian-transpose(actual_hessian)))>1e-5_real32) error stop 'Hessian symmetry'
   end do
   if (checks/=95.or.forward_calls/=30.or.reverse_calls/=20) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Three-variable polynomial points: 5; forward calls: ',forward_calls,'; reverse calls: ',reverse_calls
   print '(a,i0)', 'Exact values, directional derivatives, gradient and Hessian entries: ',checks
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized REAL32 reference error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS diffstruc-hessian-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,reference)
      real(real32),intent(in)::actual,reference
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'nonfinite AD value'
      error=abs(actual-reference)/max(1.0_real32,abs(reference))
      if (error>1e-5_real32) error stop 'analytical polynomial derivative'
      worst=max(worst,error); checks=checks+1
   end subroutine check
end program main

name: gams-qdutillib-moments-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/moments-nufft2d-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use QDUtil_NumParameters_m,only:Rkind
   use QDUtil_Quadrature_m,only:Quadrature_t,Init_Quadrature,dealloc_Quadrature
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::orders(*)=[1,2,3,4,6,8,12]
   type(Quadrature_t)::q
   real(Rkind),allocatable::nodes(:),weights(:),terms(:)
   real(Rkind)::value,reference,scale,error,worst,pi,tmp,even_moment
   integer::family,order_id,n,p,i,j,status,rules,moments,shifted
   pi=acos(-1.0_Rkind); worst=0; rules=0; moments=0; shifted=0
   do family=1,2
      do order_id=1,size(orders)
         n=orders(order_id)
         if (family==1) then
            call Init_Quadrature(q,nq=n,name='LegendreP',err=status)
         else
            call Init_Quadrature(q,nq=n,name='HO',err=status)
         end if
         if (status/=0) error stop 'quadrature initialization status'
         if (.not.allocated(q%x).or..not.allocated(q%w)) error stop 'quadrature storage'
         if (any(shape(q%x)/=[1,n]).or.size(q%w)/=n) error stop 'quadrature shape'
         if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(q%x)).or..not.all(ieee_is_finite(q%w))) error stop 'nonfinite rule'
         if (any(q%w<=0)) error stop 'positive weights'
         allocate(nodes(n),weights(n),terms(n))
         nodes=q%x(1,:); weights=q%w
         ! HO stores full-function weights; recover Gaussian-weighted polynomial moments.
         if (family==2) weights=weights*exp(-nodes**2)
         if (family==1.and.any(abs(nodes)>=1)) error stop 'Legendre interval'
         do i=2,n
            tmp=nodes(i); value=weights(i); j=i-1
            do while(j>=1)
               if (nodes(j)<=tmp) exit
               nodes(j+1)=nodes(j); weights(j+1)=weights(j); j=j-1
            end do
            nodes(j+1)=tmp; weights(j+1)=value
         end do
         if (maxval(abs(nodes+nodes(n:1:-1)))>1e-11_Rkind*max(1.0_Rkind,maxval(abs(nodes)))) &
            error stop 'node symmetry'
         if (maxval(abs(weights-weights(n:1:-1)))>1e-11_Rkind*max(1.0_Rkind,maxval(abs(weights)))) &
            error stop 'weight symmetry'
         even_moment=sqrt(pi)
         do p=0,2*n-1
            reference=0
            if (mod(p,2)==0) then
               if (family==1) then
                  reference=2.0_Rkind/real(p+1,Rkind)
               else
                  if (p>0) even_moment=even_moment*real(p-1,Rkind)/2
                  reference=even_moment
               end if
            end if
            terms=weights*nodes**p
            call check(sum(terms),reference,sum(abs(terms)))
            moments=moments+1
         end do
         if (family==1) then
            do p=0,min(2*n-1,8)
               terms=weights*(nodes+2)**p
               reference=(3.0_Rkind**(p+1)-1)/real(p+1,Rkind)
               call check(sum(terms),reference,sum(abs(terms)))
               shifted=shifted+1
            end do
         end if
         call dealloc_Quadrature(q)
         if (allocated(q%x).or.allocated(q%w)) error stop 'quadrature deallocation'
         deallocate(nodes,weights,terms)
         rules=rules+1
      end do
   end do
   if (rules/=14.or.moments/=144.or.shifted/=47) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0,a,i0)', 'Rules: ',rules,'; Legendre/Gaussian moments: ',moments,'; shifted moments: ',shifted
   print '(a)', 'Orders 1,2,3,4,6,8,12: positive weights, symmetry, exact polynomial moments and deallocation.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum moment error normalized by reference/absolute contributions: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS qdutillib-moments-reference'
contains
   subroutine check(actual,expected,contributions)
      real(Rkind),intent(in)::actual,expected,contributions
      if (.not.ieee_is_finite(actual)) error stop 'nonfinite moment'
      scale=max(1.0_Rkind,abs(expected),contributions)
      error=abs(actual-expected)/scale
      if (error>5e-11_Rkind) error stop 'analytical polynomial moment'
      worst=max(worst,error)
   end subroutine check
end program main

name: gams-nufft2d-direct-reference
source:
! Independent API consumer; MIT: licenses/moments-nufft2d-drivers-MIT.txt.
program main
   use iso_fortran_env,only:real64
   use ieee_arithmetic,only:ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   integer,parameter::counts(*)=[8,31,64],grids(2,3)=reshape([8,10,9,11,16,18],[2,3])
   real(real64),parameter::pi=acos(-1.0_real64),tolerances(*)=[1e-7_real64,1e-10_real64]
   real(real64),allocatable::x(:),y(:),saved_x(:),saved_y(:)
   complex(real64),allocatable::c(:),saved_c(:),fk(:,:),reference(:,:)
   complex(real64)::value,dc
   real(real64)::eps,error,worst,phase,scale
   integer::count_id,grid_id,nj,ms,mt,pattern,sign,tolerance_id,j,k,l,status,calls,coefficients
   interface
      subroutine nufft2d1f90(nj,xj,yj,cj,iflag,eps,ms,mt,fk,ier)
         import real64
         integer::nj,iflag,ms,mt,ier
         real(real64)::xj(nj),yj(nj),eps
         complex(real64)::cj(nj),fk(-ms/2:(ms-1)/2,-mt/2:(mt-1)/2)
      end subroutine nufft2d1f90
   end interface
   calls=0; coefficients=0; worst=0
   do count_id=1,size(counts)
      nj=counts(count_id)
      allocate(x(nj),y(nj),c(nj),saved_x(nj),saved_y(nj),saved_c(nj))
      do grid_id=1,size(grids,2)
         ms=grids(1,grid_id); mt=grids(2,grid_id)
         allocate(fk(-ms/2:(ms-1)/2,-mt/2:(mt-1)/2),reference(-ms/2:(ms-1)/2,-mt/2:(mt-1)/2))
         do pattern=1,4
            do j=1,nj
               x(j)=pi*sin(0.71_real64*j); y(j)=pi*cos(0.43_real64*j)
               c(j)=cmplx(cos(0.13_real64*j),sin(0.17_real64*j),real64)
               select case(pattern)
               case(2)
                  x(j)=0; y(j)=0
               case(3)
                  x(j)=real(2*modulo(j,2)-1,real64)*(pi-1e-6_real64)
                  y(j)=real(2*modulo(j,3)-2,real64)*pi/4
               case(4)
                  c(j)=0
               end select
            end do
            saved_x=x; saved_y=y; saved_c=c; dc=sum(c)/nj
            do sign=-1,1,2
               ! Independent direct sums use the mathematical input before any library call.
               do l=-mt/2,(mt-1)/2
                  do k=-ms/2,(ms-1)/2
                     value=0
                     do j=1,nj
                        phase=real(sign,real64)*(k*x(j)+l*y(j))
                        value=value+c(j)*cmplx(cos(phase),sin(phase),real64)
                     end do
                     reference(k,l)=value/nj
                  end do
               end do
               do tolerance_id=1,size(tolerances)
                  eps=tolerances(tolerance_id)
                  call nufft2d1f90(nj,x,y,c,sign,eps,ms,mt,fk,status)
                  if (status/=0) error stop 'NUFFT success status'
                  if (.not.all(ieee_is_finite(real(fk,real64))).or. &
                     .not.all(ieee_is_finite(aimag(fk)))) error stop 'nonfinite coefficient'
                  if (any(x/=saved_x).or.any(y/=saved_y).or.any(c/=saved_c)) error stop 'input preservation'
                  scale=max(1.0_real64,maxval(abs(reference)))
                  error=maxval(abs(fk-reference))/scale
                  if (error>50*tolerances(tolerance_id)) then
                     print '(a,6i5,a,es12.4)', 'Points/grid/pattern/sign/tolerance: ',nj,ms,mt,pattern,sign, &
                        tolerance_id,' error ',error
                     error stop 'direct Fourier sum'
                  end if
                  if (abs(fk(0,0)-dc)/scale>50*tolerances(tolerance_id)) error stop 'DC normalization'
                  if (pattern==4.and.any(abs(fk)>0)) error stop 'zero strengths'
                  worst=max(worst,error); calls=calls+1; coefficients=coefficients+ms*mt
               end do
            end do
         end do
         deallocate(fk,reference)
      end do
      deallocate(x,y,c,saved_x,saved_y,saved_c)
   end do
   if (calls/=144.or.coefficients/=22416) error stop 'fixture accounting'
   print '(a,i0,a,i0)', 'Two-dimensional type-1 NUFFT calls: ',calls,'; direct coefficient comparisons: ',coefficients
   print '(a)', 'Even/odd grids, both signs, two tolerances; scattered, coincident, near-boundary and zero-strength data.'
   print '(a,es12.4)', 'Maximum normalized direct-sum error: ',worst
   print '(a)', 'PASS nufft2d-direct-reference'
end program main
